# Bash

## CellRanger - 10.1.0
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=$HOME/bin/cellranger-10.1.0:$PATH

REF=$HOME/Son/refdata-gex-mRatBN7-2-2024-A
FASTQ=$HOME/Son/FASTQ

samples=("Son_1" "Son_2" "Son_3" "Son_4" "Son_5"
          "Son_6" "Son_7" "Son_8" "Son_9" "Son_10")

cd $HOME/Son/Counts

for sample in "${samples[@]}"; do
  if [ -f "$sample/outs/metrics_summary.csv" ]; then
    echo "$sample already done, skipping."
    continue
  fi
  # remove incomplete run
  rm -rf "$sample"

  cellranger count --id="$sample" \
    --transcriptome="$REF" \
    --fastqs="$FASTQ" \
    --sample="$sample" \
    --localcores=30 \
    --localmem=100 \
    --create-bam=true \
    > "${sample}.log" 2>&1 || echo "$sample failed"
done
```

## CellBender - 0.3.2

```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate cellbender

COUNTS=$HOME/Son/Counts
BASE=$HOME/Son/Counts/CellBender

samples=("Son_1" "Son_2" "Son_3" "Son_4" "Son_5" "Son_6" "Son_7" "Son_8" "Son_9" "Son_10")

for s in "${samples[@]}"; do
  OUT=$BASE/$s
  if [ -f "$OUT/${s}_filtered.h5" ]; then echo "$s already done"; continue; fi
  if [ ! -f "$COUNTS/$s/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5" ]; then echo "$s: Cell Ranger output missing, skipping"; continue; fi

  mkdir -p "$OUT"; cd "$OUT"
  cellbender remove-background \
    --input "$COUNTS/$s/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5" \
    --output "$OUT/${s}.h5" \
    --fpr 0.01 \
    --epochs 150 \
    --cuda \
    --cpu-threads 12 \
    --checkpoint-mins 30 \
    > "$OUT/${s}.log" 2>&1 || echo "$s failed"
done
```

```{r Open}
Son_1 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_1_filtered.h5") %>%

Son_3 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_3_filtered.h5") %>%

Son_4 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_4_filtered.h5") %>%

Son_5 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_5_filtered.h5") %>% 
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_5") %>% 
  AddMetaData(metadata = "Control", col.name = "Group")

Son_6 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_6_filtered.h5") %>%
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_6") %>%
  AddMetaData(metadata = "Control", col.name = "Group")
Son_7 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_7_filtered.h5") %>%
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_7") %>%
  AddMetaData(metadata = "WD", col.name = "Group")
Son_8 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_8_filtered.h5") %>%
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_8") %>%
  AddMetaData(metadata = "Control", col.name = "Group")
Son_9 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_9_filtered.h5") %>%
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_9") %>%
  AddMetaData(metadata = "WD", col.name = "Group")
Son_10 = Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file_name = "CellBender/Son_10_filtered.h5") %>%
  CreateSeuratObject(., min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, project = "Son_10") %>%
  AddMetaData(metadata = "WD", col.name = "Group")

#Merge
Seurat_Merged = merge(Son_1, y = c(Son_2, Son_3, Son_4,Son_5,Son_6,Son_7,Son_8,Son_9,Son_10)
                      , add.cell.ids = paste0("Son_", 1:10))


#Create Sample Count
Count = data.frame(table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident))
colnames(Count) = c("Sample", "Before_QC")

#Subset Percent.mt
Seurat_Merged[["percent.mt"]] = PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_Merged, pattern = "^Mt-")
Seurat_Merged = subset(Seurat_Merged, subset = percent.mt < 0.5)                                          
Count_Mt = data.frame(table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident))
colnames(Count_Mt) = c("Sample", "After_PercentMt")
Count = left_join(Count, Count_Mt, by = "Sample")            

#Subset Percent.Ribo
Seurat_Merged[["percent.ribo"]] = PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_Merged, pattern = "^Rp[sl]")
Seurat_Merged = subset(Seurat_Merged, subset = percent.ribo < 2)                                       
Count_Ribo = data.frame(table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident))
colnames(Count_Ribo) = c("Sample", "After_PercentRibo")
Count = left_join(Count, Count_Ribo, by = "Sample")       

#MAD 5
md = Seurat_Merged@meta.data
out = isOutlier(md$nCount_RNA,   nmads = 5, log = TRUE, type = "lower", batch = md$orig.ident) |
      isOutlier(md$nFeature_RNA, nmads = 5, log = TRUE, type = "lower", batch = md$orig.ident)
table(md$orig.ident, out)
Seurat_Merged = Seurat_Merged[, !out]
Count_Mad5 = data.frame(table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident))
colnames(Count_Mad5) = c("Sample", "After_MAD5")
Count = left_join(Count, Count_Mad5, by = "Sample")     


#scDblFinder
sce = as.SingleCellExperiment(JoinLayers(Seurat_Merged))
set.seed(4301)
sce = scDblFinder(sce, samples = "orig.ident")
Seurat_Merged$dbl_class = sce$scDblFinder.class
Seurat_Merged$dbl_score = sce$scDblFinder.score
table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident, Seurat_Merged$dbl_class)
Seurat_Merged = subset(Seurat_Merged, subset = dbl_class == "singlet")
Count_Dbl = data.frame(table(Seurat_Merged$orig.ident))
colnames(Count_Dbl) = c("Sample", "After_DoubletCorrection")
Count = left_join(Count, Count_Dbl, by = "Sample")     

#Write QC
write.xlsx(Count, "Excel/CellsPerSample.xlsx")
saveRDS(Seurat_Merged,"RDS/SON_merged_QC.rds")
```

## Integration and Clustering

```{r Integration}
set.seed(4301)
library(Seurat)
library(scDblFinder)
library(scCustomize)
library(tidyverse)
library(scuttle)
library(openxlsx)

Merge = readRDS("RDS/SON_merged_QC.rds")

#Normalization
Merge = NormalizeData(Merge)
Merge = FindVariableFeatures(Merge, nfeatures = 2000)
Merge = ScaleData(Merge)
Merge = RunPCA(Merge, npcs = 100)

#Identify Number of PCS
library(PCAtools)
library(BiocSingular)
library(BiocParallel)
mat = GetAssayData(Merge, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data")[VariableFeatures(Merge), ]
horn = parallelPCA(mat,
                   BSPARAM = IrlbaParam(),
                   BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(8, tasks = 50, progressbar = TRUE,
                                            RNGseed = 4301))
npcs = horn$n
npcs #58
saveRDS(horn, "RDS/Horn_parallelPCA_Son.rds")
horn = readRDS("RDS/Horn_parallelPCA_Son.rds")
npcs = horn$n

#Integration
options(future.globals.maxSize = 50 * 1024^3)
Merge = IntegrateLayers(Merge, method = RPCAIntegration,
                        orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "rpca",
                        dims = 1:npcs, verbose = FALSE)

Merge = FindNeighbors(Merge, reduction = "rpca", dims = 1:npcs)
Merge = RunUMAP(Merge, reduction = "rpca", dims = 1:npcs)
DimPlot(Merge, reduction = "umap", label = T, group.by = "orig.ident")

res_grid = seq(0.1, 1.5, 0.1)
res_cols = paste0("RNA_snn_res.", res_grid)

#FindClusters
library(clustree) #Clustering tree
library(bluster) #Banfeld-Raftery and within-cluster dispersion (clusterRMSD), silhouette (approxSilhouette)
library(mclust) # ARI

Merge = FindClusters(Merge, resolution = res_grid, verbose = FALSE)
png("Figures/Clustree.png", width = 10, height = 14, units = "in", res = 300, type = "cairo")
print(clustree(Merge, prefix = "RNA_snn_res."))
dev.off()
saveRDS(Merge, "RDS/Son_Clustered.rds")


emb = Embeddings(Merge, "rpca")[, 1:npcs]
metrics = map_dfr(seq_along(res_grid), function(i) {
  cl  = droplevels(Merge@meta.data[[res_cols[i]]])
  ss  = clusterRMSD(emb, cl, sum = TRUE)
  n_k = as.numeric(table(cl)[names(ss)])
  data.frame(
    Resolution    = res_grid[i],
    nClusters     = nlevels(cl),
    BR            = sum(n_k * log(ss / n_k)),
    WC_dispersion = sum(ss),
    Silhouette    = mean(approxSilhouette(emb, cl)$width),
    ARI_next      = if (i < length(res_grid))
                      pairwiseRand(cl, Merge@meta.data[[res_cols[i + 1]]], mode = "index") else NA
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)
metrics

knee = function(x, y) {
  xn = (x - min(x)) / diff(range(x))
  yn = (y - min(y)) / diff(range(y))
  which.max(1 - xn - yn)
}
m = metrics %>% arrange(Resolution)
knee_WC = m$Resolution[knee(m$nClusters, m$WC_dispersion)]
knee_BR = m$Resolution[knee(m$nClusters, m$BR)]
#Stability plateau
ari_thr = 0.95
stable  = m$Resolution[!is.na(m$ARI_next) & m$ARI_next >= ari_thr]
chosen = min(stable[stable >= min(knee_WC, knee_BR)])
cat("Knee WC:", knee_WC, "| Knee BR:", knee_BR,
    "| Plateau start:", min(stable), "| Chosen:", chosen, "\n")

lvl = c("Within-cluster dispersion", "Banfeld–Raftery",
        "Mean silhouette", "ARI (res vs next res)")
long = m %>%
  select(Resolution, WC_dispersion, BR, Silhouette, ARI_next) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Resolution) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("WC_dispersion", "BR", "Silhouette", "ARI_next"),
                       labels = lvl))
 
knees = long %>%
  filter((name == lvl[1] & Resolution == knee_WC) | (name == lvl[2] & Resolution == knee_BR))
ggplot(long, aes(Resolution, value)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = min(stable), xmax = max(stable), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = knees, colour = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chosen, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  geom_hline(data = data.frame(name = factor(lvl[4], levels = lvl), y = ari_thr),
             aes(yintercept = y), linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = m$Resolution,
                     labels = paste0(m$Resolution, "\n(", m$nClusters, ")")) +
  labs(x = "Resolution (number of clusters)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
ggsave("Figures/Clustering_Parameters.tiff", height = 10, width = 5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
write.xlsx(metrics, "Excel/Clustering_Parameters.xlsx")
```

## Number of PCs 

```{r Horn Parallel Analysis Plots}
Horn_Plot = function(horn, n_used, title) {
  obs = horn$original$variance
  perm = horn$permuted
  if (nrow(perm) != length(obs)) perm = t(perm)
  k = min(100, length(obs))
  D = tibble(PC = seq_len(k), Observed = obs[1:k],
             Median = apply(perm[1:k, , drop = FALSE], 1, median),
             Low = apply(perm[1:k, , drop = FALSE], 1, quantile, 0.05),
             High = apply(perm[1:k, , drop = FALSE], 1, quantile, 0.95)) %>%
    mutate(Retained = PC <= n_used)
  ggplot(D, aes(PC)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Low, ymax = High), fill = "grey80") +
    geom_line(aes(y = Median, linetype = "Permuted data (median, 5-95%)"), colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(aes(y = Observed), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Observed, fill = Retained), shape = 21, size = 1.3, stroke = 0.25) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = n_used + 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D43D4F") +
    annotate("text", x = n_used + 2, y = sqrt(max(D$Observed) * min(D$Observed)), hjust = 0, size = 3.2,
             colour = "#D43D4F", label = paste0(n_used, " PCs retained")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D43D4F", `FALSE` = "grey90"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Retained", `FALSE` = "Not retained"),
                      breaks = c("TRUE", "FALSE"), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Permuted data (median, 5-95%)" = "solid"), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Principal component", y = "Variance explained (%)", title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r General Functions}
do = function(de_obj, subset_name) {
  subset_DE_obj=subset(de_obj, idents=c(subset_name))
  table(Idents(subset_DE_obj))
  subset_DE_obj$celltype.osmotic= paste(subset_name,subset_DE_obj$Group, sep = "_")
  Idents(subset_DE_obj) = "celltype.osmotic"
  print(table(Idents(subset_DE_obj)))
  DefaultAssay(subset_DE_obj) ="RNA"
  subset_DE_obj= FindMarkers(subset_DE_obj, ident.1 = paste(subset_name,
                  "WD", sep = "_") , ident.2 = paste(subset_name,
                  "Control", sep = "_"), verbose = FALSE, only.pos = FALSE,
                  logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25, test.use = "MAST")
  return(subset_DE_obj)}

Expressed = function(seurat_obj, cluster_id) {
  cells_cluster = WhichCells(seurat_obj, ident = cluster_id)
  mat = GetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "data")[, cells_cluster]
  pct_express = Matrix::rowSums(mat > 0) / length(cells_cluster)
  genes_kept = names(pct_express[pct_express > 0])
  return(genes_kept)
}

hex = function(x) rgb(t(col2rgb(x)), maxColorValue = 255)

save_tiff = function(fname, expr) {
  tiff(fname, width = 12, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw")
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) message("Failed: ", fname, " - ", e$message),
           finally = dev.off())
}

Count_Mat = function(df, nodes, cross = FALSE) {
  M = matrix(0, length(nodes), length(nodes), dimnames = list(nodes, nodes))
  d = df %>% filter(source %in% nodes, target %in% nodes) %>% dplyr::count(source, target)
  M[cbind(d$source, d$target)] = d$n
  if (cross) M[outer(nodes %in% Top5, nodes %in% Top5, "==")] = 0
  M
}

Pseudobulk_WD = function(obj, min_cells = 10, min_animals = 3) {
  counts = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  meta = obj[[]] %>% transmute(Animal = orig.ident, Group, Cluster = as.character(Cluster))
  Key = paste(meta$Cluster, meta$Animal, sep = "__")
  PB = counts %*% Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + Key)
  colnames(PB) = sub("^Key", "", colnames(PB))
  Info = tibble(Sample = colnames(PB)) %>%
    separate(Sample, c("Cluster", "Animal"), sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(distinct(meta, Animal, Group), by = "Animal") %>%
    left_join(dplyr::count(meta, Cluster, Animal, name = "n_cells"), by = c("Cluster", "Animal"))
  Res = map_dfr(unique(Info$Cluster), function(ct) {
    s = Info %>% filter(Cluster == ct, n_cells >= min_cells)
    if (min(table(factor(s$Group, c("Control", "WD")))) < min_animals) return(NULL)
    Group = factor(s$Group, levels = c("Control", "WD"))
    y = DGEList(as.matrix(PB[, s$Sample]), group = Group)
    y = normLibSizes(y[filterByExpr(y, group = Group), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE])
    design = model.matrix(~ Group)
    fit = glmQLFit(estimateDisp(y, design), design)
    topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "GroupWD"), n = Inf)$table %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      transmute(gene, cell_type = ct, log2FC = logFC, logCPM, p_val = PValue, FDR,
                n_Control = sum(Group == "Control"), n_WD = sum(Group == "WD"))
  })
  list(Res = Res, Info = Info)
}

Add_PB = function(MAST, PB) {
  MAST %>% select(-any_of(c("log2FC_pseudobulk", "padj_pseudobulk"))) %>%
    left_join(PB %>% transmute(gene, cell_type, log2FC_pseudobulk = log2FC, padj_pseudobulk = FDR),
              by = c("gene", "cell_type"))
}

PB_Summary = function(MAST) {
  MAST %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25) %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    summarise(DEG_MAST = n(), Tested_PB = sum(!is.na(padj_pseudobulk)),
              Confirmed_PB = sum(padj_pseudobulk < 0.05 & sign(log2FC_pseudobulk) == sign(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
              Same_direction_PB = sum(sign(log2FC_pseudobulk) == sign(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Pct_confirmed = round(100 * Confirmed_PB / DEG_MAST, 1),
           Pct_same_direction = round(100 * Same_direction_PB / Tested_PB, 1))
}

Horn_Res_Plot = function(horn_file, param_file, n_pc) {
  horn = readRDS(horn_file)
  perm = horn$permuted
  if (nrow(perm) != length(horn$original$variance)) perm = t(perm)
  Hn = tibble(PC = 1:100, Observed = horn$original$variance[1:100],
              Median = apply(perm[1:100, ], 1, median), Low = apply(perm[1:100, ], 1, quantile, 0.05),
              High = apply(perm[1:100, ], 1, quantile, 0.95), Retained = PC <= n_pc)
  p_horn = ggplot(Hn, aes(PC)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Low, ymax = High), fill = "grey80") +
    geom_line(aes(y = Median), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Observed), linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Observed, fill = Retained), shape = 21, size = 0.7, stroke = 0.15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = n_pc + 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D43D4F", linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = n_pc + 3, y = max(Hn$Observed) * 0.5, label = paste(n_pc, "PCs"), hjust = 0, size = 2.2, colour = "#D43D4F") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D43D4F", `FALSE` = "grey90"), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Principal component", y = "Variance explained (%)", title = "Horn's parallel analysis") +
    Theme_small
  knee = function(x, y) which.max(1 - (x - min(x)) / diff(range(x)) - (y - min(y)) / diff(range(y)))
  m = read.xlsx(param_file) %>% arrange(Resolution)
  knee_WC = m$Resolution[knee(m$nClusters, m$WC_dispersion)]
  knee_BR = m$Resolution[knee(m$nClusters, m$BR)]
  ari_thr = 0.95
  stable = m$Resolution[!is.na(m$ARI_next) & m$ARI_next >= ari_thr]
  chosen = min(stable[stable >= min(knee_WC, knee_BR)])
  lvl = c("Within-cluster dispersion", "Banfeld-Raftery", "Mean silhouette", "ARI (res vs next res)")
  Res_long = m %>% select(Resolution, WC_dispersion, BR, Silhouette, ARI_next) %>% pivot_longer(-Resolution) %>%
    mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("WC_dispersion", "BR", "Silhouette", "ARI_next"), labels = lvl))
  Knees = Res_long %>% filter((name == lvl[1] & Resolution == knee_WC) | (name == lvl[2] & Resolution == knee_BR))
  p_res = ggplot(Res_long, aes(Resolution, value)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = min(stable), xmax = max(stable), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.12) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = Knees, colour = "red", size = 1.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = chosen, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(data = tibble(name = factor(lvl[4], levels = lvl), y = ari_thr), aes(yintercept = y),
               linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ name, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 1.5)) +
    labs(x = "Resolution", y = NULL,
         title = paste0("Clustering resolution (selected: ", chosen, ", ", m$nClusters[m$Resolution == chosen], " clusters)")) +
    Theme_small
  list(plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_horn, p_res, widths = c(1, 3.4)), chosen = chosen)
}

SoftPower_Plot = function(pt, power) {
  pt = pt %>% mutate(Chosen = Power == power)
  p1 = ggplot(pt, aes(Power, SFT.R.sq)) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Chosen), size = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = filter(pt, Chosen), aes(label = Power), colour = "#D43D4F", vjust = -0.9, size = 2.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D43D4F", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Soft-thresholding power", y = expression("Scale-free fit (signed R"^2*")"), title = "Scale-free topology") +
    Theme_small
  p2 = ggplot(pt, aes(Power, mean.k.)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Chosen), size = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D43D4F", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Soft-thresholding power", y = "Mean connectivity", title = "Mean connectivity") +
    Theme_small
  patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1)
}

Umap3_Plot = function(obj, cluster_by, cluster_title, cluster_cols = NULL, animal_rows = 2, legend = TRUE) {
  Th = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
             legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
             legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  u1 = DimPlot(obj, group.by = "Group", cols = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F"), shuffle = TRUE, pt.size = 0.05) +
    labs(title = "Group") + Th + NoAxes() + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
  u2 = DimPlot(obj, group.by = cluster_by, cols = cluster_cols, shuffle = TRUE, pt.size = 0.05, label = TRUE,
               label.size = 2, repel = TRUE) +
    labs(title = cluster_title) + Th + NoAxes() + NoLegend()
  u3 = DimPlot(obj, group.by = "orig.ident", shuffle = TRUE, pt.size = 0.05) +
    labs(title = "Animal") + Th + NoAxes() +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = animal_rows, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(size = 2)))
  if (legend) return(patchwork::wrap_plots(u1, u2, u3, nrow = 1))
  Col1 = function(p) cowplot::get_legend(p + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 4),
                                                    legend.justification = "left") +
                                            guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2))))
  list(plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(u1 + NoLegend(), u2, u3 + NoLegend(), nrow = 1),
       legend = cowplot::plot_grid(Col1(u1), Col1(u3), ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(3, 10)))
}
```

## Proportion

```{r Proportion Test Functions}
library(speckle)
library(limma)

Prop_Test = function(md, Cols, Nums, file_xlsx, file_tiff, width, height) {
  md = md %>% mutate(Cluster = factor(as.character(Cluster), levels = Cols$Order))
  P = propeller(clusters = md$Cluster, sample = md$orig.ident, group = md$Group, transform = "logit")
  P = P %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Cluster") %>% arrange(match(Cluster, Cols$Order))
  Animal = md %>% count(Group, orig.ident, Cluster, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(orig.ident) %>% mutate(Pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Num = factor(Nums[match(Cluster, Cols$Order)], levels = Nums))
  Bars = Animal %>% group_by(Num, Group) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(Pct), sem = sd(Pct) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
  Star = P %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(Num = factor(Nums[match(Cluster, Cols$Order)], levels = Nums),
           Label = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***", FDR < 0.01 ~ "**", TRUE ~ "*")) %>%
    left_join(Animal %>% group_by(Num) %>% summarise(y = max(Pct) * 1.08), by = "Num")
  dodge = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  p = ggplot(Bars, aes(x = Num, y = mean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), position = dodge, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = Animal, aes(x = Num, y = Pct, group = Group), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 42),
               shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 0.9, stroke = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(data = Star, aes(x = as.numeric(Num) - 0.2, xend = as.numeric(Num) + 0.2, y = y, yend = y),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = Star, aes(x = as.numeric(Num), y = y, label = Label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4, vjust = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% of nuclei per animal") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 9), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
  ggsave(file_tiff, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
  write.xlsx(list(Propeller = P, Per_animal = Animal, Mean_SEM = Bars), file_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  P
}

UMAP_Total = function(obj, Cols, Nums, prefix) {
  set.seed(4301)
  n_real = table(obj$Group)[c("Control", "WD")]
  DimPlot(obj, group.by = "Group", shuffle = TRUE, cols = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F"), raster = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F"),
                        labels = paste0(names(n_real), " (n = ", format(n_real, big.mark = ","), ")")) +
    labs(title = NULL) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "Black", size = 12),
          axis.text  = element_text(colour = "Black", size = 8),
          legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(paste0(prefix, "_Group.tiff"), width = 5, height = 5.3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

  lv  = intersect(Cols$Order, levels(factor(obj$Cluster)))
  emb = as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, reduction = "umap")[, 1:2]); colnames(emb) = c("x", "y")
  emb$Cluster = as.character(obj$Cluster)
  Cent = emb %>% group_by(Cluster) %>% summarise(x = median(x), y = median(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Num = Nums[match(Cluster, Cols$Order)])
  DimPlot(obj, group.by = "Cluster", shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(Cols$Color, Cols$Order)) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = Cent, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Num), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                              fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 3.5, min.segment.length = Inf) +
    labs(title = NULL) +
    NoLegend() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "Black", size = 12),
          axis.text  = element_text(colour = "Black", size = 8))
  ggsave(paste0(prefix, "_Cluster.tiff"), width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
}

Prop_Stack = function(md, Cols, Nums, file, width = 2, height = 4.5, angle_x = 0) {
  D = md %>% transmute(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "WD")),
                       Cluster = factor(as.character(Cluster), levels = Cols$Order)) %>%
    count(Group, Cluster, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(Group) %>% mutate(Pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Label = ifelse(Pct >= 2, round(Pct), NA),
           Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = Cols$Order))
  p = ggplot(D, aes(x = Group, y = Pct, fill = Cluster)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Label, group = Cluster), colour = "black", position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(Cols$Color, Cols$Order)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% of nuclei") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", angle = angle_x,
                                     hjust = if (angle_x == 0) 0.5 else 1, vjust = if (angle_x == 0) 0.5 else 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11))
  ggsave(file, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
  D
}
```

## CellChat

```{r CellChat Functions}
ComparativeFunction  = function (object, measure = c("count", "weight"), 
    color.use = NULL, group = NULL, group.levels = NULL, group.facet = NULL, 
    group.facet.levels = NULL, n.row = 1, color.alpha = 1, legend.title = NULL, 
    width = 0.6, title.name = NULL, digits = 3, xlabel = NULL, 
    ylabel = NULL, remove.xtick = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE, 
    x.lab.rot = FALSE, angle.x = 45, vjust.x = NULL, hjust.x = 1, 
    size.text = 10) 
{
    measure = match.arg(measure)
    if (measure == "count") {
        df = as.data.frame(sapply(object@net, function(x) sum(x$count)))
        if (is.null(ylabel)) {
            ylabel = "Number of inferred interactions"
        }
    }
    else if (measure == "weight") {
        df = as.data.frame(sapply(object@net, function(x) sum(x$weight)))
        df[, 1] = round(df[, 1], digits)
        if (is.null(ylabel)) {
            ylabel = "Interaction strength"
        }
    }
    colnames(df) = "count"
    df$dataset = names(object@net)
    if (is.null(group)) {
        group = 1
    }
    df$group = group
    df$dataset = factor(df$dataset, levels = names(object@net))
    if (is.null(group.levels)) {
        df$group = factor(df$group)
    }
    else {
        df$group = factor(df$group, levels = group.levels)
    }
    if (is.null(color.use)) {
        color.use = ggPalette(length(unique(group)))
    }
    if (!is.null(group.facet)) {
        if (all(group.facet %in% colnames(df))) {
            gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
                geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                  position = position_dodge())
            gg = gg + facet_wrap(group.facet, nrow = n.row)
        }
        else {
            df$group.facet = group.facet
            if (is.null(group.facet.levels)) {
                df$group.facet = factor(df$group.facet)
            }
            else {
                df$group.facet = factor(df$group.facet, levels = group.facet.levels)
            }
            gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
                geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                  position = position_dodge())
            gg = gg + facet_wrap(~group.facet, nrow = n.row)
            gg = gg + theme(text = element_text(size=20)) +
          geom_text(aes(label = count),
          size = 4.5, hjust = 0.5 ,angle = 0, 
          vjust= -0.5, position = position_dodge(width = .9), 
          colour = "Black",# fontface = "bold"
          )
        }
    }
    else {
        gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
            geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                position = position_dodge())
    }
    gg = gg + ylab(ylabel) + xlab(xlabel) + theme_classic() + 
        labs(title = title.name) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, 
        face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) + theme(text = element_text(size = size.text), 
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
    gg = gg + scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(color.use, alpha = color.alpha), 
        drop = FALSE)
    if (remove.xtick) {
        gg = gg + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    }
    if (is.null(legend.title)) {
        gg = gg + theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    }
    else {
        gg = gg + guides(fill = guide_legend(legend.title))
    }
    if (!show.legend) {
        gg = gg + theme(legend.position = "none")
    }
    if (x.lab.rot) {
        gg = gg + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = angle.x, 
            hjust = hjust.x, vjust = vjust.x, size = size.text))
    }
    gg
    return(gg)
}

netVisual_diffInteraction_New = function (object, comparison = c(1, 2), measure = c("count", 
    "weight", "count.merged", "weight.merged"), color.use = NULL, 
    color.edge = c("#b2182b", "#2166ac"), title.name = NULL, 
    sources.use = NULL, targets.use = NULL, remove.isolate = FALSE, 
    top = 1, weight.scale = FALSE, vertex.weight = 20, vertex.weight.max = NULL, 
    vertex.size.max = 15, vertex.label.cex = 0.0000001, vertex.label.color = "White", 
    edge.weight.max = NULL, edge.width.max = 8, alpha.edge = 0.6, 
    label.edge = FALSE, edge.label.color = "black", edge.label.cex = 0.8, 
    edge.curved = 0.2, shape = "circle", layout = in_circle(), 
    margin = 0.2, arrow.width = 1, arrow.size = 0.2) 
{
    options(warn = -1)
    measure = match.arg(measure)
    obj1 = object@net[[comparison[1]]][[measure]]
    obj2 = object@net[[comparison[2]]][[measure]]
    net.diff = obj2 - obj1
    if (measure %in% c("count", "count.merged")) {
        if (is.null(title.name)) {
            title.name = "Differential number of interactions"
        }
    }
    else if (measure %in% c("weight", "weight.merged")) {
        if (is.null(title.name)) {
            title.name = "Differential interaction strength"
        }
    }
    net = net.diff
    if ((!is.null(sources.use)) | (!is.null(targets.use))) {
        df.net = reshape2::melt(net, value.name = "value")
        colnames(df.net)[1:2] = c("source", "target")
        if (!is.null(sources.use)) {
            if (is.numeric(sources.use)) {
                sources.use = rownames(net.diff)[sources.use]
            }
            df.net = subset(df.net, source %in% sources.use)
        }
        if (!is.null(targets.use)) {
            if (is.numeric(targets.use)) {
                targets.use = rownames(net.diff)[targets.use]
            }
            df.net = subset(df.net, target %in% targets.use)
        }
        cells.level = rownames(net.diff)
        df.net$source = factor(df.net$source, levels = cells.level)
        df.net$target = factor(df.net$target, levels = cells.level)
        df.net$value[is.na(df.net$value)] = 0
        net = tapply(df.net[["value"]], list(df.net[["source"]], 
            df.net[["target"]]), sum)
        net[is.na(net)] = 0
    }
    if (remove.isolate) {
        idx1 = which(Matrix::rowSums(net) == 0)
        idx2 = which(Matrix::colSums(net) == 0)
        idx = intersect(idx1, idx2)
        net = net[-idx, ]
        net = net[, -idx]
    }
    net[abs(net) < stats::quantile(abs(net), probs = 1 - top)] = 0
    g = graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net, mode = "directed", 
        weighted = T)
    edge.start = igraph::ends(g, es = igraph::E(g), names = FALSE)
    coords = layout_(g, layout)
    if (nrow(coords) != 1) {
        coords_scale = scale(coords)
    }
    else {
        coords_scale = coords
    }
    if (is.null(color.use)) {
        color.use = scPalette(length(igraph::V(g)))
    }
    if (is.null(vertex.weight.max)) {
        vertex.weight.max = max(vertex.weight)
    }
    vertex.weight = vertex.weight/vertex.weight.max * vertex.size.max + 
        5
    loop.angle = ifelse(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1] > 0, -atan(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 
        2]/coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1]), pi - atan(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 
        2]/coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1]))
    igraph::V(g)$size = vertex.weight
    igraph::V(g)$color = color.use[igraph::V(g)]
    igraph::V(g)$frame.color = color.use[igraph::V(g)]
    igraph::V(g)$label.color = vertex.label.color
    igraph::V(g)$label.cex = vertex.label.cex
    if (label.edge) {
        igraph::E(g)$label = igraph::E(g)$weight
        igraph::E(g)$label = round(igraph::E(g)$label, digits = 1)
    }
    igraph::E(g)$arrow.width = arrow.width
    igraph::E(g)$arrow.size = arrow.size
    igraph::E(g)$label.color = edge.label.color
    igraph::E(g)$label.cex = edge.label.cex
    igraph::E(g)$color = ifelse(igraph::E(g)$weight > 0, color.edge[1], 
        color.edge[2])
    igraph::E(g)$color = grDevices::adjustcolor(igraph::E(g)$color, 
        alpha.edge)
    igraph::E(g)$weight = abs(igraph::E(g)$weight)
    if (is.null(edge.weight.max)) {
        edge.weight.max = max(igraph::E(g)$weight)
    }
    if (weight.scale == TRUE) {
        igraph::E(g)$width = 0.3 + igraph::E(g)$weight/edge.weight.max * 
            edge.width.max
    }
    else {
        igraph::E(g)$width = 0.3 + edge.width.max * igraph::E(g)$weight
    }
    igraph::E(g)$loop.angle = 0
    if (sum(edge.start[, 2] == edge.start[, 1]) != 0) {
        igraph::E(g)$loop.angle[which(edge.start[, 2] == edge.start[,
            1])] = loop.angle[edge.start[which(edge.start[,
            2] == edge.start[, 1]), 1]]
    }
    radian.rescale = function(x, start = 0, direction = 1) {
        c.rotate = function(x) (x + start)%%(2 * pi) * direction
        c.rotate(scales::rescale(x, c(0, 2 * pi), range(x)))
    }
    label.locs = radian.rescale(x = 1:length(igraph::V(g)),
        direction = -1, start = 0)
    label.dist = vertex.weight/max(vertex.weight) + 2
    plot(g, edge.curved = edge.curved, vertex.shape = shape,
        layout = coords_scale, margin = margin, vertex.label.dist = label.dist,
        vertex.label.degree = label.locs, vertex.label.family = "Helvetica",
        edge.label.family = "Helvetica")
    if (!is.null(title.name)) {
        text(0, 1.5, title.name, cex = 1.1)
    }
    gg = recordPlot()
    return(gg)
}

netVisual_circleNew = function (net, color.use = NULL, title.name = NULL, sources.use = NULL, 
    targets.use = NULL, idents.use = NULL, remove.isolate = FALSE, 
    top = 1, weight.scale = FALSE, vertex.weight = 20, vertex.weight.max = NULL, 
    vertex.size.max = NULL, vertex.label.cex = 0.0000000001, vertex.label.color = "White", 
    edge.weight.max = NULL, edge.width.max = 8, alpha.edge = 0.6, 
    label.edge = FALSE, edge.label.color = "black", edge.label.cex = 0.8, 
    edge.curved = 0.2, shape = "circle", layout = in_circle(), 
    margin = 0.2, vertex.size = NULL, arrow.width = 1, arrow.size = 0.2) 
{
    if (!is.null(vertex.size)) {
        warning("'vertex.size' is deprecated. Use `vertex.weight`")
    }
    if (is.null(vertex.size.max)) {
        if (length(unique(vertex.weight)) == 1) {
            vertex.size.max = 5
        }
        else {
            vertex.size.max = 15
        }
    }
    options(warn = -1)
    thresh = stats::quantile(net, probs = 1 - top)
    net[net < thresh] = 0
    if ((!is.null(sources.use)) | (!is.null(targets.use)) | (!is.null(idents.use))) {
        if (is.null(rownames(net))) {
            stop("The input weighted matrix should have rownames!")
        }
        cells.level = rownames(net)
        df.net = reshape2::melt(net, value.name = "value")
        colnames(df.net)[1:2] = c("source", "target")
        if (!is.null(sources.use)) {
            if (is.numeric(sources.use)) {
                sources.use = cells.level[sources.use]
            }
            df.net = subset(df.net, source %in% sources.use)
        }
        if (!is.null(targets.use)) {
            if (is.numeric(targets.use)) {
                targets.use = cells.level[targets.use]
            }
            df.net = subset(df.net, target %in% targets.use)
        }
        if (!is.null(idents.use)) {
            if (is.numeric(idents.use)) {
                idents.use = cells.level[idents.use]
            }
            df.net = filter(df.net, (source %in% idents.use) | 
                (target %in% idents.use))
        }
        df.net$source = factor(df.net$source, levels = cells.level)
        df.net$target = factor(df.net$target, levels = cells.level)
        df.net$value[is.na(df.net$value)] = 0
        net = tapply(df.net[["value"]], list(df.net[["source"]], 
            df.net[["target"]]), sum)
    }
    net[is.na(net)] = 0
    if (remove.isolate) {
        idx1 = which(Matrix::rowSums(net) == 0)
        idx2 = which(Matrix::colSums(net) == 0)
        idx = intersect(idx1, idx2)
        net = net[-idx, ]
        net = net[, -idx]
    }
    g = graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net, mode = "directed", 
        weighted = T)
    edge.start = igraph::ends(g, es = igraph::E(g), names = FALSE)
    coords = layout_(g, layout)
    if (nrow(coords) != 1) {
        coords_scale = scale(coords)
    }
    else {
        coords_scale = coords
    }
    if (is.null(color.use)) {
        color.use = scPalette(length(igraph::V(g)))
    }
    if (is.null(vertex.weight.max)) {
        vertex.weight.max = max(vertex.weight)
    }
    vertex.weight = vertex.weight/vertex.weight.max * vertex.size.max + 
        5
    loop.angle = ifelse(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1] > 0, -atan(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 
        2]/coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1]), pi - atan(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 
        2]/coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1]))
    igraph::V(g)$size = vertex.weight
    igraph::V(g)$color = color.use[igraph::V(g)]
    igraph::V(g)$frame.color = color.use[igraph::V(g)]
    igraph::V(g)$label.color = vertex.label.color
    igraph::V(g)$label.cex = vertex.label.cex
    if (label.edge) {
        igraph::E(g)$label = igraph::E(g)$weight
        igraph::E(g)$label = round(igraph::E(g)$label, digits = 1)
    }
    if (is.null(edge.weight.max)) {
        edge.weight.max = max(igraph::E(g)$weight)
    }
    if (weight.scale == TRUE) {
        igraph::E(g)$width = 0.3 + igraph::E(g)$weight/edge.weight.max * 
            edge.width.max
    }
    else {
        igraph::E(g)$width = 0.3 + edge.width.max * igraph::E(g)$weight
    }
    igraph::E(g)$arrow.width = arrow.width
    igraph::E(g)$arrow.size = arrow.size
    igraph::E(g)$label.color = edge.label.color
    igraph::E(g)$label.cex = edge.label.cex
    igraph::E(g)$color = grDevices::adjustcolor(igraph::V(g)$color[edge.start[, 
        1]], alpha.edge)
    igraph::E(g)$loop.angle = 0
    if (sum(edge.start[, 2] == edge.start[, 1]) != 0) {
        igraph::E(g)$loop.angle[which(edge.start[, 2] == edge.start[,
            1])] = loop.angle[edge.start[which(edge.start[,
            2] == edge.start[, 1]), 1]]
    }
    radian.rescale = function(x, start = 0, direction = 1) {
        c.rotate = function(x) (x + start)%%(2 * pi) * direction
        c.rotate(scales::rescale(x, c(0, 2 * pi), range(x)))
    }
    label.locs = radian.rescale(x = 1:length(igraph::V(g)),
        direction = -1, start = 0)
    label.dist = vertex.weight/max(vertex.weight) + 2
    plot(g, edge.curved = edge.curved, vertex.shape = shape,
        layout = coords_scale, margin = margin, vertex.label.dist = label.dist,
        vertex.label.degree = label.locs, vertex.label.family = "Helvetica",
        edge.label.family = "Helvetica")
    if (!is.null(title.name)) {
        text(0, 1.5, title.name, cex = 1.1)
    }
    gg = recordPlot()
    return(gg)
}

ComparativeFunction  = function (object, measure = c("count", "weight"), 
    color.use = NULL, group = NULL, group.levels = NULL, group.facet = NULL, 
    group.facet.levels = NULL, n.row = 1, color.alpha = 1, legend.title = NULL, 
    width = 0.6, title.name = NULL, digits = 3, xlabel = NULL, 
    ylabel = NULL, remove.xtick = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE, 
    x.lab.rot = FALSE, angle.x = 45, vjust.x = NULL, hjust.x = 1, 
    size.text = 10) 
{
    measure = match.arg(measure)
    if (measure == "count") {
        df = as.data.frame(sapply(object@net, function(x) sum(x$count)))
        if (is.null(ylabel)) {
            ylabel = "Number of inferred interactions"
        }
    }
    else if (measure == "weight") {
        df = as.data.frame(sapply(object@net, function(x) sum(x$weight)))
        df[, 1] = round(df[, 1], digits)
        if (is.null(ylabel)) {
            ylabel = "Interaction strength"
        }
    }
    colnames(df) = "count"
    df$dataset = names(object@net)
    if (is.null(group)) {
        group = 1
    }
    df$group = group
    df$dataset = factor(df$dataset, levels = names(object@net))
    if (is.null(group.levels)) {
        df$group = factor(df$group)
    }
    else {
        df$group = factor(df$group, levels = group.levels)
    }
    if (is.null(color.use)) {
        color.use = ggPalette(length(unique(group)))
    }
    if (!is.null(group.facet)) {
        if (all(group.facet %in% colnames(df))) {
            gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
                geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                  position = position_dodge())
            gg = gg + facet_wrap(group.facet, nrow = n.row)
        }
        else {
            df$group.facet = group.facet
            if (is.null(group.facet.levels)) {
                df$group.facet = factor(df$group.facet)
            }
            else {
                df$group.facet = factor(df$group.facet, levels = group.facet.levels)
            }
            gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
                geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                  position = position_dodge())
            gg = gg + facet_wrap(~group.facet, nrow = n.row)
            gg = gg + theme(text = element_text(size=20)) +
          geom_text(aes(label = count),
          size = 4.5, hjust = 0.5 ,angle = 0, 
          vjust= -0.5, position = position_dodge(width = .9), 
          colour = "Black",# fontface = "bold"
          )
        }
    }
    else {
        gg = ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = group)) + 
            geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = width, 
                position = position_dodge())
    }
    gg = gg + ylab(ylabel) + xlab(xlabel) + theme_classic() + 
        labs(title = title.name) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, 
        face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) + theme(text = element_text(size = size.text), 
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
    gg = gg + scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(color.use, alpha = color.alpha), 
        drop = FALSE)
    if (remove.xtick) {
        gg = gg + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    }
    if (is.null(legend.title)) {
        gg = gg + theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    }
    else {
        gg = gg + guides(fill = guide_legend(legend.title))
    }
    if (!show.legend) {
        gg = gg + theme(legend.position = "none")
    }
    if (x.lab.rot) {
        gg = gg + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = angle.x, 
            hjust = hjust.x, vjust = vjust.x, size = size.text))
    }
    gg
    return(gg)
}

netVisual_New = function (object, signaling, signaling.name = NULL, color.use = NULL, 
    vertex.receiver = NULL, sources.use = NULL, targets.use = NULL, 
    top = 1, remove.isolate = FALSE, vertex.weight = 1, vertex.weight.max = NULL, 
    vertex.size.max = NULL, weight.scale = TRUE, edge.weight.max.individual = NULL, 
    edge.weight.max.aggregate = NULL, edge.width.max = 8, layout = c("circle", 
        "hierarchy", "chord", "spatial"), height = 5, thresh = 0.05, 
    pt.title = 12, title.space = 6, vertex.label.cex = 0.000000000000001, from = NULL, 
    to = NULL, bidirection = NULL, vertex.size = NULL, out.format = c("svg", 
        "png"), alpha.image = 0.15, point.size = 1.5, group = NULL, 
    cell.order = NULL, small.gap = 1, big.gap = 10, scale = FALSE, 
    reduce = -1, show.legend = FALSE, legend.pos.x = 20, legend.pos.y = 20, 
    nCol = NULL, ...) 
{
    layout = match.arg(layout)
    if (!is.null(vertex.size)) {
        warning("'vertex.size' is deprecated. Use `vertex.weight`")
    }
    if (is.null(vertex.weight)) {
        vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(object@idents))
    }
    if (is.null(vertex.size.max)) {
        if (length(unique(vertex.weight)) == 1) {
            vertex.size.max = 5
        }
        else {
            vertex.size.max = 15
        }
    }
    pairLR = searchPair(signaling = signaling, pairLR.use = object@LR$LRsig, 
        key = "pathway_name", matching.exact = T, pair.only = F)
    if (is.null(signaling.name)) {
        signaling.name = signaling
    }
    net = object@net
    pairLR.use.name = dimnames(net$prob)[[3]]
    pairLR.name = intersect(rownames(pairLR), pairLR.use.name)
    pairLR = pairLR[pairLR.name, ]
    prob = net$prob
    pval = net$pval
    prob[pval > thresh] = 0
    if (length(pairLR.name) > 1) {
        pairLR.name.use = pairLR.name[apply(prob[, , pairLR.name], 
            3, sum) != 0]
    }
    else {
        pairLR.name.use = pairLR.name[sum(prob[, , pairLR.name]) != 
            0]
    }
    if (length(pairLR.name.use) == 0) {
        stop(paste0("There is no significant communication of ", 
            signaling.name))
    }
    else {
        pairLR = pairLR[pairLR.name.use, ]
    }
    nRow = length(pairLR.name.use)
    prob = prob[, , pairLR.name.use]
    pval = pval[, , pairLR.name.use]
    if (is.null(nCol)) {
        nCol = min(length(pairLR.name.use), 2)
    }
    if (length(dim(prob)) == 2) {
        prob = replicate(1, prob, simplify = "array")
        pval = replicate(1, pval, simplify = "array")
    }
    if (is.null(edge.weight.max.individual)) {
        edge.weight.max.individual = max(prob)
    }
    prob.sum = apply(prob, c(1, 2), sum)
    if (is.null(edge.weight.max.aggregate)) {
        edge.weight.max.aggregate = max(prob.sum)
    }
    if (layout == "hierarchy") {
        if (is.element("svg", out.format)) {
            svglite::svglite(file = paste0(signaling.name, "_hierarchy_individual.svg"), 
                width = 8, height = nRow * height)
            par(mfrow = c(nRow, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
            for (i in 1:length(pairLR.name.use)) {
                signalName_i = pairLR$interaction_name_2[i]
                prob.i = prob[, , i]
                netVisual_hierarchy1(prob.i, vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver, 
                  sources.use = sources.use, targets.use = targets.use, 
                  remove.isolate = remove.isolate, top = top, 
                  color.use = color.use, vertex.weight = vertex.weight, 
                  vertex.weight.max = vertex.weight.max, vertex.size.max = vertex.size.max, 
                  weight.scale = weight.scale, edge.weight.max = edge.weight.max.individual, 
                  edge.width.max = edge.width.max, title.name = signalName_i, 
                  vertex.label.cex = vertex.label.cex, ...)
                netVisual_hierarchy2(prob.i, vertex.receiver = setdiff(1:nrow(prob.i), 
                  vertex.receiver), sources.use = sources.use, 
                  targets.use = targets.use, remove.isolate = remove.isolate, 
                  top = top, color.use = color.use, vertex.weight = vertex.weight, 
                  vertex.weight.max = vertex.weight.max, vertex.size.max = vertex.size.max, 
                  weight.scale = weight.scale, edge.weight.max = edge.weight.max.individual, 
                  edge.width.max = edge.width.max, title.name = signalName_i, 
                  vertex.label.cex = vertex.label.cex, ...)
            }
            dev.off()
        }
        if (is.element("png", out.format)) {
            grDevices::png(paste0(signaling.name, "_hierarchy_individual.png"), 
                width = 8, height = nRow * height, units = "in", 
                res = 300)
            par(mfrow = c(nRow, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
            for (i in 1:length(pairLR.name.use)) {
                signalName_i = pairLR$interaction_name_2[i]
                prob.i = prob[, , i]
                netVisual_hierarchy1(prob.i, vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver, 
                  sources.use = sources.use, targets.use = targets.use, 
                  remove.isolate = remove.isolate, top = top, 
                  color.use = color.use, vertex.weight = vertex.weight, 
                  vertex.weight.max = vertex.weight.max, vertex.size.max = vertex.size.max, 
                  weight.scale = weight.scale, edge.weight.max = edge.weight.max.individual, 
                  edge.width.max = edge.width.max, title.name = signalName_i, 
                  vertex.label.cex = vertex.label.cex, ...)
                netVisual_hierarchy2(prob.i, vertex.receiver = setdiff(1:nrow(prob.i), 
                  vertex.receiver), sources.use = sources.use, 
                  targets.use = targets.use, remove.isolate = remove.isolate, 
                  top = top, color.use = color.use, vertex.weight = vertex.weight, 
                  vertex.weight.max = vertex.weight.max, vertex.size.max = vertex.size.max, 
                  weight.scale = weight.scale, edge.weight.max = edge.weight.max.individual, 
                  edge.width.max = edge.width.max, title.name = signalName_i, 
                  vertex.label.cex = vertex.label.cex, ...)
            }
            dev.off()
        }
        if (is.element("pdf", out.format)) {
            grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(signaling.name, "_hierarchy_individual.pdf"), 
                width = 8, height = nRow * height)
            par(mfrow = c(nRow, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
            for (i in 1:length(pairLR.name.use)) {
                signalName_i = pairLR$interaction_name_2[i]
                prob.i = prob[, , i]
                netVisual_hierarchy1(prob.i, vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver,
```

## Trajectory

```{r Trajectory Functions}
library(monocle3)
library(igraph)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(openxlsx)
library(patchwork)

Trajectory_Graph = function(obj, Types) {
  cds = new_cell_data_set(Matrix::Matrix(1, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(obj), sparse = TRUE,
                                         dimnames = list("dummy", colnames(obj))),
                          cell_metadata = obj[[]][, c("orig.ident", "Group", "Cluster")],
                          gene_metadata = data.frame(gene_short_name = "dummy", row.names = "dummy"))
  reducedDims(cds)$UMAP = Embeddings(obj, "umap")
  cds = cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP", random_seed = 4301)
  cds = learn_graph(cds, use_partition = TRUE, close_loop = FALSE,
                    learn_graph_control = list(rann.k = 25, ncenter = 600, minimal_branch_len = 30))
  g  = principal_graph(cds)$UMAP
  PG = t(cds@principal_graph_aux$UMAP$dp_mst)
  deg = igraph::degree(g)
  Key = names(deg)[deg != 2]
  Key = Key[order(PG[Key, 1], PG[Key, 2])]
  Letters_all = c(LETTERS, paste0(rep(LETTERS, each = 26), LETTERS))
  Nodes = tibble(Node = Key, Letter = Letters_all[seq_along(Key)], Type = ifelse(deg[Key] == 1, "Leaf", "Branch"),
                 x = PG[Key, 1], y = PG[Key, 2])
  Proj = cds@principal_graph_aux$UMAP$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  Cell_vertex = rownames(PG)[Proj[colnames(cds), 1]]
  Inner = delete_vertices(g, Key)
  Comp  = components(Inner)$membership
  Seg = map_dfr(unique(Comp), function(k) {
    v = names(Comp)[Comp == k]
    ends = unique(unlist(lapply(v, function(x) intersect(names(neighbors(g, x)), Key))))
    tibble(Segment = paste(sort(Nodes$Letter[match(ends, Nodes$Node)]), collapse = "-"), Vertex = v)
  })
  Cells = tibble(Cell = colnames(cds), Vertex = Cell_vertex,
                 Cluster = as.character(colData(cds)$Cluster), Group = colData(cds)$Group,
                 Animal = colData(cds)$orig.ident, Partition = as.character(partitions(cds)[colnames(cds)])) %>%
    left_join(Seg, by = "Vertex") %>%
    mutate(Segment = ifelse(is.na(Segment), Nodes$Letter[match(Vertex, Nodes$Node)], Segment))
  Composition = Cells %>% count(Segment, Cluster) %>% group_by(Segment) %>%
    mutate(Nuclei = sum(n), Pct = 100 * n / Nuclei) %>% ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Segment, dplyr::desc(Pct))
  Edges = as_edgelist(g)
  Edges = tibble(x = PG[Edges[, 1], 1], y = PG[Edges[, 1], 2], xend = PG[Edges[, 2], 1], yend = PG[Edges[, 2], 2])
  list(cds = cds, Nodes = Nodes, Cells = Cells, Composition = Composition, Edges = Edges)
}

Plot_Trajectory = function(Tr, emb, color_by, cols, file, width = 5, height = 5, breaks = names(cols)) {
  D = tibble(Cell = rownames(emb), x = emb[, 1], y = emb[, 2]) %>%
    left_join(Tr$Cells %>% select(Cell, all_of(color_by)), by = "Cell")
  p = ggplot(D, aes(x, y)) +
    ggrastr::geom_point_rast(aes(colour = .data[[color_by]]), size = 0.15, raster.dpi = 400) +
    geom_segment(data = Tr$Edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(data = Tr$Nodes, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 4.5, fill = "white", colour = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = Tr$Nodes, aes(x, y, label = Letter), size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +

Top5_MCN = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2")
Lineages_MCN = list(AVP = list(Types = c("MCNs-Mixed 2", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Avp 1"), Root = "MCNs-Mixed 2", End = "MCNs-Avp 1",
                               Label = "Mixed 2 \u2192 Avp 2 \u2192 Avp 1"),

Non_official_T = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"

Lineage_Traj = function(obj, L, file_rds) {
  cds_all = new_cell_data_set(Matrix::Matrix(1, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(obj), sparse = TRUE,
                                             dimnames = list("dummy", colnames(obj))),
                              cell_metadata = data.frame(row.names = colnames(obj)),
                              gene_metadata = data.frame(gene_short_name = "dummy", row.names = "dummy"))
  reducedDims(cds_all)$UMAP = Embeddings(obj, "umap")
  cds_all = cluster_cells(cds_all, reduction_method = "UMAP", random_seed = 4301)
  Part = partitions(cds_all)
  isL = obj$Cluster %in% L$Types
  Main = names(which.max(table(Part[isL])))
  obj = obj[, isL & Part == Main]
  rm(cds_all); gc()
  counts = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  meta = obj[[]][, c("orig.ident", "Group", "Cluster", "nCount_RNA")]
  meta$Cluster = factor(as.character(meta$Cluster), levels = L$Types)
  umap = Embeddings(obj, "umap")
  cds = new_cell_data_set(counts, cell_metadata = meta,
                          gene_metadata = data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(counts), row.names = rownames(counts)))
  rm(counts); gc()
  cds = estimate_size_factors(cds)
  reducedDims(cds)$UMAP = umap[colnames(cds), ]; colnames(reducedDims(cds)$UMAP) = c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  cds = cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP", random_seed = 4301)
  cds = learn_graph(cds, use_partition = TRUE, close_loop = FALSE,
                    learn_graph_control = list(rann.k = 25, ncenter = min(600, floor(ncol(cds) / 5))))
  PG = t(cds@principal_graph_aux$UMAP$dp_mst)
  g = principal_graph(cds)$UMAP
  U = reducedDims(cds)$UMAP
  near = function(xy) rownames(PG)[which.min(rowSums(sweep(PG, 2, xy)^2))]
  End = near(colMeans(U[colData(cds)$Cluster == L$End, , drop = FALSE]))
  U2 = U[colData(cds)$Cluster == L$Root, , drop = FALSE]
  d2 = sqrt(rowSums(sweep(U2, 2, apply(U2, 2, median))^2))
  U2 = U2[d2 <= quantile(d2, 0.8), , drop = FALSE]
  box = apply(U2, 2, range)
  in_R = rownames(PG)[PG[, 1] >= box[1, 1] & PG[, 1] <= box[2, 1] & PG[, 2] >= box[1, 2] & PG[, 2] <= box[2, 2]]
  if (length(in_R) == 0) in_R = near(apply(U2, 2, median))
  dist_end = distances(g, v = in_R, to = End)[, 1]
  Root = names(which.max(dist_end[is.finite(dist_end)]))
  cds = order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = Root)
  reach = is.finite(pseudotime(cds))
  print(table(colData(cds)$Cluster, reach))
  cds = cds[, reach]
  colData(cds)$Pseudotime = pseudotime(cds)
  saveRDS(cds, file_rds)
  cds
}

Traj_Genes = function(cds) {
  expr_ok = rownames(cds)[Matrix::rowMeans(counts(cds) > 0) >= 0.05]
  graph_test(cds[expr_ok, ], neighbor_graph = "principal_graph", cores = 1) %>%
    filter(status == "OK") %>% arrange(q_value, desc(morans_I)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene = gene_short_name, morans_I, morans_test_statistic, p_value, q_value) %>%
    mutate(Heatmap = q_value < 0.05 & morans_I > 0.1 & !grepl(Non_official_T, gene))
}

  tibble(Cell = colnames(cds), Pseudotime = colData(cds)$Pseudotime, Cluster = colData(cds)$Cluster,
         Group = colData(cds)$Group, Animal = colData(cds)$orig.ident)
}

PT_Tests = function(D, types) {
  A = D %>% group_by(Cluster, Animal) %>% summarise(Median_PT = median(Pseudotime), Nuclei = n(), .groups = "drop")
  Tt = map_dfr(seq_len(length(types) - 1), function(i) {
    W = A %>% filter(Cluster %in% types[i:(i + 1)]) %>% select(Animal, Cluster, Median_PT) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = Median_PT) %>% na.omit()
    tt = t.test(W[[types[i + 1]]], W[[types[i]]], paired = TRUE)
    tibble(From = types[i], To = types[i + 1], n_animals = nrow(W), Median_from = median(W[[types[i]]]),
           Median_to = median(W[[types[i + 1]]]), t = unname(tt$statistic), p = tt$p.value)
  })
  list(Animal = A, Tests = Tt)
}

Lineage_Prop_Plots = function(L, base_size = 8) {
  GroupCols = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")
  f = paste0("Excel/Trajectory/Joint_", L, "_Control_vs_WD.xlsx")
  Test_bin = read.xlsx(f, "Per_bin"); Frac_bin = read.xlsx(f, "Per_animal_bin")
  Animal_med = read.xlsx(f, "Animal_median"); Med_t = read.xlsx(f, "Median_test")
  pt_max = max(read.xlsx(f, "Cells")$Pseudotime)
  nb = max(Frac_bin$Bin)
  Sum_bin = Frac_bin %>% group_by(Group, Bin) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(Frac), sem = sd(Frac) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Pseudotime = (Bin - 0.5) / nb * pt_max)
  Star_bin = Test_bin %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(Pseudotime = (Bin - 0.5) / nb * pt_max,
           Label = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***", FDR < 0.01 ~ "**", TRUE ~ "*"),
           y = max(Sum_bin$mean + Sum_bin$sem) * 1.05)
  prop = ggplot(Sum_bin, aes(Pseudotime, mean, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = Star_bin, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = y, label = Label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = GroupCols, name = NULL) + scale_fill_manual(values = GroupCols, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = paste0("Pseudotime (", Lineages_MCN[[L]]$Label, ")"), y = "% of nuclei per animal") +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), legend.position = "top",
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -6, 0), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
  Lab_m = case_when(Med_t$p < 0.001 ~ "***", Med_t$p < 0.01 ~ "**", Med_t$p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
  Bars_m = Animal_med %>% group_by(Group) %>% summarise(mean = mean(Median_PT), sem = sd(Median_PT) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
  yM = max(Animal_med$Median_PT) * 1.08
  med = ggplot(Bars_m, aes(x = Group, y = mean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(data = Animal_med, aes(x = Group, y = Median_PT), inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.12, height = 0,
                shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.1, stroke = 0.3, seed = 42) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = yM, yend = yM, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = yM, label = Lab_m, vjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GroupCols) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Median pseudotime per animal") +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), legend.position = "none")
  list(prop = prop, med = med, pt_max = pt_max)
}

Dyn_Compare = function(cds, genes, nb = 10, min_cells = 5) {
  pt = colData(cds)$Pseudotime
  Bin = cut(pt, breaks = seq(0, max(pt), length.out = nb + 1), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  key = paste(colData(cds)$orig.ident, Bin, sep = "__")
  ok_key = names(which(table(key) >= min_cells))
  keep = key %in% ok_key
  lex = log1p(as.matrix(normalized_counts(cds[genes, keep], norm_method = "size_only")))
  M = t(apply(lex, 1, function(x) tapply(x, key[keep], mean)))
  Info = tibble(key = colnames(M)) %>% separate(key, c("Animal", "Bin"), sep = "__", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(distinct(tibble(Animal = colData(cds)$orig.ident, Group = colData(cds)$Group)), by = "Animal") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "WD")))
  Res = map_dfr(rownames(M), function(gn) {
    d = Info %>% mutate(y = M[gn, key])
    f0 = lm(y ~ splines::ns(Bin, 3), data = d)
    f1 = lm(y ~ splines::ns(Bin, 3) + Group, data = d)
    f2 = lm(y ~ splines::ns(Bin, 3) * Group, data = d)
    tibble(gene = gn, Diff_WD = unname(coef(f1)["GroupWD"]),
           p_level = anova(f0, f1)$`Pr(>F)`[2], p_shape = anova(f1, f2)$`Pr(>F)`[2])
  }) %>% mutate(FDR_level = p.adjust(p_level, "BH"), FDR_shape = p.adjust(p_shape, "BH")) %>% arrange(FDR_shape, FDR_level)
  list(Res = Res, M = M, Info = Info)
}

Dyn_Heatmap = function(Dyn, genes, L, file, title, width = 6, height = 4, pt_max = NULL,
                       highlight = c("Giot1", "Caprin2")) {
  Mg = Dyn$M[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  Avg = map(c("Control", "WD"), function(G) {
    k = Dyn$Info$key[Dyn$Info$Group == G]
    b = Dyn$Info$Bin[Dyn$Info$Group == G]
    t(apply(Mg[, k, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) tapply(x, b, mean)))
  })
  bins = intersect(colnames(Avg[[1]]), colnames(Avg[[2]]))
  bins = bins[order(as.numeric(bins))]
  Both = cbind(Avg[[1]][, bins, drop = FALSE], Avg[[2]][, bins, drop = FALSE])
  Z = t(scale(t(Both))); Z[Z > 2.5] = 2.5; Z[Z < -2.5] = -2.5
  Z = Z[order(apply(Z[, seq_along(bins), drop = FALSE], 1, which.max)), , drop = FALSE]
  split = factor(rep(c("Control", "WD"), each = length(bins)), levels = c("Control", "WD"))
  nb = max(Dyn$Info$Bin)
  if (is.null(pt_max)) pt_max = nb
  Centers = rep((as.numeric(bins) - 0.5) / nb * pt_max, 2)
  hl = rownames(Z) %in% highlight
  bottom = HeatmapAnnotation(Pseudotime = Centers,
                             Value = anno_text(ifelse(seq_along(Centers) %% 2 == 1, sprintf("%.0f", Centers), ""),
                                               rot = 0, just = "center", location = 0.5, gp = gpar(fontsize = 5.5)),
                             col = list(Pseudotime = colorRamp2(seq(0, pt_max, length.out = 5), viridisLite::plasma(5))),
                             show_annotation_name = FALSE, simple_anno_size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                             annotation_legend_param = list(Pseudotime = list(title = "Pseudotime", title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
                                                                             labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                                                                             legend_height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
                                                                             grid_width = unit(0.25, "cm"))))
  ht = Heatmap(Z, name = "z-score", col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
               cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE,
               bottom_annotation = bottom,
               show_row_names = nrow(Z) <= 60,
               row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5.5, fontface = ifelse(hl, "bold.italic", "italic"),
                                   col = ifelse(hl, "#C0392B", "black")),
               column_split = split, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
               top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(Group = split, col = list(Group = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")),
                                                  show_annotation_name = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE,
                                                  simple_anno_size = unit(2, "mm")),
               row_title = paste0(nrow(Z), " genes"), row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
               heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                                           legend_height = unit(1.2, "cm"), grid_width = unit(0.25, "cm")))
  tiff(file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw")
  draw(ht, column_title = title, column_title_side = "bottom", merge_legend = TRUE,
       column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r hdWGCNA Functions}
NetworkPlot = function(obj, mod, TOM, n_inner = 10, n_outer = 15,
                       n_conns = 500, label.pt = 4.85, point.size = 1.6, highlight = NULL, hl.col = "#C0392B") {
  Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
  Mods = GetModules(obj)
  col = unique(Mods$color[Mods$module == mod])
  genes = GetHubGenes(obj, n_hubs = 200) %>% subset(module == mod & !grepl(Non_official, gene_name)) %>%
    slice_max(kME, n = n_inner + n_outer, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(gene_name)
  highlight = intersect(highlight, Mods$gene_name[Mods$module == mod])
  genes = c(genes, setdiff(highlight, genes))
  rTOM = TOM[genes, genes]
  rTOM[-order(rTOM, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_conns, length(rTOM)))]] = 0
  diag(rTOM) = 0
  rTOM = (rTOM - min(rTOM)) / (max(rTOM) - min(rTOM))
  lay = rbind(layout_in_circle(make_empty_graph(n_inner)) / 2,
              layout_in_circle(make_empty_graph(length(genes) - n_inner)))
  Nodes = tibble(gene = genes, x = lay[, 1], y = lay[, 2]) %>%
    mutate(Hl = gene %in% highlight, Fill = col, Size = point.size,
           Face = ifelse(Hl, "bold.italic", "italic"), Lab = ifelse(Hl, hl.col, "black"))
  idx = which(upper.tri(rTOM) & rTOM > 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  Edges = tibble(x = lay[idx[, 1], 1], y = lay[idx[, 1], 2], xend = lay[idx[, 2], 1], yend = lay[idx[, 2], 2],
                 w = rTOM[idx]) %>% arrange(w)
  p = ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = Edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, alpha = w),
                 colour = col, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = Nodes, aes(x, y, fill = Fill, size = Size), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = Nodes, aes(x, y, label = gene, fontface = Face, colour = Lab), size = label.pt / .pt,
                             bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, box.padding = 0.12, point.padding = 0.05,
                             min.segment.length = Inf, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
    scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() + scale_size_identity() +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.6), guide = "none") +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") + labs(title = Short(mod)) + theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6))
  p
}

DotModules = function(Overlap, mods, Types) {
  Plot = Overlap %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(Types$Order)),
           module = factor(module, levels = mods),
           logFDR = pmin(-log10(fdr), 50))
  p = ggplot(Plot, aes(x = module, y = group, size = size_intersection, fill = logFDR)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDD49E", high = "#B30000", limits = c(-log10(0.05), 50),
                        name = expression(-log[10]~FDR)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.6, 4.5), name = "Overlapping\ngenes") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = Short) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(Types$Order)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black", size = 7),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey85"),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  DotAxis(Types, black = identical(Types$Order, Types_SON$Order)) + p + plot_layout(widths = c(0.07, 1))
}

DotMerge = function(Overlap, hME_mean, mods, Types) {
  Plot = hME_mean %>% mutate(Cluster = as.character(Cluster)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Cluster, names_to = "module", values_to = "hME") %>%
    group_by(module) %>% mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(hME))) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(Overlap %>% transmute(module = as.character(module), Cluster = as.character(group),
                                    n = size_intersection, sig = fdr < 0.05), by = c("module", "Cluster")) %>%
    filter(Cluster %in% Types$Order) %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0), sig = replace_na(sig, FALSE),
           group = factor(Cluster, levels = rev(Types$Order)), module = factor(module, levels = mods))
  Lim = max(abs(Plot$z))
  p = ggplot(Plot, aes(x = module, y = group)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, !sig), aes(size = n, fill = z), shape = 21, colour = "grey60", stroke = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, sig), aes(size = n, fill = z), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B30000", limits = c(-Lim, Lim),
                         name = "Module activity\n(scaled hME)") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.3, 4.5), name = "Overlapping\nmarker genes") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = Short) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(Types$Order)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = "Black border: marker overlap FDR < 0.05") + theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black", size = 7),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey85"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  DotAxis(Types, black = identical(Types$Order, Types_SON$Order)) + p + plot_layout(widths = c(0.07, 1))
}

DotMerge_Vert = function(Overlap, hME_mean, mods, Types, show = NULL) {
  Sh = if (is.null(show)) Types$Order else show
  Plot = hME_mean %>% mutate(Cluster = as.character(Cluster)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Cluster, names_to = "module", values_to = "hME") %>%
    group_by(module) %>% mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(hME))) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(Overlap %>% transmute(module = as.character(module), Cluster = as.character(group),
                                    n = size_intersection, sig = fdr < 0.05), by = c("module", "Cluster")) %>%
    filter(Cluster %in% Types$Order) %>%
    filter(Cluster %in% Sh) %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0), sig = replace_na(sig, FALSE),
           group = factor(Cluster, levels = Sh),
           module = factor(module, levels = rev(mods[order(as.numeric(sub(".*M", "", mods)))])))
  Lim = max(abs(Plot$z))
  p = ggplot(Plot, aes(x = group, y = module)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, !sig), aes(size = n, fill = z), shape = 21, colour = "grey60", stroke = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, sig), aes(size = n, fill = z), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B30000", limits = c(-Lim, Lim),
                         name = "Module activity (scaled hME)",
                         guide = guide_colourbar(theme = theme(legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                                                               legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm")))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.45, 6), breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3), name = "Overlapping marker genes") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = Sh) + scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(Plot$module), labels = Short) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 7),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey85"),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "center",
          legend.title.position = "top", legend.title = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  D = Types %>% filter(Order %in% Sh) %>% mutate(id = factor(Order, levels = Sh),
                       Txt = if (identical(Types$Order, Types_SON$Order)) "black" else Txt_Col(Color))
  pX = ggplot(D, aes(x = id, y = 0)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, size = 4.5, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = Sh) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5), clip = "off") + theme_void()
  p / pX + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.05), guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "center")
}
```
