```{r hdWGCNA Functions}
DownsampleWD = function(counts, meta) {
  Ctrl.cells = rownames(meta)[meta$Group == "Control"]
  WD.cells = rownames(meta)[meta$Group == "WD"]
  Ctrl_med = tapply(meta[Ctrl.cells, "nCount_RNA"], meta[Ctrl.cells, "Cluster"], median)
  WD_med = tapply(meta[WD.cells, "nCount_RNA"], meta[WD.cells, "Cluster"], median)
  Prop = setNames(pmin(1, Ctrl_med / WD_med[names(Ctrl_med)]), names(Ctrl_med))
  set.seed(42)
  W = counts[, WD.cells]
  p.cell = Prop[meta[WD.cells, "Cluster"]]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(p.cell))
  W@x = as.numeric(rbinom(length(W@x), size = round(W@x), prob = p.cell[rep(seq_len(ncol(W)), diff(W@p))]))
  cbind(counts[, Ctrl.cells], Matrix::drop0(W))[, rownames(meta)]
}

WD_Cell = function(Scores, meta, groups, min_cells = 10) {
  map_dfr(groups, function(ct) {
    wd = meta$Cluster == ct & meta$Group == "WD"
    co = meta$Cluster == ct & meta$Group == "Control"
    sel = meta$Cluster == ct
    map_dfr(colnames(Scores), function(m) {
      A = tibble(Animal = meta$orig.ident[sel], Group = meta$Group[sel], s = Scores[sel, m]) %>%
        group_by(Animal, Group) %>% summarise(s = mean(s), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        filter(n >= min_cells)
      tibble(module = m, group = ct, n_WD = sum(wd), n_Control = sum(co),
             mean_WD = mean(Scores[wd, m]), mean_Control = mean(Scores[co, m]),
             p_val = tryCatch(wilcox.test(Scores[wd, m], Scores[co, m])$p.value, error = function(e) NA),
             n_animals_WD = sum(A$Group == "WD"), n_animals_Control = sum(A$Group == "Control"),
             p_animal = tryCatch(t.test(s ~ Group, data = A)$p.value, error = function(e) NA))
    })
  }) %>% mutate(avg_log2FC = log2((mean_WD + 1e-3) / (mean_Control + 1e-3)),
                FDR = p.adjust(p_val, "BH"), FDR_animal = p.adjust(p_animal, "BH"))
}

Fig_WD = function(RDS, net, Types, DEG_xlsx, Out, w_bar, w_dot, Depth_correct = TRUE, black_num = FALSE, show = NULL) {
  dir.create(Out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  Sh = if (is.null(show)) Types$Order else show
  obj = readRDS(RDS)
  Modules = GetModules(obj) %>% subset(module != "grey") %>% droplevels()
  mods = levels(Modules$module)
  meta = obj[[]][, c("orig.ident", "Group", "Cluster", "nCount_RNA")]
  meta$Cluster = as.character(meta$Cluster)
  counts = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  Hubs = GetHubGenes(obj, n_hubs = 25)
  Hubs = split(Hubs$gene_name, Hubs$module)[mods]
  rm(obj); gc()
  groups = intersect(Types$Order, unique(meta$Cluster))

  Sc_raw = UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(counts, features = Hubs, name = "")[rownames(meta), mods]
  Sc_DS = UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(DownsampleWD(counts, meta), features = Hubs, name = "")[rownames(meta), mods]
  rm(counts); gc()
  Raw = WD_Cell(Sc_raw, meta, groups)
  DS = WD_Cell(Sc_DS, meta, groups)
  Main = if (Depth_correct) DS else Raw
  Res = Main %>%
    left_join(Raw %>% select(module, group, avg_log2FC_raw = avg_log2FC, FDR_raw = FDR), by = c("module", "group")) %>%
    left_join(DS %>% select(module, group, avg_log2FC_DS = avg_log2FC, FDR_DS = FDR, FDR_animal_DS = FDR_animal),
              by = c("module", "group")) %>%
    mutate(Same_direction_raw_DS = sign(avg_log2FC_raw) == sign(avg_log2FC_DS),
           Direction = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, "Up in WD", "Down in WD"))

  Overlap = read.xlsx(paste0("Excel/Control_hdWGCNA_", net, "_Modules.xlsx"), "Overlap_Markers")
  hME = read.xlsx(paste0("Excel/Control_hdWGCNA_", net, "_Modules.xlsx"), "hME_Mean_CellType") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Cluster, names_to = "module", values_to = "hME_mean")
  Pairs = Overlap %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
    left_join(hME, by = c("module", "group" = "Cluster")) %>%
    filter(hME_mean > 0) %>% select(module, group)
  Res = Res %>% left_join(Pairs %>% mutate(Specific_pair = TRUE), by = c("module", "group")) %>%
    mutate(Specific_pair = !is.na(Specific_pair))

  Lim = round(quantile(abs(Res$avg_log2FC), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  Plot = Res %>% filter(group %in% Sh) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(Sh)),
           module = factor(module, levels = mods[order(as.numeric(sub(".*M", "", mods)))]),
           logFDR = -log10(FDR_animal),
           Sig = !is.na(FDR_animal) & FDR_animal < 0.05)
  pDot = ggplot(Plot, aes(x = module, y = group)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, !Sig), aes(size = logFDR, fill = avg_log2FC, colour = Sig), shape = 21, stroke = 0.25) +
    geom_point(data = filter(Plot, Sig), aes(size = logFDR, fill = avg_log2FC, colour = Sig), shape = 21, stroke = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#25838E", mid = "white", high = "#D43D4F", limits = c(-Lim, Lim),
                         oob = scales::squish, name = "log2FC\n(WD/Control)") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey85"), breaks = c("TRUE", "FALSE"),
                        labels = c("FDR < 0.05", "n.s."), name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, stroke = c(1, 0.25), fill = "white"))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.4, 4), limits = c(0, NA), name = "-log10 FDR\n(animals)") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(Plot$module), labels = Short) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(Sh)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black", size = 7),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey85"),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  ggsave(paste0(Out, "/B_DotPlot_Modules_WD_Cell.tiff"),
         DotAxis(Types %>% filter(Order %in% Sh), black = black_num) + pDot + plot_layout(widths = c(0.07, 1)),
         width = w_dot, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

  DEG = read.xlsx(DEG_xlsx) %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)
  Valid = Res %>% filter(Specific_pair, FDR_animal < 0.05)
  if (nrow(Valid) == 0) {
    message("No specific module x cell type pair with per-animal FDR < 0.05, skipping bar plot")
    write.xlsx(list(WD_Effect_Cell = Res, Specific_Pairs = Pairs), paste0("Excel/hdWGCNA_", net, "_WD.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
    return(Res)
  }
  Valid = Valid %>%
    mutate(module = factor(module, levels = mods), group = factor(group, levels = Types$Order)) %>%
    arrange(module, group) %>% mutate(module = as.character(module), group = as.character(group)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(n_genes = sum(Modules$module == module),
           Up = sum(DEG$cell_type == group & DEG$avg_log2FC > 0 & DEG$gene %in% Modules$gene_name[Modules$module == module]),
           Down = sum(DEG$cell_type == group & DEG$avg_log2FC < 0 & DEG$gene %in% Modules$gene_name[Modules$module == module]),
           Genes_Up = paste(intersect(Modules$gene_name[Modules$module == module],
                                      DEG$gene[DEG$cell_type == group & DEG$avg_log2FC > 0]), collapse = ", "),
           Genes_Down = paste(intersect(Modules$gene_name[Modules$module == module],
                                        DEG$gene[DEG$cell_type == group & DEG$avg_log2FC < 0]), collapse = ", "),
           p_binom = if (Up + Down > 0) binom.test(Up, Up + Down)$p.value else NA) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Concordant = ifelse(Direction == "Up in WD", Up > Down, Down > Up))

  write.xlsx(list(WD_Effect_Cell = Res, Specific_Pairs = Pairs, DEG_Validation = Valid),
             paste0("Excel/hdWGCNA_", net, "_WD.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  Res
}
```

```{r NeuroEstimator - Helpers WSL}
to_wsl = function(p) {
  p = normalizePath(p, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  paste0("/mnt/", tolower(substr(p, 1, 1)), substring(p, 3))
}

run_wsl = function(script, file) {
  con = file(file, "wb")
  writeLines(script, con, sep = "\n")
  close(con)
  system2("wsl", c("-d", "Ubuntu", "--", "bash", to_wsl(file)))
}

dir.create("NeuroEstimator", showWarnings = FALSE)
NE_DIR = to_wsl("NeuroEstimator")
```

```{r NeuroEstimator - Install}
install_sh = r"---(
set -eo pipefail

if [ ! -d ~/miniforge3 ]; then
  wget -q https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /tmp/mf.sh
  bash /tmp/mf.sh -b -p ~/miniforge3
fi
source ~/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh

if conda env list | grep -q "^neuroestimator "; then
  echo "neuroestimator env already exists, skipping."
else
  ~/miniforge3/bin/mamba create -y -n neuroestimator -c conda-forge -c defaults \
    python=3.7 \
    tensorflow=1.15.0 \
    tensorflow-estimator=1.15.1 \
    r-keras=2.3.0.0 \
    r-tensorflow=2.2.0 \
    h5py=2.10.0 \
    hdf5=1.10.6 \
    r-dplyr=1.0.9 \
    r-base \
    r-remotes \
    'r-reticulate<=1.24' \
    r-matrix \
    git
fi

conda activate neuroestimator
Rscript -e 'if (!requireNamespace("neuroestimator", quietly = TRUE)) remotes::install_git("https://research-git.uiowa.edu/michaelson-lab-public/neuroestimator", upgrade = "never")'
Rscript -e 'library(neuroestimator); reticulate::use_condaenv("neuroestimator", required = TRUE); data(neuroestimator_example_data); print(head(neuroestimator(neuroestimator_example_data$counts, species = "mmusculus")))'
)---"

run_wsl(install_sh, "NeuroEstimator/install.sh")
```

```{r NeuroEstimator - Export Counts}
library(Seurat)
```

```{r NeuroEstimator - Run}
run_R = sprintf(r"---(
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Matrix); library(neuroestimator)})
reticulate::use_condaenv("neuroestimator", required = TRUE)

dir = "%s"
counts = as(readMM(file.path(dir, "counts.mtx")), "CsparseMatrix")
rownames(counts) = readLines(file.path(dir, "genes.txt"))
colnames(counts) = readLines(file.path(dir, "barcodes.txt"))

res = neuroestimator(as.matrix(counts), species = "rnorvegicus")
res$Cell = rownames(res)
write.csv(res, file.path(dir, "NeuroEstimator_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
)---", NE_DIR)

con = file("NeuroEstimator/run.R", "wb"); writeLines(run_R, con, sep = "\n"); close(con)

run_sh = sprintf(r"---(
set -eo pipefail
source ~/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate neuroestimator
Rscript %s/run.R 2>&1 | tee %s/run.log
)---", NE_DIR, NE_DIR)

run_wsl(run_sh, "NeuroEstimator/run.sh")
```

## hdWGCNA

```{r hdWGCNA SON - Run}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(patchwork)
library(WGCNA)
library(hdWGCNA)
theme_set(cowplot::theme_cowplot())
set.seed(4301)
disableWGCNAThreads()  

dir.create("Figures/Fig 1/hdWGCNA", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("RDS/TOM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")
Son[["RNA"]]$scale.data = NULL; gc()
Son = SetupForWGCNA(Son, gene_select = "fraction", fraction = 0.05,
                    group.by = "Cluster", wgcna_name = "SON")   # 12165 genes
Son = MetacellsByGroups(Son, group.by = c("Cluster", "orig.ident"), ident.group = "Cluster",
                        reduction = "rpca", k = 20, max_shared = 10, min_cells = 50,
                        target_metacells = 200) 
Son = NormalizeMetacells(Son)
table(GetMetacellObject(Son)$Cluster)
Son = SetDatExpr(Son, group_name = unique(as.character(GetMetacellObject(Son)$Cluster)),
                 group.by = "Cluster", assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
Son = TestSoftPowers(Son, networkType = "signed")
tiff("Figures/Fig 1/hdWGCNA/TestSoftPowers.tiff", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw")
print(wrap_plots(PlotSoftPowers(Son), ncol = 2))
dev.off()
saveRDS(Son, "RDS/hdWGCNA_SON.rds")

Son = ConstructNetwork(Son, tom_name = "SON", tom_outdir = "RDS/TOM", overwrite_tom = TRUE)
saveRDS(Son, "RDS/hdWGCNA_SON.rds")

Son = ScaleData(Son, features = VariableFeatures(Son))   
Son = ModuleEigengenes(Son, group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
Son[["RNA"]]$scale.data = NULL; gc()
saveRDS(Son, "RDS/hdWGCNA_SON.rds")

Son = ModuleConnectivity(Son, group.by = "Cluster", group_name = levels(Son$Cluster))
Son = ResetModuleNames(Son, new_name = "SON-M")
mods = levels(GetModules(Son)$module); mods = mods[mods != "grey"]
Pal = c("#3CB44B","#FFE119","#4363D8","#F58231","#911EB4","#46F0F0","#F032E6",
        "#BCF60C","#FABEBE","#008080","#E6BEFF","#9A6324","#800000","#AAFFC3",
        "#808000","#FFD8B1","#000075","#E6194B","#808080","#000000")
Son = ResetModuleColors(Son, setNames(Pal[seq_along(mods)], mods))
Son = ModuleExprScore(Son, n_genes = 25, method = "UCell")
saveRDS(Son, "RDS/hdWGCNA_SON.rds")
```

```{r hdWGCNA MCNs - Run}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(patchwork)
library(WGCNA)
library(hdWGCNA)
theme_set(cowplot::theme_cowplot())
set.seed(12345)
disableWGCNAThreads()
dir.create("Figures/Fig 3/hdWGCNA", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MCN = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
MCN[["RNA"]]$scale.data = NULL; gc()
MCN = SetupForWGCNA(MCN, gene_select = "fraction", fraction = 0.05,
                    group.by = "Cluster", wgcna_name = "MCNs")
MCN = MetacellsByGroups(MCN, group.by = c("Cluster", "orig.ident"), ident.group = "Cluster",
                        reduction = "rpca", k = 20, max_shared = 10, min_cells = 50,
                        target_metacells = 200)
MCN = NormalizeMetacells(MCN)
table(GetMetacellObject(MCN)$Cluster)  
MCN = SetDatExpr(MCN, group_name = unique(as.character(GetMetacellObject(MCN)$Cluster)),
                 group.by = "Cluster", assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
MCN = TestSoftPowers(MCN, networkType = "signed")
tiff("Figures/Fig 3/hdWGCNA/TestSoftPowers.tiff", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw")
print(wrap_plots(PlotSoftPowers(MCN), ncol = 2))
dev.off()
saveRDS(MCN, "RDS/hdWGCNA_MCNs.rds")
MCN = ConstructNetwork(MCN, tom_name = "MCNs", tom_outdir = "RDS/TOM", overwrite_tom = TRUE)   # soft power = 8
saveRDS(MCN, "RDS/hdWGCNA_MCNs.rds")

MCN = ScaleData(MCN, features = VariableFeatures(MCN))
MCN = ModuleEigengenes(MCN, group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
MCN[["RNA"]]$scale.data = NULL; gc()
saveRDS(MCN, "RDS/hdWGCNA_MCNs.rds")
MCN = ModuleConnectivity(MCN, group.by = "Cluster", group_name = levels(MCN$Cluster))
MCN = ResetModuleNames(MCN, new_name = "MCN-M")
mods = levels(GetModules(MCN)$module); mods = mods[mods != "grey"]   # 8 modules
Pal = c("#FFD8B1","#000075","#808080","#F133E6","#000000","#A9A9A9","#FF69B4",
        "#B8A0E6","#6B8E23","#FF4500","#2E8B57","#4682B4","#D2691E","#AAFFC3",
        "#808000","#E6194B","#3CB44B","#FFE119","#911EB4","#46F0F0")
MCN = ResetModuleColors(MCN, setNames(Pal[seq_along(mods)], mods))
MCN = ModuleExprScore(MCN, n_genes = 25, method = "UCell")
saveRDS(MCN, "RDS/hdWGCNA_MCNs.rds")
```

## CellChat

### SON - Control

```{r Control CellChat Base and Compute - Fig 1}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggalluvial)
dir.create("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (n in c("SS", "CC", "ECM")) dir.create(paste0("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat/", n), showWarnings = FALSE)

Data = subset(readRDS("RDS/Son.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")
meta = Data[[]]
Data=LayerData(Data, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
Data=Data[rowSums(Data)>0,]
data.input = Data
cell.use = rownames(meta)
data.input = data.input[, cell.use]
meta = meta[cell.use, ]
labels = data.frame(meta$Cluster, row.names = colnames(data.input))
labels$labels = labels$meta.Cluster
labels$meta.lineage =NULL
unique(labels$labels)
cellchat = createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = labels, group.by = "labels")
cellchat = addMeta(cellchat, meta = labels)
cellchat = setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels", levels = Colors_Son$Order)
levels(cellchat@idents)
groupSize = as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
CellChatDB = CellChatDB.mouse

############################## RUN
color.use = setNames(Colors_Son$Color, Colors_Son$Order)

for(i in c("Cell-Cell Contact","ECM-Receptor","Secreted Signaling","Non-protein Signaling")){
  if(i == "Cell-Cell Contact"){
    Name = "CC"
  }
  if(i == "ECM-Receptor"){
    Name = "ECM"
    }
  if(i == "Secreted Signaling"){
    Name = "SS"
  }
  if(i == "Non-protein Signaling"){
    Name = "NP"
  }
  groupSize = as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
  CellChatDB = CellChatDB.mouse
  CellChatDB.use = subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = i)
  cellchat@DB = CellChatDB.use
  cellchat = subsetData(cellchat)
  future::plan("multicore", workers = 12)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat = computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat = filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
  cellchat = computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat = aggregateNet(cellchat)
  groupSize = as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
  Order = cellchat@meta
  Order$Order = NA
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "X", 0, NA)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "MCNs", 1,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Other Neurons", 2,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Astrocytes", 3,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Oligodendrocytes", 4,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "OPCs", 5,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Immune Cells", 6,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Endothelial Cells", 7,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "VLMCs", 8,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "SMCs", 9,  Order$Order)
  Order$Order = ifelse(Order$labels == "Pericytes", 10,  Order$Order)
  Order  = Order %>% arrange(Order)
  Order$labels = factor(Order$labels, levels = Colors_Son$Order)
  cellchat@meta = Order
  saveRDS(cellchat, paste0("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat/Cellchat_",Name,".rds"))
  tiff(file=paste0("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat/Number_",Name,"_Leg.tiff"),width=6, height=6, units="in", res=100)
  netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T,
                   label.edge= F, title.name = paste0("Number:",Name), color.use = color.use,vertex.label.cex = 0.01, )
  dev.off()
}
```

### SON - Control vs WD

```{r Base and Compute}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(Seurat)
library(NMF)
library(ggalluvial)
library(MASS)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)

Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")

Colors_Son = data.frame(Order =  c("MCNs","Other Neurons","Astrocytes",
        "Oligodendrocytes", "OPCs","Immune Cells","Endothelial Cells",
        "VLMCs", "SMCs", "Pericytes"),
            Color = c("#F8766D",  "#D89000", "#A3A500",
           "#39B600", "#00BF7D", "#00BFC4",  "#00B0F6",
           "#9590FF", "#E76BF3","#FF62BC"))

dir.create("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

RunCellChat = function(Seurat){
  meta = Seurat[[]]
  labels = data.frame(labels = factor(as.character(meta$Cluster), levels = Colors_Son$Order),
                      samples = factor(meta$orig.ident),
                      row.names = colnames(Seurat))
  cellchat = createCellChat(object = Seurat, meta = labels, group.by = "labels")
  cellchat = setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels", levels = Colors_Son$Order)
  return(cellchat)
}
RunAnalyses = function(cellchat, Group){
  DBs = c(CC = "Cell-Cell Contact", ECM = "ECM-Receptor", SS = "Secreted Signaling", NP = "Non-protein Signaling")
  future::plan("sequential")
  for(Name in names(DBs)){
    cc = cellchat
    cc@DB = subsetDB(CellChatDB.mouse, search = DBs[[Name]])
    cc = subsetData(cc)
    cc = identifyOverExpressedGenes(cc)
    cc = identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cc)
    cc = computeCommunProb(cc)
    cc = filterCommunication(cc, min.cells = 10)
    cc = computeCommunProbPathway(cc)
    cc = aggregateNet(cc)
    saveRDS(cc, paste0("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/Cellchat_",Group,"_",Name,".rds"))
  }
  future::plan("sequential")
}

md = Son[[]]
counts = LayerData(Son, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
rm(Son); gc()

Ctrl.cells = rownames(md)[md$Group == "Control"]
WD.cells = rownames(md)[md$Group == "WD"]
Ctrl_med = tapply(md[Ctrl.cells, "nCount_RNA"], as.character(md[Ctrl.cells, "Cluster"]), median)
WD_med = tapply(md[WD.cells, "nCount_RNA"], as.character(md[WD.cells, "Cluster"]), median)
Prop = setNames(pmin(1, Ctrl_med / WD_med[names(Ctrl_med)]), names(Ctrl_med))

set.seed(42)
WD_counts = counts[, WD.cells]
p.cell = Prop[as.character(md[WD.cells, "Cluster"])]
stopifnot(!anyNA(p.cell))
col.idx = rep(seq_len(ncol(WD_counts)), diff(WD_counts@p))
WD_counts@x = as.numeric(rbinom(length(WD_counts@x), size = round(WD_counts@x), prob = p.cell[col.idx]))
WD_counts = Matrix::drop0(WD_counts)
counts = cbind(counts[, Ctrl.cells], WD_counts)[, rownames(md)]
rm(WD_counts); gc()

Son = CreateSeuratObject(counts, meta.data = md[, c("orig.ident", "Group", "Cluster")])
Son = NormalizeData(Son)
rm(counts); gc()

Control = subset(Son, subset = Group == "Control")
WD = subset(Son, subset = Group == "WD")
rm(Son)

Control = RunCellChat(Control)
Control = RunAnalyses(Control, "Control")

WD = RunCellChat(WD)
WD = RunAnalyses(WD, "WD")
```


```{r Joint Lineage Trajectory - Fig 4}
MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
for (L in names(Lineages_MCN)) {
  cds = Lineage_Traj(MCN_obj, Lineages_MCN[[L]], paste0("RDS/Trajectory/Joint_", L, "_cds.rds"))
  D = PT_Table(cds)
  nb = 10
  D$Bin = cut(D$Pseudotime, breaks = seq(0, max(D$Pseudotime), length.out = nb + 1), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  Frac_bin = D %>% count(Group, Animal, Bin) %>%
    complete(nesting(Group, Animal), Bin = 1:nb, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(Animal) %>% mutate(Frac = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
  Test_bin = Frac_bin %>% group_by(Bin) %>%
    summarise(Control = mean(Frac[Group == "Control"]), WD = mean(Frac[Group == "WD"]),
              p = t.test(Frac ~ Group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
  Animal_med = D %>% group_by(Group, Animal) %>% summarise(Median_PT = median(Pseudotime), .groups = "drop")
  Tt_med = t.test(Median_PT ~ Group, data = Animal_med)
  Sub_med = D %>% group_by(Cluster, Group, Animal) %>% summarise(Median_PT = median(Pseudotime), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Cluster) %>%
    summarise(Control = mean(Median_PT[Group == "Control"]), WD = mean(Median_PT[Group == "WD"]),
              p = t.test(Median_PT ~ Group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
  print(Test_bin); print(Tt_med); print(Sub_med)

  gC = read.xlsx(paste0("Excel/Trajectory/Control_", L, "_Trajectory.xlsx"), "Trajectory_Genes")
  gW = read.xlsx(paste0("Excel/Trajectory/WD_", L, "_Trajectory.xlsx"), "Trajectory_Genes")
  Genes_U = union(gC$gene[gC$Heatmap], gW$gene[gW$Heatmap])
  Genes_U = intersect(Genes_U, rownames(cds))
  Dyn = Dyn_Compare(cds, Genes_U)
  Dyn$Res = Dyn$Res %>% mutate(Control_traj = gene %in% gC$gene[gC$Heatmap], WD_traj = gene %in% gW$gene[gW$Heatmap])
  Overlap = tibble(Control_only = sum(Dyn$Res$Control_traj & !Dyn$Res$WD_traj),
                   Both = sum(Dyn$Res$Control_traj & Dyn$Res$WD_traj),
                   WD_only = sum(!Dyn$Res$Control_traj & Dyn$Res$WD_traj),
                   Shape_FDR005 = sum(Dyn$Res$FDR_shape < 0.05), Level_FDR005 = sum(Dyn$Res$FDR_level < 0.05))
  print(Overlap)
  saveRDS(Dyn, paste0("RDS/Trajectory/Joint_", L, "_Dynamics.rds"))
  write.xlsx(list(Per_bin = Test_bin, Per_animal_bin = Frac_bin, Animal_median = Animal_med,
                  Median_test = tibble(t = unname(Tt_med$statistic), p = Tt_med$p.value),
                  Subtype_median = Sub_med, Gene_dynamics = Dyn$Res, Overlap = Overlap,
                  Cells = D),
             paste0("Excel/Trajectory/Joint_", L, "_Control_vs_WD.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  rm(cds, Dyn); gc()
}
rm(MCN_obj); gc()
```

```{r Control GO - Fig 1}
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(openxlsx)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)

Markers = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Son_Markers.xlsx")
Markers = subset(Markers, subset = avg_log2FC > 0.25 & p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25)

Son = subset(readRDS("RDS/Son.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")

wb = createWorkbook()
for(i in unique(Markers$cluster)){
  DataFrame = data.frame()
  List = subset(Markers, subset = avg_log2FC > 0.25 & p_val_adj < 0.05 & cluster == i)
  List = bitr(List$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
  Data = Expressed(Son, cluster_id = i)
  Data = bitr(Data, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
  for (x in c("BP","MF","CC")) {
   GO = enrichGO(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                  universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                          OrgDb         = org.Rn.eg.db,
                          ont           = x,
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                          qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                          readable      = TRUE)
          X_GO = data.frame(GO@result)
          X_GO$Analyses = x
          DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_GO)
        }
  KEGG = enrichKEGG(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                    universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                     organism     = "rno" ,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  X_KEGG = data.frame(KEGG@result)
  X_KEGG$Analyses = "KEGG"
  DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_KEGG)
  Reactome = enrichPathway(gene=as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                           universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                           pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                           readable=TRUE, organism = "rat")
  Reactome = Reactome@result
  Reactome$Analyses = "Reactome"
  DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, Reactome)
  DataFrame$Cluster = i
  DataFrame = DataFrame %>% arrange(Analyses,p.adjust)
  DataFrame$DEGs = "Positive DEGs Markers"
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = i)
  writeData(wb, sheet = i, DataFrame, startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0("Excel/Control_Son_Markers_GO.xlsx"),  overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r Control Violin Plot - Fig 1}
modify_vlnplot= function(obj,
feature,
pt.size = 0,
plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
...) {
p= VlnPlot(obj, features = feature, cols = Colors_Son$Color,
           pt.size = pt.size)+
ylab(feature) +
theme(legend.position = "none",
plot.title= element_blank(),
axis.title.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank(),
axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
plot.margin = plot.margin )
return(p)
}
extract_max= function(p){
  ymax= max(ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_scales_y[[1]]$range$range)
  return(ceiling(ymax))
}
StackedVlnPlot= function(obj, features,
                          pt.size = 0,
                          plot.margin = unit(c(-0.75, 0, -0.75, 0), "cm"),
                          ...) {

  plot_list= purrr::map(features, function(x) modify_vlnplot(obj = obj,feature = x, ...))

  plot_list[[length(plot_list)]]= plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_blank())

  ymaxs= purrr::map_dbl(plot_list, extract_max)
  plot_list= purrr::map2(plot_list, ymaxs, function(x,y) x +
                            scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2.5, y)) +
                            expand_limits(y = y))

  lv = levels(obj)
  balls = data.frame(cluster = factor(lv, levels = lv), num = seq_along(lv))
  axis = ggplot(balls, aes(x = cluster, y = 0)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = cluster), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, size = 14) +
    geom_text(aes(label = num), size = 7, colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Colors_Son$Color) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0.2, 0, 0, 0, "cm"))
  plot_list = c(plot_list, list(axis))

  p= patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 1,
                           heights = c(rep(1, length(plot_list) - 1), 0.4))
  return(p)
}

p = StackedVlnPlot(Son, Annot_Top$gene)
print(p)
ggsave("Figures/Fig 1/Control_Violino_Son_Annotation.tiff", plot = p, width = 9, height = 14, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r Control DotPlot Markers - Fig 1}
Top1 = function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = specificity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = Colors_Son$Order)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster)
}

Genes_DP = bind_rows(

  Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers, Class == "enzyme")) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = "Enzyme"),
  Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers, Class == "TF")) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = "TF")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Block = factor(Block, levels = c("Top marker", "GPCR", "Enzyme", "TF"))) %>%

Sig_DP = Markers %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, cluster) %>%

Keys_DP = paste(Genes_DP$Block, Genes_DP$gene, sep = "__")

  dplyr::select(-cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(DP, by = c("gene" = "features.plot"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%

  dplyr::mutate(sig   = !is.na(sig),
                id    = factor(id, levels = Colors_Son$Order),
                y_key = factor(paste(Block, gene, sep = "__"), levels = rev(unique(Keys_DP))))
Lim_fill = range(DP_plot$avg.exp.scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

Plot_DP = function(D) {
ggplot(D, aes(x = id, y = y_key)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*__", "", x)) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(D, !sig), aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.exp.scaled, color = sig),
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(D, sig), aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.exp.scaled, color = sig),
             shape = 21, stroke = 1.4) +
  facet_grid(Block ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(25, 50, 75, 100),
             name = "% expressing") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "#B2182B", name = "Scaled expression", limits = Lim_fill,
                      guide = guide_colourbar(theme = theme(legend.key.width  = unit(4, "cm"),
                                                            legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm")))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "black"),
                     labels = c(`FALSE` = "n.s.", `TRUE` = "P_adj < 0.05"),
                     name = NULL,
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 7.5, stroke = c(0.6, 2.1), fill = "white"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.75),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", margin = margin(7.5, 7.5, 7.5, 7.5)),

        legend.position = "top",
        legend.box      = "vertical",
        legend.box.just = "center",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 21, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.75, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(6, "pt"),
        legend.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}
```

```{r Control Specific Pathways - Fig 1}
b = body(netVisual_circle_fix)
```

```{r Control Individual Plots - Fig 1}
library(CellChat)

mycircle_fix <- function(coords, v = NULL, params) {
  vertex.color <- params("vertex", "color")
  if (length(vertex.color) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.color <- vertex.color[v]
  vertex.size <- params("vertex", "size")
  if (length(vertex.size) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.size <- vertex.size[v]
  vertex.frame.color <- params("vertex", "frame.color")
  if (length(vertex.frame.color) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.frame.color <- vertex.frame.color[v]
  vertex.frame.width <- params("vertex", "frame.width")
  if (length(vertex.frame.width) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.frame.width <- vertex.frame.width[v]
  mapply(coords[, 1], coords[, 2], vertex.color, vertex.frame.color,
         vertex.size, vertex.frame.width,
         FUN = function(x, y, bg, fg, size, lwd) {
           symbols(x = x, y = y, bg = bg, fg = fg, lwd = lwd,
                   circles = size, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE)
         })
  if (!is.null(num_by_col)) {
    nums <- num_by_col[hex(rep_len(vertex.color, nrow(coords)))]
    nums_border <- num_by_col[hex(rep_len(vertex.frame.color, nrow(coords)))]
    nums <- ifelse(is.na(nums), nums_border, nums)
    text(coords[, 1], coords[, 2], labels = ifelse(is.na(nums), "", nums),
         cex = num.cex, font = 2, col = "black")
  }
}
assignInNamespace("mycircle", mycircle_fix, "CellChat")

if (!exists("h1_orig")) h1_orig <- CellChat:::netVisual_hierarchy1
if (!exists("h2_orig")) h2_orig <- CellChat:::netVisual_hierarchy2
st.cex <- 1.4
set_cex <- function(f) {
  src <- deparse(f)
  target_lines <- grep('"Source", "Target", "Source"', src)
  src[target_lines] <- sub("cex = 0.8", paste0("cex = ", st.cex), src[target_lines], fixed = TRUE)
  g <- eval(parse(text = src)); environment(g) <- environment(f); g
}
h1_mod <- set_cex(h1_orig); h2_mod <- set_cex(h2_orig)
assignInNamespace("netVisual_hierarchy1", function(..., title.name = NULL) h1_mod(..., title.name = NULL), "CellChat")
assignInNamespace("netVisual_hierarchy2", function(..., title.name = NULL) h2_mod(..., title.name = NULL), "CellChat")

num_by_col <- NULL
num.cex <- 1.1

vertex.receiver <- 1:5
v.size   <- 15

for (i in c("SS", "CC", "ECM", "NP")) {
  out_dir <- paste0("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat/cellchat_hierarchy_", i)
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  cellchat <- readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 1/Control_CellChat/Cellchat_", i, ".rds"))
  print(levels(cellchat@idents))

  cols <- Colors_Son$Color
  names(cols) <- Colors_Son$Order
  cols <- cols[levels(cellchat@idents)]
  num_by_col <- setNames(match(names(cols), Colors_Son$Order), hex(cols))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(cols))

  cellchat_nolab <- cellchat
  dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$prob)[1:2] <- list(rep("", nrow(cellchat@net$prob)),
                                                 rep("", ncol(cellchat@net$prob)))
  dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$pval)[1:2] <- dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$prob)[1:2]

  for (pw in cellchat@netP$pathways) {
    pw_dir <- file.path(out_dir, pw)
    dir.create(pw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

    save_tiff(file.path(pw_dir, paste0(pw, "_aggregate.tiff")),
              netVisual_aggregate(cellchat_nolab, signaling = pw, layout = "hierarchy",
                                  vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver, color.use = cols,
                                  vertex.weight = 1, vertex.size.max = v.size,
                                  title.space = -100))

    pairs <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat, signaling = pw, geneLR.return = FALSE)$interaction_name
    for (lr in pairs) {
      save_tiff(file.path(pw_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", lr), ".tiff")),
                netVisual_individual(cellchat_nolab, signaling = pw, pairLR.use = lr,
                                     layout = "hierarchy", vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver,
                                     color.use = cols, vertex.weight = 1,
                                     vertex.size.max = v.size))
    }
  }
}
```

## Bulk RNA-seq Validation

```{r BulkValidation - Fig 2}
Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")
Idents(Son) = "Group"
Markers = FindMarkers(Son, ident.1 = "WD", ident.2 = "Control", verbose = FALSE, only.pos = FALSE,
                  logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0, test.use = "MAST")
Markers$gene = rownames(Markers)
write.xlsx(Markers, "Excel/BulkSupraoptic.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(ggrepel)

pseudobulk = read.xlsx("Excel/BulkSupraoptic.xlsx") %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  transmute(Gene = gene, LOG2_Pseudo = avg_log2FC, PADJ_Pseudo = p_val_adj)

Bulk = read.xlsx("Fisiologico/degs.xlsx", sheet = "DEseq2_full_ALL_n32403_Wist_SON") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, !is.na(ENSEMBL_gene.name)) %>%
  transmute(Gene = ENSEMBL_gene.name, LOG2_Bulk = log2FoldChange, PADJ_Bulk = padj) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>% slice_min(PADJ_Bulk, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

Validation = inner_join(pseudobulk, Bulk, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(sign(LOG2_Pseudo) == sign(LOG2_Bulk), "Concordant", "Discordant"))

#Spearman correlation
Spearman = cor.test(Validation$LOG2_Pseudo, Validation$LOG2_Bulk,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
Spearman

#Direction concordance
Binom = binom.test(sum(Validation$Direction == "Concordant"), nrow(Validation), p = 0.5)

Stats_Bulk = data.frame(N_sig_pseudobulk = nrow(pseudobulk),
                        N_sig_bulk       = nrow(Bulk),
                        N_shared         = nrow(Validation),
                        Spearman_rho     = unname(Spearman$estimate),
                        Spearman_p       = Spearman$p.value,
                        N_concordant     = sum(Validation$Direction == "Concordant"),
                        Pct_concordant   = mean(Validation$Direction == "Concordant") * 100,
                        Binomial_p       = Binom$p.value)
Stats_Bulk

Sel = c("Giot1", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1")
Selected = Validation %>% filter(Gene %in% Sel)
Selected

write.xlsx(list(Stats = Stats_Bulk, Genes = Validation),
           "Excel/Correlation/Pseudobulk_x_Bulk_Correlation.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Tree = Validation %>%
  mutate(Score = abs(LOG2_Pseudo) + abs(LOG2_Bulk), Quadrant = paste(sign(LOG2_Bulk), sign(LOG2_Pseudo))) %>%
  filter(!Gene %in% Sel, !grepl(Non_official, Gene), !grepl("^Mt-", Gene)) %>%
  group_by(Quadrant) %>% slice_max(Score, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

Label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f\np = %s\nn = %d genes\nConcordant = %.1f%%",
                Stats_Bulk$Spearman_rho,
                formatC(Stats_Bulk$Spearman_p, format = "e", digits = 1),
                Stats_Bulk$N_shared, Stats_Bulk$Pct_concordant)

ggplot(Validation, aes(x = LOG2_Bulk, y = LOG2_Pseudo)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Direction), shape = 16, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Tree, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "italic", size = 4.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  geom_point(data = Selected, shape = 21, fill = "#C0392B", colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Selected, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "bold.italic", colour = "#C0392B", size = 4.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.6, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Concordant = "#D43D4F", Discordant = "#65be3b")) +
  labs(x = expression("Bulk RNA-seq log"[2]*"FC (Dehydrated vs Control)"),
       y = expression("snRNA-seq log"[2]*"FC (WD vs Control)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("Figures/Fig 2/Pseudobulk_x_Bulk_Correlation.tiff", width = 7, height = 6.5,
       bg = "white", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r Jitter - Fig 2}
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)

FC_cut = 0.25
padj_cut = 0.05
n_up = 3
n_down = 3

set.seed(4301)
DE_plot = read.xlsx("Excel/Son_Osmotic_Markers.xlsx") %>%
  filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > FC_cut, cell_type %in% Colors_Son$Order) %>%
  left_join(Colors_Son, by = c("cell_type" = "Order")) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = Colors_Son$Order),
         sig       = p_val_adj < padj_cut,
         sig_PB    = sig & !is.na(padj_pseudobulk) & padj_pseudobulk < padj_cut &
                     sign(log2FC_pseudobulk) == sign(avg_log2FC),
         Color     = ifelse(sig, Color, "grey"),
         x_jit     = as.numeric(cell_type) + runif(n(), -0.25, 0.25))

table(MAST = DE_plot$sig, Pseudobulk = DE_plot$sig_PB)

Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"

Tree = DE_plot %>%
  filter(sig, !grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>%
  mutate(direction = sign(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, direction) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  filter(Rank <= ifelse(first(direction) > 0, n_up, n_down)) %>%
  ungroup()

x_lim =c(0.5, length(levels(DE_plot$cell_type)) + 0.5)
y_top = max(DE_plot$avg_log2FC)

p = ggplot(DE_plot, aes(x = x_jit, y = avg_log2FC)) +
  geom_point_rast(data = filter(DE_plot, !sig_PB), aes(color = Color), shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_point_rast(data = filter(DE_plot, sig_PB), aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black",
                  stroke = 0.3, size = 1.8, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Tree, aes(label = gene),
                  fontface = "italic", size = 3.5, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  annotate("point", x = c(0.75, 0.75), y = y_top * c(1, 0.92), shape = c(1, 21),
           colour = c("grey30", "black"), fill = c(NA, "grey30"), size = c(1.5, 1.8)) +
  annotate("text", x = c(0.85, 0.85), y = y_top * c(1, 0.92), hjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = c("MAST", "MAST + Pseudobulk (edgeR)")) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(DE_plot$cell_type)),
                     labels = levels(DE_plot$cell_type),
                     limits = x_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"))

balls = data.frame(num = seq_along(Colors_Son$Order), Color = Colors_Son$Color)
axis = ggplot(balls, aes(x = num, y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, size = 10) +
  geom_text(aes(label = num), size = 5, colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void()

p_final = patchwork::wrap_plots(p, axis, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.08))
p_final
ggsave("Figures/Fig 2/Son_Osmotic_Markers.tiff", plot = p_final, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r GO - Fig 2}
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(openxlsx)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)

Markers = read.xlsx("Excel/Son_Osmotic_Markers.xlsx")
Markers = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")

wb = createWorkbook()
for(i in unique(Markers$cell_type)){
  Run = data.frame()
  for(y in c("Total","Positive","Negative")){
    DataFrame = data.frame()
    if(y == "Total"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i)
    }
    if(y == "Positive"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i & avg_log2FC > 0.25)
    }
     if(y == "Negative"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i & avg_log2FC < -0.25)
     }
    if(length(List$gene) >= 1){
      List = bitr(List$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
      Data = Expressed(Son, cluster_id = i)
      Data = bitr(Data, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
      for (x in c("BP","MF","CC")) {
       GO = enrichGO(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                      universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                              OrgDb         = org.Rn.eg.db,
                              ont           = x,
                              pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                              pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                              qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                              readable      = TRUE)
              if(!is.null(GO)){
              X_GO = data.frame(GO@result)
              X_GO$Analyses = x
              DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_GO)}
            }
      KEGG = enrichKEGG(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                        universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                         organism     = "rno" ,
                         pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
      if(!is.null(KEGG)){
      X_KEGG = data.frame(KEGG@result)
      X_KEGG$Analyses = "KEGG"
      DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_KEGG)}
      Reactome = enrichPathway(gene=as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                               universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                               pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                               readable=TRUE, organism = "rat")
      if(!is.null(Reactome)){
      Reactome = Reactome@result
      Reactome$Analyses = "Reactome"
      DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, Reactome)}
      DataFrame = DataFrame %>% arrange(Analyses,p.adjust)
      if(length(DataFrame$subcategory) == 0){
        DataFrame$category = NA
        DataFrame$subcategory = NA
      }
      DataFrame$DEGs = y
      Run = rbind(DataFrame, Run)
  }
    }
    Run$Cluster = i
    print(i)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = i)
    writeData(wb, sheet = i, Run, startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0("Excel/Son_Osmotic_Markers_GO.xlsx"),
             overwrite = TRUE)

#Jitter
```

```{r BarPlot Information Flow}
Group_Colors = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")

Flow = do.call(rbind, lapply(c("SS","CC","ECM","NP"), function(Pathway){
  cellchat = readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/CellChat_Merged_",Pathway,".rds"))
  df = rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", stacked = T, do.stat = T,
               color.use = unname(Group_Colors), return.data = T)$signaling.contribution
  df = df[!is.na(df$pvalues) & df$pvalues < 0.05, c("name","group","contribution","pvalues")]
  df$DB = Pathway
  df
}))
Flow$name = as.character(Flow$name)
Flow$group = factor(as.character(Flow$group), levels = names(Group_Colors))

Frac = tapply(Flow$contribution, list(paste(Flow$DB, Flow$name, sep = "__"), Flow$group), sum)
Frac[is.na(Frac)] = 0
Frac = Frac[, "Control"] / rowSums(Frac)

Flow$Key = paste(Flow$DB, Flow$name, sep = "__")
Flow$Key = factor(Flow$Key, levels = names(sort(Frac, decreasing = T)))
Flow$DB = factor(Flow$DB, levels = c("SS","CC","ECM","NP"))

Labels = unique(Flow[, c("Key","name","DB")])
Labels$Enriched = ifelse(Frac[as.character(Labels$Key)] >= 0.5, "Control", "WD")

ggplot(Flow, aes(x = Key, y = contribution, fill = group)) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative Information Flow", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 80, 5)) +
  NoLegend()
```

```{r CirclePlot}
  }
```

```{r CellChat Tables - Fig 2}
# Tables from the saved CellChat objects
Lv_DB = c(SS = "Secreted Signaling", CC = "Cell-Cell Contact", ECM = "ECM-Receptor", NP = "Non-protein Signaling")
Long = function(m, name) as.data.frame(as.table(m), responseName = name) %>% rename(source = Var1, target = Var2)
Interactions = Flow_all = Pathways = LR = data.frame()
for (n in names(Lv_DB)) {
  Obj = lapply(c(Control = "Control", WD = "WD"), function(G) readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/Cellchat_", G, "_", n, ".rds")))
  Interactions = bind_rows(Interactions,
    Long(Obj$Control@net$count, "Interactions_Control") %>%
      left_join(Long(Obj$WD@net$count, "Interactions_WD"), by = c("source", "target")) %>%
      left_join(Long(Obj$Control@net$weight, "Strength_Control"), by = c("source", "target")) %>%
      left_join(Long(Obj$WD@net$weight, "Strength_WD"), by = c("source", "target")) %>%
      mutate(DataBase = Lv_DB[[n]], .before = 1))
  for (G in names(Obj)) {
    Pathways = bind_rows(Pathways, subsetCommunication(Obj[[G]], slot.name = "netP") %>% mutate(DataBase = Lv_DB[[n]], Group = G, .before = 1))
    LR = bind_rows(LR, subsetCommunication(Obj[[G]], slot.name = "net") %>% mutate(DataBase = Lv_DB[[n]], Group = G, .before = 1))
  }
  merged = readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/CellChat_Merged_", n, ".rds"))
  Flow_all = bind_rows(Flow_all, rankNet(merged, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, return.data = TRUE)$signaling.contribution %>%
    mutate(DataBase = Lv_DB[[n]], .before = 1))
}
```

```{r CellChat MCNs - Fig 2}
library(CellChat)
Group_Colors =c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")
Lv_DB = c(SS = "Secreted Signaling", CC = "Cell-Cell Contact", ECM = "ECM-Receptor", NP = "Non-protein Signaling")

MCN_Flow = map_dfr(names(Lv_DB), function(Pathway) {
  cellchat = readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/CellChat_Merged_", Pathway, ".rds"))
  map_dfr(c("Outgoing", "Incoming"), function(Dir) {
    df = tryCatch(rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE,
                          sources.use = if (Dir == "Outgoing") "MCNs" else NULL,
                          targets.use = if (Dir == "Incoming") "MCNs" else NULL,
                          color.use = unname(Group_Colors), return.data = TRUE)$signaling.contribution,
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
    df %>% transmute(name = as.character(name), group = as.character(group), contribution, pvalues,
                     DB = Pathway, Direction = Dir)
  })
})

MCN_Wide = MCN_Flow %>%
  group_by(DB, Direction, name) %>%
  summarise(Control = sum(contribution[group == "Control"]), WD = sum(contribution[group == "WD"]),
            p = suppressWarnings(min(pvalues, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log2FC = log2((WD + 1e-6) / (Control + 1e-6)),
         Sig    = is.finite(p) & p < 0.05,
         Change = ifelse(WD > Control, "Up in WD", "Down in WD"))
MCN_Wide %>% filter(Sig) %>% count(DB, Direction, Change)
write.xlsx(MCN_Wide, "Excel/CellChat_MCNs_Pathways_WD.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

MCN_Wide = read.xlsx("Excel/CellChat_MCNs_Pathways_WD.xlsx")
Plot_MCN = MCN_Wide %>%
  filter(Sig) %>%
  group_by(Direction, Change) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2FC = pmax(pmin(log2FC, 6), -6),
         Key    = paste(Direction, paste0(name, " [", DB, "]"), sep = "__"),
         Key    = reorder(Key, log2FC),
         Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Outgoing", "Incoming"),
                            labels = c("MCNs as source", "MCNs as target")))

ggplot(Plot_MCN, aes(x = log2FC, y = Key, fill = Change)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Down in WD" = "#25838E", "Up in WD" = "#D43D4F")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*__", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6, 6), breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6),
                     labels = c("≤-6", "-3", "0", "3", "≥6")) +
  labs(x = expression(atop(log[2]~"(WD / Control)", "information flow")), y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10.8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10.8),
        axis.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13.5),
        strip.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12.6),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
ggsave("Figures/Fig 2/CellChat/MCNs_Pathways_WD.tiff", width = 3.9, height = 8, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

## Activity

```{r Dif Analyses - Fig 2}
Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")
Son = subset(Son, subset = Cluster %in% c("MCNs", "Other Neurons"))

library(rstatix)
#library(effectsize)

Meta = Son[[]]
Meta$Cell = rownames(Meta)
Meta$Osmotic = Meta$Group
Meta$Animal = Meta$orig.ident
Meta = Meta[,c("Cell","Osmotic","Animal")]
Activity = read.xlsx("Excel/NeuroEstimator_Results.xlsx")
Activity$Cell = gsub("\\.", "-", Activity$Cell)
Activity = dplyr::left_join(Activity, Meta, by = "Cell")

Activity = Activity %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Osmotic = factor(Osmotic, levels = c("Control","WD")),
    Cluster = factor(Cluster))


# 1. Wilcoxon
wilc = Activity %>% 
  group_by(Cluster) %>% 
  wilcox_test(predicted_activity ~ Osmotic) %>% 
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, group1, group2, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# 2. Medians per group
meds = Activity %>% 
  group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Osmotic, values_from = med) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff_medianas = WD - Control)

# 3. Number of nuclei
n_cells = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Osmotic, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_")

# 4. Effect size
effsize = Activity %>% 
  group_by(Cluster) %>% 
  wilcox_effsize(predicted_activity ~ Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, effsize, magnitude)

# 5. Per animal
animal = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Animal, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Control_animals = mean(med[Osmotic == "Control"]), WD_animals = mean(med[Osmotic == "WD"]),
                   n_animals_Control = sum(Osmotic == "Control"), n_animals_WD = sum(Osmotic == "WD"),
                   p_animal = t.test(med ~ Osmotic)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_animal_adj = p.adjust(p_animal, "BH"))

#  Merge
final_df = wilc %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meds, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(n_cells, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(effsize, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(animal, by = "Cluster")
final_df
write.xlsx(final_df %>% dplyr::select(Cluster, n_Control, n_WD, n_animals_Control, n_animals_WD, Control_animals, WD_animals, p_animal, p_animal_adj),
           "Excel/Activity_Sig_SON.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

library(patchwork)
Lv_act = c("MCNs", "Other Neurons")
Lb_act = c("1.MCNs", "2.Other Neurons")
Animal_act = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Animal, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = Lv_act, labels = Lb_act))
Bars_act = Animal_act %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(med), sem = sd(med) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
Sig = final_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_animal_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = Lv_act, labels = Lb_act),
                   Label   = ifelse(diff_medianas > 0, "*", "#")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Animal_act %>% group_by(Cluster) %>% dplyr::summarise(y = max(med) * 1.06), by = "Cluster")

dodge = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
Bar_Act = function(cl, lab, vj) {
  A  = Animal_act %>% dplyr::filter(Cluster == cl) %>% droplevels() %>% dplyr::mutate(Lab = lab)
  B  = Bars_act %>% dplyr::filter(Cluster == cl) %>% droplevels() %>% dplyr::mutate(Lab = lab)
  Sg = Sig %>% dplyr::filter(Cluster == cl) %>% dplyr::mutate(Lab = lab)
  ggplot(B, aes(x = Cluster, y = mean, fill = Osmotic)) +
    facet_wrap(~ Lab, strip.position = "left") +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), position = dodge, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = A, aes(x = Cluster, y = med, group = Osmotic), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 42),
               shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.1, stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = Sg, aes(x = 0.8, xend = 1.2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = Sg, aes(x = 1, y = y, label = Label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, vjust = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#25838E","#D43D4F")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title      = element_blank(),
          strip.placement   = "outside",
          strip.background  = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 13, hjust = 1, vjust = vj),
          axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
          plot.margin     = margin(5, 10, 0, 5),
          legend.position = "none")
}

Ball = function(i) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, Color = Colors_Son$Color[i]), aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4, size = 5) +
    geom_text(label = i, size = 2.8, colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.4, 1.6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 10, 2, 5))
}

p_act_son = Bar_Act(Lb_act[1], "Activity", 0) / Ball(1) / Bar_Act(Lb_act[2], "score", 1) / Ball(2) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.12, 1, 0.12))
p_act_son
write.xlsx(list(Animal = Animal_act, Mean_SEM = Bars_act), "Excel/Activity_Barplot_SON.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
ggsave("Figures/Fig 2/Activity_Plot.tiff", plot = p_act_son, width = 2.5, height = 3.6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r CorrPlot - Activity x AVP Genes}
library(ggrastr)

Genes_C = c("Oxt", "Avp", "Creb3l1", "Caprin2")
Cols_C = c(Avp = "#C0392B", Oxt = "#E6A800", Creb3l1 = "#2E86C1", Caprin2 = "#7D3C98")

D_C = tibble(Cell = colnames(Mcn), Activity = Act, Group = Mcn$Group) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(t(Expr))) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(Genes_C), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expr") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>% mutate(Z = as.numeric(scale(Expr))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = Genes_C))
rm(Mcn, Expr); gc()

Rho_C = D_C %>% group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(rho = cor.test(Activity, Expr, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$estimate,

  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
         Lab = paste0(Gene, ": ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", rho)))
Rho_C

Bin_C = D_C %>% mutate(Bin = ntile(Activity, 10)) %>%

  summarise(Activity = mean(Activity), mean = mean(Z), sem = sd(Z) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
write.xlsx(list(Spearman = Rho_C, Deciles = Bin_C), "Excel/Correlation/Activity_AVP_Genes_Corr.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Rho_lab = Rho_C %>% mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = Genes_C), Txt = paste0("ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", rho)))
```

```{r Corr Activity x All Genes - Neurons}
# Same approach as the subtype correlation in Fig 4
Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")
Act = read.xlsx("Excel/NeuroEstimator_Results.xlsx")
Act = setNames(Act$predicted_activity, gsub("\\.", "-", Act$Cell))
IEGs = c("Arc", "Btg2", "Coq10b", "Crem", "Dusp1", "Dusp5", "Egr1", "Egr3",
         "Fbxo33", "Fos", "Fosl2", "Gadd45g", "Gmeb2", "Grasp", "Junb",
         "Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Per1", "Rgs2", "Sertad1", "Tiparp")

Corr_Neu = bind_rows(lapply(c("MCNs", "Other Neurons"), function(cl) {
  cells = colnames(Son)[Son$Cluster == cl]
  act   = Act[cells]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(act))
  Data  = LayerData(Son, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[, cells]
  Data  = Data[Matrix::rowMeans(Data > 0) >= 0.10, ]
  Data  = as.matrix(Data[!rownames(Data) %in% IEGs, ])
  n     = length(act)
  Rho   = cor(t(Data), act, method = "spearman")[, 1]
  Tst   = Rho * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - Rho^2))
  data.frame(Cluster = cl, Gene = names(Rho), Rho = Rho, P = 2 * pt(-abs(Tst), df = n - 2)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rho)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Rho)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number(), Sig = P_adj < 0.05 & abs(Rho) >= 0.1)
}))
rm(Son); gc()
dplyr::count(Corr_Neu, Cluster, Sig)
Corr_Neu %>% group_by(Cluster) %>% slice_head(n = 3)
write.xlsx(split(Corr_Neu, Corr_Neu$Cluster), "Excel/Correlation/Activity_Neurons_AllGenes_Corr.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Supplementary Figure 4 - SON WD Effect

```{r Sup Fig 4}
library(ggrepel)
Out = "Figures/FigSup/Sup4"
dir.create(Out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# A) snRNA-seq vs bulk RNA-seq, proteome and phosphoproteome
Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Sel = c("Giot1", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1")
Layers = c("Bulk RNA-seq", "Bulk proteome", "Bulk phosphoproteome")

SN = read.xlsx("Excel/BulkSupraoptic.xlsx") %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  transmute(Gene = gene, LOG2_SN = avg_log2FC)

RNA = read.xlsx("Fisiologico/degs.xlsx", sheet = "DEseq2_full_ALL_n32403_Wist_SON") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange), !is.na(ENSEMBL_gene.name)) %>%
  transmute(Gene = ENSEMBL_gene.name, LOG2_Bulk = log2FoldChange, P = pvalue, FDR = padj) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>% slice_min(P, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sig_bulk = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05)

R = read.xlsx("Excel/BulkProteomics.xlsx", "SON Total_Phospho_proteome", colNames = FALSE, skipEmptyRows = FALSE)
Fill = function(x) { x = as.character(x); for (i in seq_along(x)[-1]) if (is.na(x[i])) x[i] = x[i - 1]; x }
h3 = Fill(unlist(R[3, ])); h4 = Fill(unlist(R[4, ])); h5 = as.character(unlist(R[5, ]))
D = R[-(1:5), ]
Num = function(i) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(D[[i]]))
Col = function(a) which(h3 == a)
Gene_p = trimws(D[[which(grepl("^Gene names", h4))[1]]])
Cont = D[[which(h4 == "Contaminant")]] %in% c("TRUE", TRUE)
Primary = D[[Col("Primary Protein Row")]] %in% c("TRUE", TRUE)
Phos_present = D[[Col("Phosphopeptide Present")]] %in% c("TRUE", TRUE)
St = which(h4 == "Stats - Total")

Protein = tibble(Gene = Gene_p, LOG2_Bulk = Num(St[h5[St] == "LogFC"]), P = Num(St[h5[St] == "T Test"]),
                 FDR = Num(St[h5[St] == "FDR"])) %>%
  filter(Primary, !Cont, !is.na(Gene), Gene != "", !is.na(LOG2_Bulk)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>% slice_min(P, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sig_bulk = !is.na(P) & P < 0.05)

Ab = which(h3 == "Phospho Normalised Abundanxe")
WD_ab = Ab[h4[Ab] == "SON Experimental"]; Ct_ab = Ab[h4[Ab] == "SON Control"]
M = sapply(c(WD_ab, Ct_ab), Num)
keep = Phos_present & !Cont & !is.na(Gene_p) & Gene_p != "" & complete.cases(M)
S = rowsum(M[keep, ], Gene_p[keep])
L = log2(S)
nWD = length(WD_ab)
Phospho = tibble(Gene = rownames(S), n_phosphopeptides = as.numeric(table(Gene_p[keep])[rownames(S)]),
                 LOG2_Bulk = rowMeans(L[, 1:nWD]) - rowMeans(L[, -(1:nWD)]),
                 P = apply(L, 1, function(x) tryCatch(t.test(x[1:nWD], x[-(1:nWD)])$p.value, error = function(e) NA))) %>%
  filter(is.finite(LOG2_Bulk), !is.na(P)) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(P, "BH"), Sig_bulk = P < 0.05)

Omics = bind_rows(RNA %>% mutate(Layer = Layers[1]), Protein %>% mutate(Layer = Layers[2]),
                  Phospho %>% select(-n_phosphopeptides) %>% mutate(Layer = Layers[3])) %>%
  inner_join(SN, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(Layer = factor(Layer, levels = Layers),
         Direction = ifelse(sign(LOG2_SN) == sign(LOG2_Bulk), "Concordant", "Discordant"))

Stats_Omics = Omics %>% group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarise(N_shared = n(),
            Spearman_rho = cor.test(LOG2_SN, LOG2_Bulk, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$estimate,
            Spearman_p = cor.test(LOG2_SN, LOG2_Bulk, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
            Pct_concordant = 100 * mean(Direction == "Concordant"),
            Binomial_p = binom.test(sum(Direction == "Concordant"), n())$p.value,
            N_sig_bulk = sum(Sig_bulk),
            Pct_concordant_sig_bulk = 100 * mean(Direction[Sig_bulk] == "Concordant"),
            Spearman_rho_sig_bulk = cor.test(LOG2_SN[Sig_bulk], LOG2_Bulk[Sig_bulk], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$estimate,
            Spearman_p_sig_bulk = cor.test(LOG2_SN[Sig_bulk], LOG2_Bulk[Sig_bulk], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
            .groups = "drop")
Stats_Omics
write.xlsx(list(Stats = Stats_Omics, Genes = Omics, Protein_all = Protein, Phospho_per_protein = Phospho),
           "Excel/Correlation/snRNA_x_Bulk_Omics_Correlation.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

# Only genes significant in both datasets are plotted
Brk = identity
Omics = Omics %>% mutate(y_t = Brk(LOG2_SN)) %>% filter(Sig_bulk)
Fit =Omics %>% group_by(Layer) %>% group_modify(function(d, k) {
  g = tibble(LOG2_Bulk = seq(min(d$LOG2_Bulk), max(d$LOG2_Bulk), length.out = 100))
  pr = predict(lm(LOG2_SN ~ LOG2_Bulk, data = d), g, interval = "confidence")
  g %>% mutate(fit = Brk(pr[, "fit"]), lwr = Brk(pr[, "lwr"]), upr = Brk(pr[, "upr"]))
}) %>% ungroup()
Lab_om = Stats_Omics %>%
  mutate(Txt = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f\np = %s\nn = %d genes\nConcordant = %.1f%%", Spearman_rho_sig_bulk,
                       formatC(Spearman_p_sig_bulk, format = "e", digits = 1), N_sig_bulk, Pct_concordant_sig_bulk))
Tree_om = Omics %>% filter(Sig_bulk, !Gene %in% Sel, !grepl(Non_official, Gene), !grepl("^Mt-", Gene)) %>%
  mutate(Score = abs(LOG2_SN) + abs(LOG2_Bulk), Quadrant = paste(sign(LOG2_Bulk), sign(LOG2_SN))) %>%
  group_by(Layer, Quadrant) %>% slice_max(Score, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
Sel_om = Omics %>% filter(Gene %in% Sel)

# Bulk RNA-seq for Fig 2A, proteome and phosphoproteome for Sup Fig 4A
P_om = function(ls) {
  f = function(d) filter(d, Layer %in% ls)
  Omics = f(Omics); Fit = f(Fit); Lab_om = f(Lab_om); Tree_om = f(Tree_om); Sel_om = f(Sel_om)
  ggplot(Omics, aes(x = LOG2_Bulk, y = y_t)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(data = Fit, aes(x = LOG2_Bulk, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = Fit, aes(x = LOG2_Bulk, y = fit), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Direction), shape = 1, size = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Tree_om, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "italic", size = 2.2, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  geom_point(data = Sel_om, shape = 1, colour = "#C0392B", size = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Sel_om, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "bold.italic", colour = "#C0392B", size = 2.4,
                  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.5,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  geom_text(data = Lab_om, aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = Txt), hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Layer, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Concordant = "#D43D4F", Discordant = "#65be3b")) +
  labs(x = expression("Bulk log"[2]*"FC (Dehydrated vs Control)"),
       y = expression("snRNA-seq log"[2]*"FC (WD vs Control)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
}
p_rna = P_om(Layers[1])
p_rna
ggsave("Figures/Fig 2/A_snRNA_x_Bulk_RNAseq_Correlation.tiff", p_rna, width = 3.4, height = 3.4,
       bg = "white", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
p_prot = P_om(Layers[2:3])
p_prot
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/A_snRNA_x_Proteome_Phospho_Correlation.tiff"), p_prot, width = 6.3, height = 3.4,
       bg = "white", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

# C) Cell type proportions per animal (propeller)
Son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")
Prop_SON = Prop_Test(Son[[]], Colors_Son, 1:10, "Excel/Proportion_Test_SON.xlsx",
                     paste0(Out, "/C_Proportion_Test_SON.tiff"), width = 4.6, height = 3)
Prop_SON
rm(Son); gc()
```


## Markers and GO

```{r Control Run DEGs - Fig 3}
library(patchwork)
MCN_obj = subset(readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")
Idents(MCN_obj) = "Cluster"
Markers = FindAllMarkers(MCN_obj,
                         test.use = "MAST",
                         logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25, only.pos = FALSE)
Markers = Markers %>%
  mutate(specificity = avg_log2FC * ((pct.1 + 0.01) / (pct.2 + 0.01))) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(specificity))
write.xlsx(Markers, "Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)

FC_cut = 0.25
padj_cut = 0.05
n_up = 3
n_down = 3

set.seed(4301)
DE_plot = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::rename(cell_type = cluster) %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > FC_cut, cell_type %in% Colors_MCN$Order[1:5]) %>%
  left_join(Colors_MCN, by = c("cell_type" = "Order")) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = Colors_MCN$Order[1:5]),
         sig       = p_val_adj < padj_cut,
         Color     = ifelse(sig, Color, "grey"),
         x_jit     = as.numeric(cell_type) + runif(n(), -0.2, 0.2))

table(DE_plot$sig)

Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"

Tree = DE_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig, !grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = sign(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, direction) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(avg_log2FC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rank <= ifelse(dplyr::first(direction) > 0, n_up, n_down)) %>%
  ungroup()

X_lim = c(0.5, nlevels(DE_plot$cell_type) + 0.5)

p = ggplot(DE_plot, aes(x = x_jit, y = avg_log2FC)) +
  geom_point_rast(aes(color = Color), shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Tree, aes(label = gene),
                  fontface = "italic", size = 4.5, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(DE_plot$cell_type)),
                     labels = levels(DE_plot$cell_type),
                     limits = X_lim, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 0, 5.5))

Dots = Colors_MCN[1:5, ] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = seq_len(n()))
Dots$Num = 10 + match(Dots$Order, Colors_MCN$Order)
rgb_d = col2rgb(Dots$Color)
Dots$Txt = ifelse((0.299 * rgb_d[1, ] + 0.587 * rgb_d[2, ] + 0.114 * rgb_d[3, ]) / 255 > 0.5,
                  "black", "white")

P_Dot = ggplot(Dots, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, size = 7, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = X_lim, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 0.3), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5))

p = p / P_Dot + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.1))
p
ggsave("Figures/Fig 3/Control_MCNs_Markers.tiff", plot = p, width = 4.8, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r Control GO - Fig 3}
library(ggrastr)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(openxlsx)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)

Markers = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers.xlsx")
Markers = subset(Markers, subset = avg_log2FC > 0.25 & p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25)

MCN_obj = subset(readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")
wb = createWorkbook()

for(i in unique(Markers$cluster)){
  DataFrame = data.frame()
  List = subset(Markers, subset = avg_log2FC > 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05 & cluster == i)
  List = bitr(List$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
  Data = Expressed(MCN_obj, cluster_id = i)
  Data = bitr(Data, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
  for (x in c("BP","MF","CC")) {
   GO = enrichGO(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                  universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                          OrgDb         = org.Rn.eg.db,
                          ont           = x,
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                          qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                          readable      = TRUE)
          X_GO = data.frame(GO@result)
          X_GO$Analyses = x
          DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_GO)
        }
  KEGG = enrichKEGG(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                    universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                     organism     = "rno" ,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  X_KEGG = data.frame(KEGG@result)
  X_KEGG$Analyses = "KEGG"
  DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_KEGG)
  Reactome = enrichPathway(gene=as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                           universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                           pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                           readable=TRUE, organism = "rat")
  Reactome = Reactome@result
  Reactome$Analyses = "Reactome"
  DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, Reactome)
  DataFrame$Cluster = i
  DataFrame = DataFrame %>% arrange(Analyses,p.adjust)
  DataFrame$DEGs = "Positive DEGs Markers"
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = i)
  writeData(wb, sheet = i, DataFrame, startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = "Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers_GO.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

#Jitter
DF = data.frame()
for(i in openxlsx::getSheetNames("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers_GO.xlsx")){
  X = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers_GO.xlsx", sheet = i)
  DF = rbind(DF,X)
}

DF = subset(DF, subset = Cluster %in% c(Colors_MCN$Order[1:5]))
DF$neg_log10_padj = -log10(DF$p.adjust)
DF = left_join(DF, Colors_MCN, by = c("Cluster" = "Order"))

DF = subset(DF, subset = p.adjust < 0.05)
DF$Seq = seq(1:length(DF$ID))

X = DF %>% group_by(Cluster) %>% slice_min(p.adjust, n = 1)

#Jitter
ggplot(DF, aes(y = neg_log10_padj, x = Cluster, fill = Color)) +
        geom_jitter_rast(data=DF, color = DF$Color,
                         height = 0.0, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, shape = 1,
        raster.dpi = 300) + theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "none",axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
              panel.border = element_blank()) +
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
              axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", angle = 0)) +
        scale_x_discrete(limits = c(Colors_MCN$Order[1:5]))
ggsave("Figures/Fig 3/Control_GO_Markers.tiff",width = 3, height = 5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```
