## IUPHAR

```{r Control DotPlot Markers - Fig 3}
library(patchwork)
MCN_obj = subset(readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")
Idents(MCN_obj) = "Cluster"
Cols_DP = data.frame(Order = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2"),
                      Color = c("#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf"),
                      Num   = 11:15)
Clusters_DP = Cols_DP$Order

Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Markers = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.25, cluster %in% Clusters_DP,
                !grepl("^Mt-", gene), !grepl(Non_official, gene))

IUPHAR = read.xlsx("Data/IUPHAR.xlsx")[, c("Gene", "Class")] %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(Gene, sep = "\\|") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene = paste0(toupper(substring(trimws(Gene), 1, 1)),
                              tolower(substring(trimws(Gene), 2)))) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
Markers_Class = dplyr::left_join(Markers, IUPHAR, by = c("gene" = "Gene"))

Top1 = function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = specificity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = Clusters_DP)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster)
}

Cand = c(GPCR = "gpcr", Enzyme = "enzyme")
Spec_cand = sapply(Cand, function(k) mean(Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers_Class, Class == k))$specificity))
Spec_cand
Extra = names(which.max(Spec_cand))

Genes_DP = bind_rows(
  Top1(Markers) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = "Top marker"),
  Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers_Class, Class == "Endogenous peptide")) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = "Endogenous peptide"),
  Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers_Class, Class == Cand[[Extra]])) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = Extra),
  Top1(dplyr::filter(Markers_Class, Class == "TF")) %>% dplyr::mutate(Block = "TF")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Block = factor(Block, levels = c("Top marker", "Endogenous peptide", Extra, "TF"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Block, cluster, gene)
Genes_DP
write.xlsx(Genes_DP, "Excel/Control_Magnos_DotPlot_Top1.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

DP = DotPlot(subset(MCN_obj, idents = Clusters_DP), features = unique(Genes_DP$gene))$data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(features.plot = as.character(features.plot))

Sig_DP = Markers %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, cluster) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig = TRUE)

Keys_DP =paste(Genes_DP$Block, Genes_DP$gene, sep = "__")
DP_plot = Genes_DP %>%
  dplyr::select(-cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(DP, by = c("gene" = "features.plot"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(id %in% Clusters_DP) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Sig_DP, by = c("gene", "id" = "cluster")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig   = !is.na(sig),
                id    = factor(id, levels = Clusters_DP),
                y_key = factor(paste(Block, gene, sep = "__"), levels = rev(unique(Keys_DP))))

p_dp = ggplot(DP_plot, aes(x = id, y = y_key)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*__", "", x)) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(DP_plot, !sig), aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.exp.scaled, color = sig),
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(DP_plot, sig), aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.exp.scaled, color = sig),
             shape = 21, stroke = 1.2) +
  facet_grid(Block ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 7), limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(25, 50, 75, 100),
             name = "% expressing") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "#B2182B", name = "Scaled expression", breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
                      guide = guide_colourbar(theme = theme(legend.key.width  = unit(2.5, "cm"),
                                                            legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm")))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "black"),
                     labels = c(`FALSE` = "n.s.", `TRUE` = "P_adj < 0.05"),
                     name = NULL,
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = c(0.3, 1.2), fill = "white"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black"),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.box      = "vertical",
        legend.box.just = "center",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
        legend.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

Dots_DP = data.frame(id = factor(Clusters_DP, levels = Clusters_DP),
                     Num = Cols_DP$Num,
                     Color = Cols_DP$Color)
rgb_dp = col2rgb(Dots_DP$Color)
Dots_DP$Txt = ifelse((0.299 * rgb_dp[1, ] + 0.587 * rgb_dp[2, ] + 0.114 * rgb_dp[3, ]) / 255 > 0.5,
                     "black", "white")

P_Dot_DP = ggplot(Dots_DP, aes(x = id, y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, size = 8, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(Dots_DP$id)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 0, 0, 0))

p_dp_final = p_dp + P_Dot_DP + plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.06))
p_dp_final
```

## CellChat (SON + MCN Subtypes)

```{r Control CellChat - MCN outgoing}
library(CellChat)
Groups_CC = data.frame(
  Order = c("Other Neurons", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPCs", "Immune Cells",
            "Endothelial Cells", "VLMCs", "SMCs", "Pericytes",
            "MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2",
            "MCNs-Mixed 3", "MCNs-Mixed 4", "MCNs-Mixed 5"),
  Num   = 2:18)
Groups_CC$Label = paste0(Groups_CC$Num, ".", Groups_CC$Order)
Sub_MCN = Groups_CC$Order[10:14]

cellchat = readRDS("RDS/Control_CellChat_SON_MCNs.rds")

LR = subsetCommunication(cellchat, sources.use = Sub_MCN, thresh = 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source = as.character(source), target = as.character(target),
                Target_type = ifelse(target %in% Sub_MCN, "MCN subtype", "SON cell type"),
                Source = Groups_CC$Label[match(source, Groups_CC$Order)],
                Target = Groups_CC$Label[match(target, Groups_CC$Order)])

Pathways = LR %>%
  group_by(Source, Target, Target_type, pathway_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(annotation = paste(unique(annotation), collapse = "; "),
                   prob     = sum(prob),
                   n_LR     = dplyr::n(),
                   min_pval = min(pval),
                   LR_pairs = paste(interaction_name_2, collapse = "; "),
                   .groups  = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Source, Groups_CC$Label), match(Target, Groups_CC$Label), dplyr::desc(prob))

wb = createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Pathways")
writeData(wb, "Pathways", Pathways)
addWorksheet(wb, "LR_pairs")
writeData(wb, "LR_pairs",
          LR %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Source, Groups_CC$Label), match(Target, Groups_CC$Label),
                                dplyr::desc(prob)) %>%
            dplyr::select(Source, Target, Target_type, pathway_name, annotation,
                          ligand, receptor, interaction_name_2, prob, pval))
saveWorkbook(wb, "Excel/Control_CellChat_MCNs_Outgoing.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Path_plot = Pathways %>%
  dplyr::filter(Target %in% Groups_CC$Label[1:14]) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Target_num = factor(Groups_CC$Num[match(Target, Groups_CC$Label)], levels = Groups_CC$Num[1:14]),
                Source     = factor(Source, levels = Groups_CC$Label[10:14]))
order_pathways = names(sort(tapply(Path_plot$prob, Path_plot$pathway_name, sum), decreasing = TRUE))
Path_plot$pathway_name = factor(Path_plot$pathway_name, levels = rev(order_pathways))

p_cc = ggplot(Path_plot, aes(x = Target_num, y = pathway_name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_LR, fill = prob), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Source)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 5), name = "L-R pairs") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "#B2182B", name = "Commun. prob") +
  labs(x = "Target (2-10: SON cell types | 11-15: MCN subtypes)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black"),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "right")
p_cc
ggsave("Figures/Fig 3/Control_CellChat/MCNs_Outgoing_DotPlot.tiff", plot = p_cc,
       width = 16, height = max(4, 0.18 * nlevels(Path_plot$pathway_name) + 1.5),
       dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Sources_spec = Groups_CC$Label[10:14]
pseudo = 0.01
Tot = Pathways %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% Sources_spec) %>%
  group_by(pathway_name, Source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(prob = sum(prob), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Source, values_from = prob, values_fill = 0)
Tot[, setdiff(Sources_spec, names(Tot))] = 0

Categorias = list("Avp 1" = "11.MCNs-Avp 1",
                  "Avp 2" = "12.MCNs-Avp 2",
                  "AVPs"  = c("11.MCNs-Avp 1", "12.MCNs-Avp 2"),
                  "Oxt"   = "13.MCNs-Oxt",
                  "Mixed 1" = "14.MCNs-Mixed 1",
                  "Mixed 2" = "15.MCNs-Mixed 2")

Spec = bind_rows(lapply(names(Categorias), function(k) {
  dentro = Categorias[[k]]
  fora   = setdiff(Sources_spec, dentro)
  data.frame(Category     = k,
             pathway_name = Tot$pathway_name,
             prob_in      = rowMeans(Tot[, dentro, drop = FALSE]),
             prob_out     = rowMeans(Tot[, fora, drop = FALSE])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Specificity = (prob_in + pseudo) / (prob_out + pseudo))
}))

Top_spec = data.frame()
for (k in names(Categorias)) {
  escolha = Spec %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == k, prob_in > 0, Specificity > 1,
                  !pathway_name %in% Top_spec$pathway_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Specificity)) %>%
    head(1)
  Top_spec = bind_rows(Top_spec, escolha)
}
Top_spec

Sig_pathways_extra    = c("SLIT", "FGF", "PCDH")
Ligantes_extra = c("Tenm2", "Flrt2")

Rows_pathways = Pathways %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% Sources_spec,
                pathway_name %in% c(Top_spec$pathway_name, Sig_pathways_extra)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Top_spec %>% dplyr::select(pathway_name, Category), by = "pathway_name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Row = ifelse(is.na(Category), pathway_name, paste0(pathway_name, " (", Category, ")"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Row, Source, Target, prob, n_LR)

Rows_lig = LR %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% Sources_spec, ligand %in% Ligantes_extra) %>%
  group_by(ligand, Source, Target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(prob = sum(prob), n_LR = dplyr::n(),
                   pathways = paste(sort(unique(pathway_name)), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(ligand) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Row = paste0(ligand, " (", paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(pathways, "/")))), collapse = "/"), ")")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Row, Source, Target, prob, n_LR)

order_rows = c(paste0(Top_spec$pathway_name, " (", Top_spec$Category, ")"),
                 Sig_pathways_extra,
                 unique(Rows_lig$Row))

Spec_plot = bind_rows(Rows_pathways, Rows_lig) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Target %in% Groups_CC$Label[1:14]) %>%
```

```{r Control CellChat - Hierarchy MCNs}
library(CellChat)
Groups_CC = data.frame(
  Order = c("Other Neurons", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPCs", "Immune Cells",
            "Endothelial Cells", "VLMCs", "SMCs", "Pericytes",
            "MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2",
            "MCNs-Mixed 3", "MCNs-Mixed 4", "MCNs-Mixed 5"),
  Num   = 2:18,
  Color = c("#D89000", "#A3A500", "#39B600", "#00BF7D", "#00BFC4", "#00B0F6",
            "#9590FF", "#E76BF3", "#FF62BC",
            "#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf", "#E97E22", "#3e4c5e", "#0e329e"))
Sub_MCN = Groups_CC$Order[10:14]

cellchat = readRDS("RDS/Control_CellChat_SON_MCNs.rds")
cellchat = subsetCellChat(cellchat, idents.use = setdiff(levels(cellchat@idents), c("MCNs-Mixed 3", "MCNs-Mixed 4", "MCNs-Mixed 5")))
cols = setNames(Groups_CC$Color, Groups_CC$Order)[levels(cellchat@idents)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(cols))
vertex.receiver = match(Sub_MCN, levels(cellchat@idents))

num_by_col = setNames(Groups_CC$Num, hex(Groups_CC$Color))
num.cex = 1.1
st.cex  = 1.4
v.size  = 15

mycircle_fix = function(coords, v = NULL, params) {
  vertex.color = params("vertex", "color")
  if (length(vertex.color) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.color = vertex.color[v]
  vertex.size = params("vertex", "size")
  if (length(vertex.size) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.size = vertex.size[v]
  vertex.frame.color = params("vertex", "frame.color")
  if (length(vertex.frame.color) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.frame.color = vertex.frame.color[v]
  vertex.frame.width = params("vertex", "frame.width")
  if (length(vertex.frame.width) != 1 && !is.null(v)) vertex.frame.width = vertex.frame.width[v]
  n = nrow(coords)
  vertex.color = rep_len(vertex.color, n); vertex.frame.color = rep_len(vertex.frame.color, n)
  vertex.size  = rep_len(vertex.size, n);  vertex.frame.width = rep_len(vertex.frame.width, n)
  nums = num_by_col[hex(vertex.color)]
  nums_border = num_by_col[hex(vertex.frame.color)]
  cheia = !is.na(nums)
  nums = ifelse(cheia, nums, nums_border)
  mostra = !(cheia & nums %in% num_esconde)
  mapply(coords[mostra, 1], coords[mostra, 2], vertex.color[mostra], vertex.frame.color[mostra],
         vertex.size[mostra], vertex.frame.width[mostra],
         FUN = function(x, y, bg, fg, size, lwd) {
           symbols(x = x, y = y, bg = bg, fg = fg, lwd = lwd, circles = size, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE)
         })
  col_txt = ifelse(cheia & nums %in% num_branco, "white", "black")
  text(coords[mostra, 1], coords[mostra, 2], labels = ifelse(is.na(nums), "", nums)[mostra],
       cex = num.cex, font = 2, col = col_txt[mostra])
}
assignInNamespace("mycircle", mycircle_fix, "CellChat")
num_branco  = c(11, 12, 14, 17, 18)
num_esconde = c(2:10, 16:18)

if (!exists("h1_orig")) h1_orig = CellChat:::netVisual_hierarchy1
if (!exists("h2_orig")) h2_orig = CellChat:::netVisual_hierarchy2
set_cex = function(f) {
  src = deparse(f)
  target_lines = grep('"Source", "Target", "Source"', src)
  src[target_lines] = sub("cex = 0.8", paste0("cex = ", st.cex), src[target_lines], fixed = TRUE)
  src[target_lines] = sub('"Source", "Target", "Source"', '"Source", "Target", ""', src[target_lines], fixed = TRUE)
  seta2 = grep("shape::Arrows(arrow.pos2[1]", src, fixed = TRUE)
  src[seta2] = sub("shape::Arrows(", "if (FALSE) shape::Arrows(", src[seta2], fixed = TRUE)
  g = eval(parse(text = src)); environment(g) = environment(f); g
}
h1_mod = set_cex(h1_orig); h2_mod = set_cex(h2_orig)
assignInNamespace("netVisual_hierarchy1", function(..., title.name = NULL) h1_mod(..., title.name = NULL), "CellChat")
assignInNamespace("netVisual_hierarchy2", function(..., title.name = NULL) h2_mod(..., title.name = NULL), "CellChat")

cellchat_nolab = cellchat
dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$prob)[1:2] = list(rep("", nrow(cellchat@net$prob)), rep("", ncol(cellchat@net$prob)))
dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$pval)[1:2] = dimnames(cellchat_nolab@net$prob)[1:2]

nao_MCN = which(!levels(cellchat@idents) %in% Sub_MCN)
cellchat_nolab@net$prob[nao_MCN, , ]  = 0
cellchat_nolab@netP$prob[nao_MCN, , ] = 0
Mix345 = which(levels(cellchat@idents) %in% c("MCNs-Mixed 3", "MCNs-Mixed 4", "MCNs-Mixed 5"))
cellchat_nolab@net$prob[, Mix345, ]  = 0
cellchat_nolab@netP$prob[, Mix345, ] = 0

Sig_pathways_hier = c("SEMA3", "OPIOID", "EPHA", "NGL", "SLIT", "FGF", "PCDH", "ADGRL", "FLRT", "UNC5",
              "Glutamate", "CNTN", "NRG", "ADGRA")
Sig_pathways_hier = intersect(Sig_pathways_hier, cellchat@netP$pathways)
out_dir = "Figures/Fig 3/Control_CellChat/Hierarchy"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (pw in Sig_pathways_hier) {
  pw_dir = file.path(out_dir, pw)
  dir.create(pw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  save_tiff(file.path(pw_dir, paste0(pw, "_aggregate.tiff")),
            netVisual_aggregate(cellchat_nolab, signaling = pw, layout = "hierarchy",
                                vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver,
                                color.use = cols, vertex.weight = 1, vertex.size.max = v.size,
                                title.space = -100))
  pairs = subsetCommunication(cellchat, signaling = pw, sources.use = Sub_MCN)$interaction_name
  for (lr in unique(as.character(pairs))) {
    save_tiff(file.path(pw_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", lr), ".tiff")),
              netVisual_individual(cellchat_nolab, signaling = pw, pairLR.use = lr,
                                   layout = "hierarchy", vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver,
                                   color.use = cols,
                                   vertex.weight = 1, vertex.size.max = v.size))
  }
}
```

```{r Control CellChat - Circle Plots - Fig 3}
library(CellChat)
library(igraph)
Groups_CC = data.frame(
  Order = c("Other Neurons", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPCs", "Immune Cells",
            "Endothelial Cells", "VLMCs", "SMCs", "Pericytes",
            "MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2",
            "MCNs-Mixed 3", "MCNs-Mixed 4", "MCNs-Mixed 5"),
  Num   = 2:18,
  Color = c("#D89000", "#A3A500", "#39B600", "#00BF7D", "#00BFC4", "#00B0F6",
            "#9590FF", "#E76BF3", "#FF62BC",
            "#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf", "#E97E22", "#3e4c5e", "#0e329e"))
Top5 = Groups_CC$Order[10:14]
SON9 = Groups_CC$Order[1:9]
Lv_DB = c(SS = "Secreted Signaling", CC = "Cell-Cell Contact", ECM = "ECM-Receptor", NP = "Non-protein Signaling")

netVisual_circle_fix = CellChat::netVisual_circle
b = body(netVisual_circle_fix)
k = which(sapply(as.list(b), function(e) startsWith(paste(deparse(e), collapse = ""), "loop.angle <-")))
b[[k]] = quote(loop.angle <- atan2(coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 2], coords_scale[igraph::V(g), 1]))
body(netVisual_circle_fix) = b

Circle_2x2 = function(LR, nodes, cross, sizes, file) {
  Mats = lapply(Lv_DB, function(db) Count_Mat(filter(LR, annotation == db), nodes, cross))
  max_w = max(sapply(Mats, max))
  idx = match(nodes, Groups_CC$Order)
  nums = paste0(Groups_CC$Num[idx], ".")
  ang = pi/2 - 2 * pi * (seq_along(nodes) - 1) / length(nodes)
  coords = cbind(cos(ang), sin(ang))
  layout_clockwise = igraph:::layout_spec(function(graph) coords)
  graphics.off()
  tiff(file, width = 10, height = 11, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw")
  tryCatch({
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2), xpd = TRUE)
    for (n in names(Lv_DB)) {
      mat = Mats[[n]]; dimnames(mat) = list(nums, nums)
      if (max(mat) == 0) { plot.new(); mtext(Lv_DB[[n]], side = 3, line = 1.5, cex = 1.3, font = 2); next }
      netVisual_circle_fix(mat, vertex.weight = as.numeric(sizes[nodes]), weight.scale = TRUE,
                           edge.weight.max = max_w, label.edge = FALSE, title.name = NULL,
                           color.use = setNames(Groups_CC$Color[idx], nums), layout = layout_clockwise,
                           vertex.label.color = "transparent", margin = 0.35)
      mtext(Lv_DB[[n]], side = 3, line = 1.5, cex = 1.3, font = 2)
    }
  }, error = function(e) message("Circle plot error: ", e$message), finally = dev.off())
  bind_rows(lapply(names(Mats), function(n) as.data.frame(as.table(Mats[[n]])) %>%
                     setNames(c("source", "target", "n_interactions")) %>% mutate(DB = n))) %>% filter(n_interactions > 0)
}

cellchat = readRDS("RDS/Control_CellChat_SON_MCNs.rds")
Sizes = table(cellchat@idents)
LR = subsetCommunication(cellchat, thresh = 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source = as.character(source), target = as.character(target))
Tab_SON = Circle_2x2(LR, c(Top5, SON9), TRUE, Sizes, "Figures/Fig 3/Control_CellChat/Number_MCNs_SON_SS_CC_ECM_NP.tiff")
Tab_MCN = Circle_2x2(LR, Top5, FALSE, Sizes, "Figures/Fig 3/Control_CellChat/Number_MCNs_MCNs_SS_CC_ECM_NP.tiff")
write.xlsx(list(MCNs_SON = Tab_SON, MCNs_MCNs = Tab_MCN,
                All_LR = LR %>% dplyr::select(source, target, annotation, pathway_name, ligand, receptor, prob, pval)),
           "Excel/Control_CellChat_MCNs_Circle.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Avp/Oxt Classification

```{r Control Classification - Fig 3}
MCN_obj = subset(readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds"), subset = Group == "Control")
dat = expm1(LayerData(MCN_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[c("Avp", "Oxt"), ])
cl  = as.character(MCN_obj$Cluster)
an  = as.character(MCN_obj$orig.ident)
Frac   = function(idx) { s = Matrix::rowSums(dat[, idx, drop = FALSE]); unname(s[1] / sum(s)) }
Classe = function(f) ifelse(f >= 2/3, "AVP", ifelse(f <= 1/3, "OXT", "Mixed"))

Per_animal = map_dfr(Colors_MCN$Order, function(k) {
  idx = split(which(cl == k), an[cl == k])
  tibble(Cluster = k, Animal = names(idx), Nuclei = lengths(idx), Frac = sapply(idx, Frac))
})
Animal_sum = Per_animal %>% filter(Nuclei >= 10) %>% group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(Animals = n(), Mean_animal = mean(Frac), SD_animal = sd(Frac),
            CI95_low  = if (n() > 2) t.test(Frac)$conf.int[1] else NA,
            CI95_high = if (n() > 2) t.test(Frac)$conf.int[2] else NA,
            Min = min(Frac), Max = max(Frac), .groups = "drop")
Classification = tibble(Cluster = Colors_MCN$Order,
                        Nuclei  = sapply(Colors_MCN$Order, function(k) sum(cl == k)),
                        Frac_cluster = sapply(Colors_MCN$Order, function(k) Frac(which(cl == k)))) %>%
  left_join(Animal_sum, by = "Cluster") %>%
  mutate(Class = Classe(Frac_cluster), Class_animal_mean = Classe(Mean_animal))
Classification
write.xlsx(list(Classification = Classification, Per_animal = Per_animal),
           "Excel/Control_MCNs_AvpOxt_Classification.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r GO - Fig 4}
Markers = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

Son = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
Idents(Son) = "Cluster"

wb = createWorkbook()
for(i in c(intersect(All_MCN, unique(Markers$cell_type)),
           setdiff(unique(Markers$cell_type), All_MCN))){
  Run = data.frame()
  for(y in c("Total","Positive","Negative")){
    DataFrame = data.frame()
    if(y == "Total"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i)
    }
    if(y == "Positive"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i & avg_log2FC > 0.25)
    }
     if(y == "Negative"){
      List = subset(Markers, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & cell_type == i & avg_log2FC < -0.25)
     }
    Test = try(bitr(List$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db"))
    if(length(List$gene) >= 1 & !inherits(Test, "try-error")){
      List = bitr(List$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
      Data = Expressed(Son, cluster_id = i)
      Data = bitr(Data, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Rn.eg.db")
      for (x in c("BP","MF","CC")) {
       GO = enrichGO(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                      universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                              OrgDb         = org.Rn.eg.db,
                              ont           = x,
                              pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                              pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                              qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                              readable      = TRUE)
              if(!is.null(GO)){
              X_GO = data.frame(GO@result)
              X_GO$Analyses = x
              DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_GO)}
            }
      KEGG = enrichKEGG(gene     = as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                        universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                         organism     = "rno" ,
                         pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
      if(!is.null(KEGG)){
      X_KEGG = data.frame(KEGG@result)
      X_KEGG$Analyses = "KEGG"
      DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, X_KEGG)}
      Reactome = enrichPathway(gene=as.numeric(List$ENTREZID),
                               universe = as.character(Data$ENTREZID),
                               pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                               readable=TRUE, organism = "rat")
      if(!is.null(Reactome)){
      Reactome = Reactome@result
      Reactome$Analyses = "Reactome"
      DataFrame = bind_rows(DataFrame, Reactome)}
      DataFrame = DataFrame %>% arrange(Analyses,p.adjust)
      if(length(DataFrame$subcategory) == 0){
        DataFrame$category = NA
        DataFrame$subcategory = NA
      }
      DataFrame$DEGs = y
      Run = rbind(DataFrame, Run)
  }
    }
    Run$Cluster = i
    print(i)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = i)
    writeData(wb, sheet = i, Run, startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = "Excel/Magnos_Osmotic_Markers_GO.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r Jitter - Fig 4}
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

FC_cut   = 0.25
padj_cut = 0.05
n_up     = 3
n_down   = 3
Cols_OS =data.frame(Order = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2"),
                      Color = c("#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf"),
                      Num   = 11:15)
Clusters_OS = Cols_OS$Order

set.seed(4301)
DE_mcn = read.xlsx("Excel/Magnos_Osmotic_Markers.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > FC_cut, cell_type %in% Clusters_OS) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Cols_OS[, c("Order", "Color")], by = c("cell_type" = "Order")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = Clusters_OS),
                sig       = p_val_adj < padj_cut,
                sig_PB    = sig & !is.na(padj_pseudobulk) & padj_pseudobulk < padj_cut &
                            sign(log2FC_pseudobulk) == sign(avg_log2FC),
                Color     = ifelse(sig, Color, "grey"),
                x_jit     = as.numeric(cell_type) + runif(dplyr::n(), -0.2, 0.2))
table(DE_mcn$cell_type, MAST = DE_mcn$sig, Pseudobulk = DE_mcn$sig_PB)

Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Tree_mcn = DE_mcn %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig, !grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = sign(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, direction) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(avg_log2FC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rank <= ifelse(dplyr::first(direction) > 0, n_up, n_down)) %>%
  ungroup()

x_lim_mcn = c(0.5, length(Clusters_OS) + 0.5)
y_top = max(DE_mcn$avg_log2FC)

p_mcn = ggplot(DE_mcn, aes(x = x_jit, y = avg_log2FC)) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(DE_mcn, !sig), colour = "grey", shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(DE_mcn, sig & !sig_PB), aes(colour = Color), shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(DE_mcn, sig_PB), aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black",
                  stroke = 0.3, size = 1.8, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Tree_mcn, aes(label = gene),
                  fontface = "italic", size = 3, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  annotate("point", x = c(0.75, 0.75), y = y_top * c(1.22, 1.14), shape = c(1, 21),
           colour = c("grey30", "black"), fill = c(NA, "grey30"), size = c(1.5, 1.8)) +
  annotate("text", x = c(0.85, 0.85), y = y_top * c(1.22, 1.14), hjust = 0, size = 3.2,
           label = c("MAST", "MAST + Pseudobulk (edgeR)")) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_mcn, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.04))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"))

balls_mcn = data.frame(x = seq_along(Clusters_OS), Num = Cols_OS$Num, Color = Cols_OS$Color)
balls_mcn$Txt = ifelse(balls_mcn$Num %in% c(11, 12, 14), "white", "black")

axis_mcn = ggplot(balls_mcn, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, size = 10) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_mcn, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void()

p_mcn_final = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_mcn, axis_mcn, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.08))
p_mcn_final
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/Magnos_Osmotic_Markers.tiff", plot = p_mcn_final,
       width = 6.5, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r AVP Fraction WD - Fig 4}
library(patchwork)
MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
Cl_F = Colors_MCN$Order
GroupCols = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")
dat = expm1(LayerData(MCN_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[c("Avp", "Oxt"), ])
meta = MCN_obj[[]] %>% transmute(Cell = colnames(MCN_obj), Cluster = as.character(Cluster), Group, Animal = orig.ident)
rm(MCN_obj); gc()
meta$Avp = dat["Avp", meta$Cell]; meta$Oxt = dat["Oxt", meta$Cell]
rm(dat); gc()

Frac_G = meta %>% filter(Cluster %in% Cl_F) %>% group_by(Cluster, Group) %>%
  summarise(Frac = mean(Avp) / (mean(Avp) + mean(Oxt)), Nuclei = n(), .groups = "drop")
Frac_A = meta %>% filter(Cluster %in% Cl_F) %>% group_by(Cluster, Group, Animal) %>%
  summarise(Frac = mean(Avp) / (mean(Avp) + mean(Oxt)), Nuclei = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(Nuclei >= 10)
Test_F = Frac_A %>% group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(Control = mean(Frac[Group == "Control"]), WD = mean(Frac[Group == "WD"]),
            p = tryCatch(t.test(Frac ~ Group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH"), Label = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***", FDR < 0.01 ~ "**", FDR < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))
Test_F
write.xlsx(list(Pooled = Frac_G, Per_animal = Frac_A, Tests = Test_F), "Excel/AVP_Fraction_Control_vs_WD.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Frac_G = Frac_G %>% mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = rev(Cl_F)))
Lab_F = Frac_G %>% select(Cluster, Group, Frac) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Frac) %>%
  left_join(Test_F %>% select(Cluster, Label), by = "Cluster") %>%
  mutate(Label = replace_na(Label, ""),
         Txt = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Control), " → ", sprintf("%.2f", WD), " ", Label),
         Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = rev(Cl_F)))
Grad = expand.grid(x = seq(0.0025, 0.9975, by = 0.005), Cluster = rev(Cl_F)) %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = rev(Cl_F)))

P_Bar_WD = ggplot(Frac_G, aes(y = Cluster)) +
  geom_tile(data = Grad, aes(x = x, fill = x), width = 0.006, height = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_tile(data = Lab_F, aes(x = 0.5), width = 1, height = 0.6, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1/3, 2/3), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = c(1/6, 1/2, 5/6), y = Inf, label = c("OXT", "Mixed", "AVP"), vjust = -0.6, size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Frac, xend = Frac, y = as.numeric(Cluster) - 0.42, yend = as.numeric(Cluster) + 0.42),
               colour = "white", linewidth = 2.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Frac, xend = Frac, y = as.numeric(Cluster) - 0.42, yend = as.numeric(Cluster) + 0.42,
                   colour = Group), linewidth = 1.6) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", "#F7F7F7",
                                   "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B"), limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = GroupCols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(Cl_F)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = expression(italic(Avp) ~ "fraction" ~ "[" * italic(Avp) / (italic(Avp) + italic(Oxt)) * "]"), y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
        plot.margin  = margin(20, 8, 5.5, 0))

Dots_F =tibble(Cluster = factor(Cl_F, levels = rev(Cl_F)), Num = 10 + seq_along(Cl_F), Color = Colors_MCN$Color)
rgb_f = col2rgb(Dots_F$Color)
Dots_F$Txt = ifelse((0.299 * rgb_f[1, ] + 0.587 * rgb_f[2, ] + 0.114 * rgb_f[3, ]) / 255 > 0.5, "black", "white")
P_Dot_WD = ggplot(Dots_F, aes(x = 0, y = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, size = 8, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_identity() + scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(Cl_F)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 0.3), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 0, 5.5, 5.5))

P_Dot_WD + P_Bar_WD + plot_layout(widths = c(0.18, 1))
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/Barplot_AVP_frac_Control_WD.tiff", width = 2.9, height = 5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

leg = data.frame(num = seq_along(Cl_F), name = paste0(10 + seq_along(Cl_F), ".", Cl_F), colour = Colors_MCN$Color)
pdf(NULL); par(ps = txt_size * .pt)
width_name = strwidth(leg$name, units = "inches")
invisible(dev.off())
leg$width = 2 * r + dist + width_name + gap
leg$x = cumsum(c(0, head(leg$width, -1)))
total = sum(leg$width) - gap + r + 2 * mrg
ggplot(leg, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
```

## Correlation Between Markers and WD Effect

```{r Corr Marker WD - Fig 4}
Osmotic = read.xlsx("Excel/Magnos_Osmotic_Markers.xlsx")
Osmotic = subset(Osmotic, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)
Osmotic$Unique = paste0(Osmotic$gene,Osmotic$cell_type)
Osmotic = data.frame(LOG2_WD = Osmotic$avg_log2FC, 
                     PADJ_WD = Osmotic$p_val_adj,
                     Unique = Osmotic$Unique)

Marker = read.xlsx("Excel/Control_Magnos_Markers.xlsx")
Marker = subset(Marker, subset = p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)
Marker$Unique = paste0(Marker$gene,Marker$cluster)
Marker = data.frame(Gene = Marker$gene, LOG2_Marker = Marker$avg_log2FC, 
                     PADJ_Marker = Marker$p_val_adj, Cluster = Marker$cluster, 
                     Unique = Marker$Unique)
Marker = subset(Marker, subset = Marker$Unique %in% Osmotic$Unique)
Marker = left_join(Marker, Osmotic, by = "Unique")
Marker$Unique = NULL
Cols_Corr = data.frame(Order = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2"),
                        Color = c("#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf"),
                        Num   = 11:15)
Marker = subset(Marker, subset = Cluster %in% Cols_Corr$Order)

Spearman = Marker %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_genes = dplyr::n(),
                   rho = cor.test(LOG2_Marker, LOG2_WD, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$estimate,
                   p   = cor.test(LOG2_Marker, LOG2_WD, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Cluster, Cols_Corr$Order))
write.xlsx(list(Spearman = Spearman, Genes = Marker),
           "Excel/Correlation/Correlation_Markers_WDEffect_Magnos.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Marker$Cluster = factor(Marker$Cluster, levels = Cols_Corr$Order)
xr = range(Marker$LOG2_Marker); yr = range(Marker$LOG2_WD)
Leg_rho = Cols_Corr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rho = Spearman$rho[match(Order, Spearman$Cluster)],
                Txt = ifelse(Num %in% c(11, 12, 14), "white", "black"),
                x   = xr[1] + 0.04 * diff(xr),
                y   = yr[2] - (dplyr::row_number() - 1) * 0.085 * diff(yr),
                rho_txt = paste0("ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", rho)))

p_corr = ggplot(Marker, aes(x = LOG2_Marker, y = LOG2_WD, colour = Cluster)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = Cluster), method = "lm", se = FALSE, formula = y ~ x,
              colour = "white", linewidth = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, formula = y ~ x, linewidth = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(Cols_Corr$Color, Cols_Corr$Order)) +
  geom_point(data = Leg_rho, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Color), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, size = 6, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(Leg_rho, Txt == "white"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = Num),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "white", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(Leg_rho, Txt == "black"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = Num),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = Leg_rho, aes(x = x + 0.05 * diff(xr), y = y, label = rho_txt), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, size = 3.8) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(x = "Log2FC Enrichment (Control marker)", y = "Log2FC in Response to WD") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
        legend.position = "none")
p_corr
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/Corr_Marker_WDEffect.tiff", plot = p_corr, width = 3.9, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

## Activity

```{r Dif Analyses - Fig 4}
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)

Cols_Act = data.frame(Order = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2"),
                       Color = c("#4183D7", "#C0392B", "#FFC300", "#9A11D9", "#57d9bf"),
                       Num   = 11:15,
                       Txt   = c("white", "white", "black", "white", "black"))

MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
Act = read.xlsx("Excel/NeuroEstimator_Results.xlsx")
Act$Cell = gsub("\\.", "-", Act$Cell)
MCN_obj$predicted_activity = setNames(Act$predicted_activity, Act$Cell)[colnames(MCN_obj)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(MCN_obj$predicted_activity))

Activity = data.frame(Cell = colnames(MCN_obj),
                      Cluster = as.character(MCN_obj$Cluster),
                      Osmotic = as.character(MCN_obj$Group),
                      Animal = as.character(MCN_obj$orig.ident),
                      predicted_activity = MCN_obj$predicted_activity) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cluster %in% Cols_Act$Order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Osmotic = factor(Osmotic, levels = c("Control", "WD")),
                Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = Cols_Act$Order))

# 1. Wilcoxon
wilc = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  wilcox_test(predicted_activity ~ Osmotic) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, group1, group2, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# 2. Medians per group
meds = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Osmotic, values_from = med) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(diff_medianas = WD - Control)

# 3. Number of nuclei
n_cells = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Osmotic, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_")

# 4. Effect size
effsize = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(predicted_activity ~ Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, effsize, magnitude)

# 5. Per animal
animal = Activity %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Animal, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Control_animals = mean(med[Osmotic == "Control"]), WD_animals = mean(med[Osmotic == "WD"]),
                   n_animals_Control = sum(Osmotic == "Control"), n_animals_WD = sum(Osmotic == "WD"),
                   p_animal = t.test(med ~ Osmotic)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_animal_adj = p.adjust(p_animal, "BH"))

final_df = wilc %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meds, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(n_cells, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(effsize, by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(animal, by = "Cluster")
final_df
write.xlsx(final_df %>% dplyr::select(Cluster, n_Control, n_WD, n_animals_Control, n_animals_WD, Control_animals, WD_animals, p_animal, p_animal_adj),
           "Excel/Activity_Sig_MCN_Subtypes.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Animal_act4 = Activity %>% group_by(Cluster, Animal, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(predicted_activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = as.numeric(Cluster))
Bars_act4 = Animal_act4 %>% group_by(Cluster, Osmotic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(med), sem = sd(med) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = as.numeric(Cluster))
Sig = final_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_animal_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Cluster, Label = "*") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Animal_act4 %>% group_by(Cluster) %>% dplyr::summarise(y = max(med) * 1.06), by = "Cluster") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = as.numeric(Cluster))
write.xlsx(list(Animal = Animal_act4, Mean_SEM_animals = Bars_act4), "Excel/Activity_Barplot_MCN_Subtypes.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
x_lim_act = c(0.5, nrow(Cols_Act) + 0.5)

dodge = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
p_act = ggplot(Bars_act4, aes(x = x, y = mean, fill = Osmotic)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), position = dodge, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = Animal_act4, aes(x = x, y = med, group = Osmotic), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 42),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.1, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = Sig, aes(x = x - 0.2, xend = x + 0.2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = Sig, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, vjust = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_act, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(y = "Predicted Activity Score") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none")

axis_act = ggplot(Cols_Act, aes(x = seq_along(Order), y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.5, size = 6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_act, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void()

p_act_final = p_act / axis_act + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.08))
p_act_final
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/Activity_Plot_Slide.tiff", plot = p_act_final, width = 3.2, height = 3,
       dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r CorrPlot Activity Subtypes}
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)

IEGs = c("Arc", "Btg2", "Coq10b", "Crem", "Dusp1", "Dusp5", "Egr1", "Egr3",
         "Fbxo33", "Fos", "Fosl2", "Gadd45g", "Gmeb2", "Grasp", "Junb",
         "Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Per1", "Rgs2", "Sertad1", "Tiparp")
Highlight = c("Avp", "Oxt", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1", "Giot1")
Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"

Corr_all = bind_rows(lapply(Cols_Act$Order, function(cl) {
  cells = colnames(MCN_obj)[MCN_obj$Cluster == cl]
  Data  = LayerData(MCN_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[, cells]
  Data  = Data[Matrix::rowMeans(Data > 0) >= 0.10, ]         
  Data  = as.matrix(Data[!rownames(Data) %in% IEGs, ])
  act   = MCN_obj$predicted_activity[cells]
  n     = length(act)
  Rho   = cor(t(Data), act, method = "spearman")[, 1]
  Tst   = Rho * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - Rho^2))
  data.frame(Cluster = cl, Gene = names(Rho), Rho = Rho, P = 2 * pt(-abs(Tst), df = n - 2)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rho)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Rho)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number(), Sig = P_adj < 0.05 & abs(Rho) >= 0.1)
}))
dplyr::count(Corr_all, Cluster, Sig)

dir.create("Excel/Correlation", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.xlsx(split(Corr_all, factor(Corr_all$Cluster, levels = Cols_Act$Order)),
           "Excel/Correlation/Activity_MCN_Subtypes_Corr.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

#Jitter
set.seed(4301)
Corr_all = Corr_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x     = match(Cluster, Cols_Act$Order),
                x_jit = x + runif(dplyr::n(), -0.2, 0.2),
                Color = ifelse(Sig, Cols_Act$Color[x], "grey"))

Label = Corr_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sig, !grepl(Non_official, Gene), !grepl("^Mt-", Gene)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = sign(Rho)) %>%
  group_by(Cluster, direction) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(Rho)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() <= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

x_lim_ca = c(0.5, nrow(Cols_Act) + 0.5)

p_corr_act = ggplot(Corr_all, aes(x = x_jit, y = Rho)) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(Corr_all, !Sig), colour = "grey", shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(Corr_all, Sig), aes(colour = Color), shape = 1, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Label, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "italic", size = 3, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.4,
                  point.padding = 0.15, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_ca, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = expression("Spearman's " * rho * " with activity")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"))

axis_ca = ggplot(Cols_Act, aes(x = seq_along(Order), y = 0)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Color), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.5, size = 6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Num, colour = Txt), size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim_ca, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void()

p_corr_act_final = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_corr_act, axis_ca, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.08))
p_corr_act_final
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/MCN_Subtypes_Activity_Corr_Slide.tiff", plot = p_corr_act_final, width = 4.4, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r Activity Depth Check}
Act_all = read.xlsx("Excel/NeuroEstimator_Results.xlsx")
Act_all = setNames(Act_all$predicted_activity, gsub("\\.", "-", Act_all$Cell))
M_son = readRDS("RDS/Son.rds")[[]]
M_mcn = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")[[]]
D_dep = bind_rows(
  M_son %>% filter(Cluster %in% c("MCNs", "Other Neurons")) %>%
    transmute(Cell = rownames(.), Cluster = as.character(Cluster), Group, Animal = orig.ident, nCount_RNA, Level = "SON"),
  M_mcn %>% filter(Cluster %in% Colors_MCN$Order[1:5]) %>%
    transmute(Cell = rownames(.), Cluster = as.character(Cluster), Group, Animal = orig.ident, nCount_RNA, Level = "MCN subtypes")) %>%
  mutate(Activity = unname(Act_all[Cell]), logUMI = log10(nCount_RNA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Activity))
rm(M_son, M_mcn); gc()

Depth = D_dep %>% group_by(Level, Cluster) %>% group_modify(function(d, k) {
  d$Resid = resid(lm(Activity ~ logUMI, data = d))
  A = d %>% group_by(Animal, Group) %>% summarise(Raw = median(Activity), Adj = median(Resid), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(rho_UMI = cor(d$Activity, d$logUMI, method = "spearman"),
         rho_UMI_Control = cor(d$Activity[d$Group == "Control"], d$logUMI[d$Group == "Control"], method = "spearman"),
         UMI_ratio_WD_Control = median(d$nCount_RNA[d$Group == "WD"]) / median(d$nCount_RNA[d$Group == "Control"]),
         p_animal_raw = t.test(Raw ~ Group, data = A)$p.value,
         p_animal_depth_adj = t.test(Adj ~ Group, data = A)$p.value,
         Diff_raw = mean(A$Raw[A$Group == "WD"]) - mean(A$Raw[A$Group == "Control"]),
         Diff_depth_adj = mean(A$Adj[A$Group == "WD"]) - mean(A$Adj[A$Group == "Control"]))
}) %>% group_by(Level) %>%
  mutate(FDR_raw = p.adjust(p_animal_raw, "BH"), FDR_depth_adj = p.adjust(p_animal_depth_adj, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
as.data.frame(Depth)
write.xlsx(Depth, "Excel/Activity_Depth_Check.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

## CellChat

```{r CellChat}
library(CellChat)
library(igraph)
Top5 = Groups_CC$Order[10:14]
SON9 = Groups_CC$Order[1:9]
Lv_DB = c(SS = "Secreted Signaling", CC = "Cell-Cell Contact", ECM = "ECM-Receptor", NP = "Non-protein Signaling")

merged = readRDS("Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CellChat_SON_MCNs_Merged.rds")
LR_g = lapply(c(Control = "Control", WD = "WD"), function(G)
  subsetCommunication(readRDS(paste0("Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CellChat_SON_MCNs_", G, ".rds")), thresh = 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = as.character(source), target = as.character(target)))

Diff_2x2 = function(nodes, cross, file) {
  MC = lapply(Lv_DB, function(db) Count_Mat(filter(LR_g$Control, annotation == db), nodes, cross))
  MW = lapply(Lv_DB, function(db) Count_Mat(filter(LR_g$WD, annotation == db), nodes, cross))
  max_w = max(sapply(names(Lv_DB), function(n) max(abs(MW[[n]] - MC[[n]]))))
  idx = match(nodes, Groups_CC$Order)
  ang = pi/2 - 2 * pi * (seq_along(nodes) - 1) / length(nodes)
  coords = cbind(cos(ang), sin(ang))
  layout_clockwise = igraph:::layout_spec(function(graph) coords)
  graphics.off()
  tiff(file, width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw", type = "cairo")
  tryCatch({
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2), xpd = TRUE)
    for (n in names(Lv_DB)) {
      cc = merged
      cc@net = list(Control = list(count = MC[[n]]), WD = list(count = MW[[n]]))
      if (max(abs(MW[[n]] - MC[[n]])) == 0) { plot.new(); mtext(Lv_DB[[n]], side = 3, line = 1.5, cex = 1.3, font = 2); next }
      netVisual_diffInteraction_New(cc, measure = "count", weight.scale = TRUE, edge.weight.max = max_w,
                                    color.use = Groups_CC$Color[idx], layout = layout_clockwise)
      mtext(Lv_DB[[n]], side = 3, line = 1.5, cex = 1.3, font = 2)
    }
  }, error = function(e) message("Circle plot error: ", e$message), finally = dev.off())
  bind_rows(lapply(names(Lv_DB), function(n) {
    full_join(as.data.frame(as.table(MC[[n]])) %>% setNames(c("source", "target", "Control")),
              as.data.frame(as.table(MW[[n]])) %>% setNames(c("source", "target", "WD")), by = c("source", "target")) %>%
      mutate(DB = n, Diff_WD_Control = WD - Control)
  })) %>% filter(Control > 0 | WD > 0)
}
Tab_SON = Diff_2x2(c(Top5, SON9), TRUE, "Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CirclePlot_MCNs_SON_Dif_SS_CC_ECM_NP.tiff")
Tab_MCN = Diff_2x2(Top5, FALSE, "Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CirclePlot_MCNs_MCNs_Dif_SS_CC_ECM_NP.tiff")
write.xlsx(list(MCNs_SON = Tab_SON, MCNs_MCNs = Tab_MCN), "Excel/CellChat_MCNs_Circle_Control_vs_WD.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r CellChat MCNs - Fig 4}
library(CellChat)
Top5 = Groups_CC$Order[10:14]
SON9 = Groups_CC$Order[1:9]
Abbrev = c("Secreted Signaling" = "SS", "Cell-Cell Contact" = "CC", "ECM-Receptor" = "ECM", "Non-protein Signaling" = "NP")
ann = CellChatDB.mouse$interaction
ann = ann[ann$annotation %in% names(Abbrev), ]
DB_map = sapply(split(ann$annotation, ann$pathway_name), function(x) Abbrev[[names(which.max(table(x)))]])
Group_Colors = c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F")

cellchat = readRDS("Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CellChat_SON_MCNs_Merged.rds")
Sets = list("MCNs to SON" = list(s = Top5, t = SON9), "SON to MCNs" = list(s = SON9, t = Top5),
            "MCNs to MCNs" = list(s = Top5, t = Top5))
MCN_Flow = map_dfr(names(Sets), function(Dir) {
  df = tryCatch(rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE,
                        sources.use = Sets[[Dir]]$s, targets.use = Sets[[Dir]]$t,
                        color.use = unname(Group_Colors), return.data = TRUE)$signaling.contribution,
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df %>% transmute(name = as.character(name), group = as.character(group), contribution, pvalues, Direction = Dir)
})
MCN_Wide = MCN_Flow %>%
  group_by(Direction, name) %>%
  summarise(Control = sum(contribution[group == "Control"]), WD = sum(contribution[group == "WD"]),
            p = suppressWarnings(min(pvalues, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(DB = unname(DB_map[name]),
         log2FC = log2((WD + 1e-6) / (Control + 1e-6)),
         Sig    = is.finite(p) & p < 0.05,
         Change = ifelse(WD > Control, "Up in WD", "Down in WD"))
MCN_Wide %>% filter(Sig) %>% count(Direction, Change)
write.xlsx(MCN_Wide, "Excel/CellChat_MCNs_Subtypes_Pathways_WD.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

Plot_MCN = MCN_Wide %>%
  filter(Sig) %>%
  group_by(Direction, Change) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2FC = pmax(pmin(log2FC, 6), -6),
         Key    = paste(Direction, paste0(name, " [", DB, "]"), sep = "__"),
         Key    = reorder(Key, log2FC),
         Direction = factor(Direction, levels = names(Sets)))

ggplot(Plot_MCN, aes(x = log2FC, y = Key, fill = Change)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Down in WD" = "#25838E", "Up in WD" = "#D43D4F")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*__", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6, 6), breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6),
                     labels = c("≤-6", "-3", "0", "3", "≥6")) +
  labs(x = expression(atop(log[2]~"(WD / Control)", "information flow")), y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10.8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10.8),
        axis.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13.5),
        strip.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12.6),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
ggsave("Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/MCNs_Pathways_WD.tiff", width = 3.9, height = 10, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r CellChat - Table}
library(openxlsx)
cellchat = readRDS("Figures/Fig 4/CellChat/CellChat_SON_MCNs_Merged.rds")
MCNs = Groups_CC$Order[10:17]

Abbrev = c("Secreted Signaling" = "SS", "Cell-Cell Contact" = "CC", "ECM-Receptor" = "ECM", "Non-protein Signaling" = "NP")
ann = CellChatDB.mouse$interaction
ann = ann[ann$annotation %in% names(Abbrev), ]
DB_map = sapply(split(ann$annotation, ann$pathway_name), function(x) Abbrev[[names(which.max(table(x)))]])

Sig_pathways = subsetCommunication(cellchat, slot.name = "netP", thresh = 0.05)
Sig_pathways = lapply(names(Sig_pathways), function(g) {
  x = Sig_pathways[[g]][, c("source", "target", "pathway_name", "prob", "pval")]
  x[] = lapply(x, function(v) if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else v)
  colnames(x)[4:5] = paste0(c("prob_", "pval_"), g)
  x
})
Tab = merge(Sig_pathways[[1]], Sig_pathways[[2]], by = c("source", "target", "pathway_name"), all = TRUE)
Tab$prob_Control[is.na(Tab$prob_Control)] = 0
Tab$prob_WD[is.na(Tab$prob_WD)] = 0

Tab$DB = unname(DB_map[Tab$pathway_name])
Tab$Diff_WD_vs_Control = Tab$prob_WD - Tab$prob_Control
Tab$log2FC_WD_vs_Control = ifelse(Tab$prob_Control > 0 & Tab$prob_WD > 0,
                                  log2(Tab$prob_WD / Tab$prob_Control), NA)
Tab$Status = with(Tab, ifelse(prob_Control == 0, "WD only",
                       ifelse(prob_WD == 0, "Control only",
                       ifelse(prob_WD > prob_Control, "Up in WD",
                       ifelse(prob_WD < prob_Control, "Down in WD", "Unchanged")))))

Tab$source = factor(Tab$source, levels = Groups_CC$Order)
Tab$target = factor(Tab$target, levels = Groups_CC$Order)
Tab = Tab[order(Tab$source, Tab$target, -abs(Tab$Diff_WD_vs_Control)),
          c("source", "target", "pathway_name", "DB", "prob_Control", "pval_Control",
            "prob_WD", "pval_WD", "Diff_WD_vs_Control", "log2FC_WD_vs_Control", "Status")]
rownames(Tab) = NULL
table(Tab$Status)

Overview = as.data.frame.matrix(table(paste(Tab$source, "->", Tab$target), Tab$Status))

write.xlsx(list(All = Tab,
                MCNs_Sending = Tab[Tab$source %in% MCNs, ],
                MCNs_Receiving = Tab[Tab$target %in% MCNs, ],
                Summary = cbind(Pair = rownames(Overview), Overview)),
           "Excel/CellChat_SON_MCNs_Pathways_Control_vs_WD.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r Total Trajectory - Fig 4}
                paste0(Out, "/Total_Trajectory_Nodes_Subtype.tiff"), width = 6.5, height = 5, breaks = Top5_MCN)
Plot_Trajectory(Tr_T, emb, "Group", c(Control = "#25838E", WD = "#D43D4F"),
                paste0(Out, "/Total_Trajectory_Nodes_Group.tiff"), width = 6, height = 5)

Seg_WD = Tr_T$Cells %>% count(Segment, Group, Animal) %>%
  complete(Segment, nesting(Group, Animal), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(Animal) %>% mutate(Frac = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Segment) %>%
  summarise(Control = mean(Frac[Group == "Control"]), WD = mean(Frac[Group == "WD"]),
            p = tryCatch(t.test(Frac ~ Group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log2_WD_Control = log2((WD + 0.01) / (Control + 0.01)), FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
  arrange(FDR)
Seg_WD
write.xlsx(list(Nodes = Tr_T$Nodes, Segment_Composition = Tr_T$Composition, Segment_WD = Seg_WD),
           "Excel/Trajectory/Total_MCNs_Trajectory_Nodes.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Fig 5 - Giot1

## Giot1 Correlation (MCNs-Avp 2, WD)

```{r Giot1 - Correlation}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)
dir.create("Excel/Giot1", showWarnings = FALSE)
Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Highlight = c("Avp", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1", "Pdyn")

MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
cells = colnames(MCN_obj)[MCN_obj$Cluster == "MCNs-Avp 2" & MCN_obj$Group == "WD"]
Data  = LayerData(MCN_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[, cells]
rm(MCN_obj); gc()
x     = as.numeric(Data["Giot1", ])
Data  = Data[Matrix::rowMeans(Data > 0) >= 0.10, ]
Data  = as.matrix(Data[rownames(Data) != "Giot1", ])
n     = length(x)
Rho   = cor(t(Data), x, method = "spearman")[, 1]
Tst   = Rho * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - Rho^2))
Corr = data.frame(Cluster = "MCNs-Avp 2", Target = "Giot1", Gene = names(Rho), Rho = Rho,
                  P = 2 * pt(-abs(Tst), df = n - 2)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rho)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P, method = "BH"), Sig = P_adj < 0.05 & abs(Rho) >= 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Rho))
table(Corr$Sig, sign(Corr$Rho))
write.xlsx(Corr, "Excel/Giot1/Avp2_Giot1_Corr.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

set.seed(4301)
Corr = Corr %>% dplyr::mutate(x_jit = 1 + runif(dplyr::n(), -0.2, 0.2),
                              Color = ifelse(Sig, "#C0392B", "grey"))
Lab = Corr %>% dplyr::filter(Sig, !grepl(Non_official, Gene)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = sign(Rho)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(Rho), n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  bind_rows(Corr %>% dplyr::filter(Sig, Gene %in% Highlight)) %>% distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
p_g1 = ggplot(Corr, aes(x = x_jit, y = Rho)) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(Corr, !Sig), colour = "grey", shape = 1, size = 0.8, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_point_rast(data = dplyr::filter(Corr, Sig), aes(colour = Color), shape = 1, size = 0.8, raster.dpi = 300) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Lab, aes(label = Gene), fontface = "italic", size = 5 / .pt,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.25,
                  point.padding = 0.1, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = bquote("Spearman's " * rho * " with " * italic(Giot1))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black"))
axis_g1 = ggplot(data.frame(x = 1), aes(x, 0)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "#C0392B", colour = "black", stroke = 0.3, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(label = "12", colour = "white", size = 1.9, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = -1.1, label = "MCNs-Avp 2", size = 6 / .pt) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.4, 0.5), clip = "off") + theme_void()
ggsave("Figures/Fig 5/Giot1/A_Giot1_Avp2_Corr.tiff", patchwork::wrap_plots(p_g1, axis_g1, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.12)),
       width = 1.4, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

## Giot1 in the MCNs-M6 Module

```{r Giot1 - M6 Hub}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(hdWGCNA)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
Out = "Figures/Fig 5/Giot1"
dir.create(Out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Key = c("Giot1", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1")

Mods = read.xlsx("Excel/hdWGCNA_MCNs_Modules.xlsx", "Modules")
Corr = read.xlsx("Excel/Giot1/Avp2_Giot1_Corr.xlsx")
Corr_up = Corr$Gene[Corr$Sig & Corr$Rho > 0]
M6 = Mods %>% filter(module == "MCN-M6") %>% transmute(gene = gene_name, kME = `kME_MCN-M6`) %>%
  arrange(desc(kME)) %>% mutate(kME_rank = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(Corr %>% select(gene = Gene, Rho, P_adj, Sig), by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(Class = ifelse(!is.na(Sig) & Sig, "Corr", "Other"))
M6 %>% filter(gene %in% Key)

U = Corr$Gene
ft = fisher.test(table(factor(U %in% M6$gene, c(TRUE, FALSE)), factor(U %in% Corr_up, c(TRUE, FALSE))),
                 alternative = "greater")
D = M6 %>% filter(!is.na(Rho))
ct = cor.test(D$kME, D$Rho, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
Stats = tibble(Test = c("MCNs-M6 genes x genes correlated with Giot1 (Fisher, one-sided)",
                        "kME in MCNs-M6 x rho with Giot1 (Spearman)"),
               Estimate = c(unname(ft$estimate), unname(ct$estimate)), p = c(ft$p.value, ct$p.value),
               n = c(length(U), nrow(D)), Overlap = c(sum(U %in% M6$gene & U %in% Corr_up), NA))
Stats

genes = M6 %>% filter(!grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>% slice_head(n = 25) %>% pull(gene)
genes = c(genes, setdiff(Key, genes))

Lab_F = D %>% filter(Class == "Corr", !grepl(Non_official, gene))
Txt_F = sprintf("Spearman ρ = %.2f, p = %.3f\nOverlap: OR = %.1f, p = %.0e",
                ct$estimate, ct$p.value, ft$estimate, ft$p.value)
pF = ggplot(D, aes(kME, Rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(D, Class == "Other"), colour = "grey75", size = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = filter(D, Class == "Corr"), fill = "#C0392B", shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.2, size = 1.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Lab_F, aes(label = gene), fontface = "italic",
                  size = 5 / .pt, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                  box.padding = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  annotate("text", x = min(D$kME), y = max(D$Rho), label = Txt_F, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.5 / .pt) +
  labs(x = "kME in MCNs-M6 (module membership)", y = expression("Spearman's " * rho * " with " * italic(Giot1)),
       subtitle = expression("Higher module membership " %->% " stronger coupling to " * italic(Giot1))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6.5, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0, 0, 3, 0)))
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/C_Giot1_Corr_vs_kME.tiff"), pF, width = 3.6, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
PB = Pseudobulk_WD(MCN_obj)$Res
rm(MCN_obj); gc()
Sub = Types_MCN %>% filter(Order %in% c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2")) %>%
  mutate(x = row_number(), Txt = Txt_Col(Color))
Ord = M6 %>% filter(gene %in% genes) %>% pull(gene)
G = expand_grid(gene = Ord, cell_type = Sub$Order) %>%
  left_join(PB %>% select(gene, cell_type, log2FC, FDR), by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(Ord)), x = match(cell_type, Sub$Order),
         Star = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***", FDR < 0.01 ~ "**", FDR < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))
G = G %>% group_by(gene) %>% mutate(Mean = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>% mutate(Rank = rank(-log2FC, na.last = "keep")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(as.character(gene), levels = names(sort(tapply(Mean, as.character(gene), unique)))),
         Sig = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05)
G %>% filter(gene %in% Key) %>% arrange(gene, x)
Rk = G %>% filter(gene == "Giot1") %>% pull(Rank)
Txt_G = paste0("Giot1: most induced hub in ", sum(Rk == 1), "/", length(Rk),
               " subtypes, 2nd in ", sum(Rk == 2), "/", length(Rk))
Face_G = ifelse(levels(G$gene) %in% Key, "bold.italic", "italic")
Col_G = ifelse(levels(G$gene) %in% Key, "#C0392B", "black")
Mean_G = G %>% distinct(gene, Mean)
pG = ggplot(G, aes(log2FC, gene)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = Mean_G, aes(x = 0, xend = Mean, y = gene, yend = gene), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = cell_type, colour = Sig), shape = 21, size = 1.3, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = Mean_G, aes(x = Mean, y = gene), shape = 23, size = 1.6, fill = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 1, label = Txt_G, hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5 / .pt) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(Sub$Color, Sub$Order), breaks = Sub$Order,
                    labels = paste0(Sub$Num, ". ", Sub$Order), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey80"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = "log2FC WD/Control (pseudobulk, animals)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5, face = Face_G, colour = Col_G), axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -4, 0), legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "pt")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2.2, colour = "black")))
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/B_M6_Hubs_WD_Pseudobulk.tiff"), pG, width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

write.xlsx(list(M6_Genes = M6, Stats = Stats,
                WD_Pseudobulk_Hubs = G %>% select(gene, cell_type, log2FC, FDR) %>% arrange(gene, cell_type)),
           "Excel/Giot1/Giot1_M6_Hub.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Giot1+ vs Giot1- (MCNs-Avp 2, WD)

```{r Giot1 - Positive vs Negative - Fig 5}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)
Out = "Figures/Fig 5/Giot1"
dir.create(Out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
Non_official = "^(ENSRNOG|LOC|RGD|AABR|AC[0-9]|Newgene)|\\.[0-9]+$"
Key = c("Avp", "Caprin2", "Creb3l1")
Cols_G = c("Giot1+" = "#C0392B", "Giot1-" = "grey70")

MCN_obj = readRDS("RDS/MCNs.rds")
Avp2 = subset(MCN_obj, subset = Cluster == "MCNs-Avp 2" & Group == "WD")
rm(MCN_obj); gc()
Avp2$Giot1 = factor(ifelse(LayerData(Avp2, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")["Giot1", ] > 0, "Giot1+", "Giot1-"),
                    levels = c("Giot1+", "Giot1-"))
Idents(Avp2) = "Giot1"
Counts_G = Avp2[[]] %>% count(Animal = orig.ident, Giot1) %>% group_by(Animal) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
Counts_G

MAST_G = FindMarkers(Avp2, ident.1 = "Giot1+", ident.2 = "Giot1-", test.use = "MAST",
                     logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25, only.pos = FALSE, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>% filter(gene != "Giot1") %>%
  mutate(Sig = p_val_adj < 0.05, Direction = case_when(Sig & avg_log2FC > 0 ~ "Up in Giot1+",
                                                       Sig & avg_log2FC < 0 ~ "Down in Giot1+", TRUE ~ "n.s."))
table(MAST_G$Direction)
rm(Avp2); gc()

pD = ggplot(Counts_G, aes(x = Animal, y = pct, fill = Giot1)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(data = Counts_G %>% group_by(Animal) %>% summarise(n = sum(n)), aes(x = Animal, y = 97, label = n),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "white", size = 5 / .pt, vjust = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Cols_G, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "WD animals", y = "% of MCNs-Avp 2 nuclei") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -4, 0))
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/D_Giot1_PosNeg_Animals.tiff"), pD, width = 1.4, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Lab_E = MAST_G %>% filter(Sig, !grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>% group_by(Direction) %>%
  slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  bind_rows(MAST_G %>% filter(Sig, !grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>% group_by(Direction) %>%
              slice_min(p_val_adj, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()) %>%
  bind_rows(MAST_G %>% filter(gene %in% Key)) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Col = ifelse(gene %in% Key, "#C0392B", "black"))
Cap = max(-log10(MAST_G$p_val_adj[MAST_G$p_val_adj > 0]))
MAST_G = MAST_G %>% mutate(logP = pmin(-log10(p_val_adj), Cap))
Lab_E = Lab_E %>% mutate(logP = pmin(-log10(p_val_adj), Cap))
pE = ggplot(MAST_G, aes(avg_log2FC, logP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point_rast(aes(colour = Direction), size = 0.7, raster.dpi = 600) +
  geom_text_repel(data = Lab_E, aes(label = gene, colour = NULL), colour = Lab_E$Col, fontface = "italic",
                  size = 5.5 / .pt, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                  box.padding = 0.25, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up in Giot1+" = "#C0392B", "Down in Giot1+" = "#25838E", "n.s." = "grey80"),
                      breaks = c("Up in Giot1+", "Down in Giot1+"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2] * "FC (" * italic(Giot1) * "+ / " * italic(Giot1) * "−)"),
       y = expression(-log[10] * " adjusted p (MAST)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -4, 0)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/E_Giot1_PosNeg_Volcano.tiff"), pE, width = 2.8, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Corr = read.xlsx("Excel/Giot1/Avp2_Giot1_Corr.xlsx")
Mods = read.xlsx("Excel/hdWGCNA_MCNs_Modules.xlsx", "Modules")
M6 = Mods %>% filter(module == "MCN-M6") %>% transmute(gene = gene_name, kME = `kME_MCN-M6`)
Sets = list(`Up in Giot1+` = MAST_G$gene[MAST_G$Direction == "Up in Giot1+"],
            `Correlated with Giot1` = Corr$Gene[Corr$Sig & Corr$Rho > 0],
            `MCNs-M6` = setdiff(M6$gene, "Giot1"))
lengths(Sets)
In = sapply(Sets, function(s) unique(unlist(Sets)) %in% s)
rownames(In) = unique(unlist(Sets))
Reg = as.data.frame(In) %>% count(across(everything()))
Reg

Circ = tibble(Set = names(Sets), x0 = c(-0.6, 0.6, 0), y0 = c(0.35, 0.35, -0.65))
Poly = Circ %>% group_by(Set) %>% reframe(t = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200), x = x0 + cos(t), y = y0 + sin(t))
Pos = tibble(A = c(T, F, F, T, T, F, T), B = c(F, T, F, T, F, T, T), C = c(F, F, T, F, T, T, T),
             x = c(-1.05, 1.05, 0, 0, -0.62, 0.62, 0), y = c(0.6, 0.6, -1.2, 0.72, -0.35, -0.35, 0.02))
names(Reg)[1:3] = c("A", "B", "C")
Pos = Pos %>% left_join(Reg, by = c("A", "B", "C")) %>% mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L))
Set_lab = Circ %>% mutate(lx = c(-1.1, 1.1, 0), ly = c(1.55, 1.55, -1.85),
                          Lab = paste0(Set, "\n(n = ", lengths(Sets), ")"))
Cols_V = setNames(c("#C0392B", "#E6A800", "#2E86C1"), names(Sets))
pF = ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = Poly, aes(x, y, fill = Set, colour = Set), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = Pos, aes(x, y, label = n), size = 6.5 / .pt) +
  geom_text(data = Pos %>% filter(A, B, C), aes(x, y - 0.17), label = "core", size = 5 / .pt, fontface = "italic") +
  geom_text(data = Set_lab, aes(lx, ly, label = Lab, colour = Set), size = 6 / .pt, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Cols_V, guide = "none") + scale_colour_manual(values = Cols_V, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(clip = "off") + theme_void()
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/F_Giot1_Venn.tiff"), pF, width = 2.2, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Core = rownames(In)[rowSums(In) == 3]
Core_T = tibble(gene = Core) %>%
  left_join(Corr %>% select(gene = Gene, Rho), by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(MAST_G %>% select(gene, log2FC = avg_log2FC, pct_pos = pct.1, pct_neg = pct.2, p_val_adj), by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(M6, by = "gene") %>% arrange(desc(kME))
Core_T
Core_P = Core_T %>% filter(!grepl(Non_official, gene)) %>% slice_head(n = 25)
Lv = rev(Core_P$gene)
G_long = Core_P %>% select(gene, Rho, log2FC, kME) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = Lv),
         Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Rho", "log2FC", "kME"),
                         labels = c("ρ with Giot1", "log2FC Giot1+/Giot1−", "kME in MCNs-M6")))
Face = ifelse(Lv %in% Key, "bold.italic", "italic"); Col_y = ifelse(Lv %in% Key, "#C0392B", "black")
pG = ggplot(G_long, aes(Value, gene, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(Cols_V[c(2, 1, 3)], levels(G_long$Metric)), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = Face, colour = Col_y, size = 6), axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 5.5),
        strip.background = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside", strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"))
ggsave(paste0(Out, "/G_Giot1_Core_Genes.tiff"), pG, width = 3.6, height = 3, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

write.xlsx(list(Counts_Animal = Counts_G, MAST_Giot1_Pos_vs_Neg = MAST_G %>% select(-logP),
                Sets = stack(Sets) %>% transmute(Set = ind, gene = values), Core_Genes = Core_T),
           "Excel/Giot1/Avp2_WD_Giot1_Pos_vs_Neg.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Supplementary Material

## Functions

```{r Supplementary Functions}
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)

Out_Supp = "Paper/Supplementary_Tables/"
dir.create(Out_Supp, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

Read_X = function(file, sheet = 1) read.xlsx(paste0("Excel/", file), sheet = sheet, sep.names = " ")

Read_GO = function(file) {
  lapply(getSheetNames(paste0("Excel/", file)), function(s) Read_X(file, s) %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)) %>%
    bind_rows() %>% relocate(Cluster)
}

# hdWGCNA genes sorted by module and kME
Module_Genes = function(file) {
  M = Read_X(file, "Modules") %>% select(-color, -any_of("kME_grey"))
  Own = M %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("kME_"), names_to = "m", names_prefix = "kME_", values_to = "kME") %>%
    filter(m == module) %>% select(gene_name, kME)
  M %>% left_join(Own, by = "gene_name") %>%
    arrange(parse_number(sub(".*-M", "", module)), desc(kME)) %>% relocate(gene_name, module, kME)
}
Module_Desc = "Genes of each co-expression module, sorted by kME in the assigned module (kME; hub genes first), and kME in every module (kME_)"
WD_Mod_Desc = function(group) paste0("Effect of WD on module activity (UCell score of the 25 hub genes) per ", group,
                                     ", per nucleus (FDR) and per animal (FDR_animal); _raw = all reads, _DS = depth-downsampled; Specific_pair = module-",
                                     group, " pair with marker overlap FDR < 0.05 and positive mean eigengene")

GO_Desc = function(what, cluster) paste0("GO, KEGG and Reactome enrichment of the ", what,
                                         " (terms with Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted P < 0.05); Cluster indicates the ", cluster)


Supp_Table = function(Table, Title, Sheets) {
  Bold = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
  wb = createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Contents")
  writeData(wb, "Contents", Title, startRow = 1)
  addStyle(wb, "Contents", createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 12), rows = 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb, "Contents", data.frame(Sheet = names(Sheets), Description = sapply(Sheets, `[[`, 1)),
            startRow = 3, headerStyle = Bold)
  setColWidths(wb, "Contents", cols = 1:2, widths = c(28, 100))
  for (s in names(Sheets)) {
    addWorksheet(wb, s)
    # keep TRUE/FALSE as text in Excel
    D = Sheets[[s]][[2]] %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ ifelse(.x, "TRUE", "FALSE")))
    writeData(wb, s, D, headerStyle = Bold)
    freezePane(wb, s, firstRow = TRUE)
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(Out_Supp, "Supplementary_Table_", Table, ".xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
}
```
