## Table S4

```{r Supplementary Table S4}
F_Omics = "Correlation/snRNA_x_Bulk_Omics_Correlation.xlsx"
Om_Stats = Read_X(F_Omics, "Stats")
Om_Genes = Read_X(F_Omics, "Genes")
N_phos = Read_X(F_Omics, "Phospho_per_protein") %>% select(Gene, n_phosphopeptides)
MAST_SON = Read_X("BulkSupraoptic.xlsx")
Padj_SN = MAST_SON %>% select(Gene = gene, padj_snRNAseq = p_val_adj)

Om_Sheet = function(L) {
  Om_Genes %>% filter(Layer == L) %>% left_join(Padj_SN, by = "Gene") %>%
    transmute(Gene, log2FC_snRNAseq = LOG2_SN, padj_snRNAseq, log2FC_bulk = LOG2_Bulk, P_bulk = P, FDR_bulk = FDR,
              Significant_in_both = Sig_bulk, Direction)
}
Om_Desc = function(L, what) {
  s = Om_Stats %>% filter(Layer == L)
  sprintf(paste0("snRNA-seq (MAST, all SON nuclei, adjusted P < 0.05) vs %s (WD vs control). Genes significant in snRNA-seq and detected in the bulk data; ",
                 "Significant in both: n = %d, Spearman rho = %.2f (P = %.1e), %.1f%% concordant"),
          what, s$N_sig_bulk, s$Spearman_rho_sig_bulk, s$Spearman_p_sig_bulk, s$Pct_concordant_sig_bulk)
}

Supp_Table("S4", "Supplementary Table S4. Effect of water deprivation on the SON transcriptome and comparison with bulk omics", list(
  MAST_SON_WD          = list("WD vs control differential expression in all SON nuclei (MAST)", MAST_SON),
  snRNAseq_vs_RNAseq   = list(Om_Desc("Bulk RNA-seq", "bulk RNA-seq (DESeq2)"), Om_Sheet("Bulk RNA-seq")),
  snRNAseq_vs_Proteome = list(Om_Desc("Bulk proteome", "bulk proteome"), Om_Sheet("Bulk proteome")),
  snRNAseq_vs_Phospho  = list(Om_Desc("Bulk phosphoproteome", "bulk phosphoproteome"),
                              Om_Sheet("Bulk phosphoproteome") %>% left_join(N_phos, by = "Gene"))
))
```

```{r Supplementary Table S9}
# Control only
Top5_CC = c("MCNs-Avp 1", "MCNs-Avp 2", "MCNs-Oxt", "MCNs-Mixed 1", "MCNs-Mixed 2")
SON9_CC = c("Other Neurons", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPCs", "Immune Cells", "Endothelial Cells", "VLMCs", "SMCs", "Pericytes")
LR_MCN = Read_X("Control_CellChat_MCNs_Circle.xlsx", "All_LR") %>%
  filter(source %in% c(Top5_CC, SON9_CC), target %in% c(Top5_CC, SON9_CC), source %in% Top5_CC | target %in% Top5_CC) %>%
  mutate(Pair_type = case_when(source %in% Top5_CC & target %in% Top5_CC ~ "MCN -> MCN",
                               source %in% Top5_CC ~ "MCN -> SON", TRUE ~ "SON -> MCN"),
         Order = match(source, c(Top5_CC, SON9_CC)) * 100 + match(target, c(Top5_CC, SON9_CC))) %>%
  rename(DataBase = annotation) %>% arrange(Pair_type, Order, DataBase, desc(prob)) %>% select(-Order) %>% relocate(Pair_type, DataBase)
Spec_MCN = Read_X("Control_CellChat_MCNs_Outgoing.xlsx", "Specificity_all") %>%
  left_join(Read_X("Control_CellChat_MCNs_Outgoing.xlsx", "Specific_top1") %>% transmute(Category, pathway_name, Shown_in_figure = TRUE),
            by = c("Category", "pathway_name")) %>% mutate(Shown_in_figure = !is.na(Shown_in_figure))

  Interactions = list("Number of significant ligand-receptor interactions (Interactions) and summed communication probability (Strength) between each pair of MCN subtypes, and between MCN subtypes and SON cell types, per CellChat database",
                      LR_MCN %>% group_by(Pair_type, DataBase, source, target) %>% summarise(Interactions = n(), Strength = sum(prob), .groups = "drop")),
  Pathways     = list("Communication probability of each signaling pathway (sum over its ligand-receptor pairs) between MCN subtypes, and between MCN subtypes and SON cell types",
                      LR_MCN %>% group_by(Pair_type, DataBase, source, target, pathway_name) %>%
                        summarise(prob = sum(prob), n_LR = n(), LR_pairs = paste0(ligand, "-", receptor, collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")),
  Pathway_specificity = list("Specificity of pathways sent by MCN subtypes: mean probability in the subtype (prob_in) vs the other four subtypes (prob_out), Specificity = (prob_in + 0.01) / (prob_out + 0.01); AVPs = MCNs-Avp 1 and 2; Shown_in_figure = most specific pathway of each category",
                      Spec_MCN),
  LR_pairs     = list("Significant ligand-receptor interactions (P < 0.05) between MCN subtypes, and between MCN subtypes and SON cell types", LR_MCN)
))

  Nuclei_per_animal = list("Number and percentage of Giot1+ (>= 1 Giot1 count) and Giot1- MCNs-Avp 2 nuclei in each WD animal", Read_X(F_PN, "Counts_Animal")),
  Giot1_pos_DEGs    = list("Giot1+ vs Giot1- MCNs-Avp 2 nuclei from WD animals (MAST, min.pct = 0.25, |log2FC| > 0.25); pct.1 = Giot1+, pct.2 = Giot1-; Sig = adjusted P < 0.05",
                           Read_X(F_PN, "MAST_Giot1_Pos_vs_Neg")),
  Core_genes        = list("Core genes: up-regulated in Giot1+ nuclei, positively correlated with Giot1 and members of module MCN-M6 (Rho = correlation with Giot1; log2FC, pct_pos, pct_neg and p_val_adj from Giot1+ vs Giot1-; kME = connectivity in MCN-M6)",
                           Read_X(F_PN, "Core_Genes"))
))
```
